"""Inspect frequency representations on the unchanged RLNN search trajectory."""
import csv
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean
from time import perf_counter

import torch

from eval_v2 import ROOT, dataset_at, search, sync, write_run
from eval_v4_frequency import build_parser as evaluation_parser, configure, prepare
from mis_v3_search import SearchGraph, nodes, platform_search
from mis_v3_value import PAVEV3
from mis_v4_frequency import state_bands, v4_topology
from models import GCN


PHASES = (0, 10, 25, 50, 75, 100)
QUANTILES = (0.0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 1.0)


def csv_file(path, rows):
    if rows:
        with path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(rows)


def distribution(values):
    values = values.detach().float().cpu().flatten()
    result = dict(count=values.numel(), mean=values.mean().item(),
                  std=values.std(unbiased=False).item(), mean_abs=values.abs().mean().item())
    result.update({f"q{int(q * 100):02}": value for q, value in
                   zip(QUANTILES, torch.quantile(values, torch.tensor(QUANTILES)).tolist())})
    return result


def groups(x, counts, degree):
    degree = degree.float().cpu().flatten()
    lower, upper = torch.quantile(degree, torch.tensor([1 / 3, 2 / 3]))
    degree = degree[:, None].expand_as(x)
    masks = dict(all=torch.ones_like(x, dtype=torch.bool), selected=x.bool(),
                 unselected=~x.bool(), blockers0=counts == 0, blockers1=counts == 1,
                 blockers2plus=counts >= 2, selected_conflicted=x.bool() & (counts > 0),
                 degree_low=degree <= lower, degree_mid=(degree > lower) & (degree <= upper),
                 degree_high=degree > upper)
    for selected in (0, 1):
        for count_name, count_mask in (("0", counts == 0), ("1", counts == 1), ("2plus", counts >= 2)):
            masks[f"selected{selected}_blockers{count_name}"] = (x == selected) & count_mask
    return {name: mask for name, mask in masks.items() if mask.any()}


def spectral_basis(edge_index, size):
    binary = torch.zeros((size, size), dtype=torch.float64)
    edges = edge_index.cpu()
    binary[edges[0], edges[1]] = 1
    degree = binary.sum(1)
    inverse = degree.clamp_min(1).rsqrt()
    laplacian = torch.diag((degree > 0).double()) - inverse[:, None] * binary * inverse[None, :]
    eigenvalues, eigenvectors = torch.linalg.eigh(laplacian)
    return eigenvalues.clamp(0, 2), eigenvectors, degree.clamp_min(1).sqrt()


def spectral_statistics(signal, basis):
    """Use sqrt(D) weighting to express the lazy random walk in the L_sym basis."""
    eigenvalues, eigenvectors, weight = basis
    values = signal.detach().to(device="cpu", dtype=torch.float64).flatten(1)
    coefficients = eigenvectors.T @ (weight[:, None] * values)
    energy = coefficients.square().sum(1)
    total = energy.sum()
    denominator = total.clamp_min(1e-30)
    stats = dict(weighted_energy=total.item(),
                 spectral_centroid=(energy * eigenvalues).sum().div(denominator).item())
    for low, high in ((0, 0.5), (0.5, 1), (1, 1.5), (1.5, 2.000001)):
        key = f"energy_fraction_{low:g}_{min(high, 2):g}"
        stats[key] = energy[(eigenvalues >= low) & (eigenvalues < high)].sum().div(denominator).item()
    return stats


def build_parser():
    parser = evaluation_parser()
    parser.set_defaults(split="validation", test_samples=100)
    parser.add_argument("--diagnostic-particles", type=int, default=4,
                        help="Particles used for representation and conditional distributions")
    parser.add_argument("--spectral-graphs", type=int, default=20,
                        help="First graphs with a full L_sym eigendecomposition")
    parser.add_argument("--reference-checkpoint", type=Path,
                        help="Original RLNN best.pt; defaults to the same-seed v2 none checkpoint")
    return parser


@torch.no_grad()
def diagnose(args):
    configure(args)
    if args.time_budget_s is not None or args.extended_search:
        raise ValueError("Mechanism diagnostics use the fixed K20 T100 trajectory")
    if set(args.post) - {"none", "pave"}:
        raise ValueError("Mechanism diagnostics record none and the frozen PAVE head")
    if not 1 <= args.diagnostic_particles <= args.num_k or args.spectral_graphs < 0:
        raise ValueError("Choose 1..20 diagnostic particles and a nonnegative spectral graph count")
    solver = prepare(args)
    solver.model.requires_grad_(False)
    model = solver.accelerator.unwrap_model(solver.model)
    adapter = getattr(model, "adapter", None)
    device = solver.accelerator.device
    dataset = dataset_at(args.test_path, solver.dtype, args.test_samples, official=args.split == "test")
    backbone_seed = args.train_seed if args.backbone_seed is None else args.backbone_seed
    reference_path = args.reference_checkpoint or ROOT / f"outputs/v2/none_seed{backbone_seed}/checkpoints/best.pt"
    reference = GCN(1, args.num_h, args.num_l, 1).to(device).eval()
    reference.load_state_dict(torch.load(reference_path, map_location=device, weights_only=True))
    reference.requires_grad_(False)
    ranker = None
    if "pave" in args.post:
        checkpoint = torch.load(args.value_checkpoint, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
        ranker = PAVEV3(checkpoint["mode"], checkpoint.get("stats_dim", 24)).cpu().eval()
        ranker.load_state_dict(checkpoint["model_state"])
    args.result_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    curves, conditioned, bands, spectra, eigen_rows, final_rows, timings = [], [], [], [], [], [], []
    histograms = {}
    started = perf_counter()
    started_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

    for index, item in enumerate(dataset):
        graph_id = f"idx_{index}" if args.split == "test" else Path(dataset.files[index]).stem
        edges = item.edge_index
        cpu_graph = SearchGraph(item.num_nodes, edges, seed=args.seed + index)
        basis = spectral_basis(edges, item.num_nodes) if index < args.spectral_graphs else None
        if basis is not None:
            eigen_rows.append(dict(graph_id=graph_id, **distribution(basis[0])))
        graph = item.to(device)
        sync(device)
        graph_started = perf_counter()
        observer_seconds = 0.0

        def observe(step, state, best, adj, topology):
            nonlocal observer_seconds
            if step not in PHASES:
                return
            sync(device)
            observation_started = perf_counter()
            ft = topology if adapter is not None else v4_topology(graph.edge_index, adj, graph.num_nodes)
            raw_energy, _ = solver.problem.energy_func(adj, graph.b, state)
            best_energy, _ = solver.problem.energy_func(adj, graph.b, best)
            counts = ft.binary @ state.float()
            best_counts = ft.binary @ best.float()
            logits = solver.flip_logits(state, graph, adj, topology)
            probabilities = logits.sigmoid()
            sync(device)
            decode_start = perf_counter()
            decoded = solver.problem.decode_gradient_flip(best, adj, graph.b, return_solutions=True)
            sync(device)
            decode_seconds = perf_counter() - decode_start
            for particle in range(state.shape[1]):
                curves.append(dict(
                    graph_id=graph_id, step=step, particle=particle,
                    trajectory_elapsed_excluding_observers_s=observation_started - graph_started - observer_seconds,
                    raw_energy=raw_energy[particle].item(), best_energy=best_energy[particle].item(),
                    raw_selected=state[:, particle].sum().item(), best_selected=best[:, particle].sum().item(),
                    raw_conflict_edges=(state[:, particle].float() * counts[:, particle]).sum().item() / 2,
                    best_conflict_edges=(best[:, particle].float() * best_counts[:, particle]).sum().item() / 2,
                    decoded_best_energy_size=int(decoded[:, particle].sum().item()),
                    expected_flips=probabilities[:, particle].sum().item(),
                    expected_flip_target=args.num_d,
                ))

            particles = args.diagnostic_particles
            x = state[:, :particles].contiguous()
            sync(device)
            adapter_start = perf_counter()
            with solver.accelerator.autocast():
                details = adapter.inspect(x, adj, ft) if adapter is not None else state_bands(x, ft, args.beta)
                raw_hidden = model.initial_project(x.unsqueeze(-1))
                delta_low = details.get("delta_low", torch.zeros_like(raw_hidden))
                delta_high = details.get("delta_high", torch.zeros_like(raw_hidden))
                fused = raw_hidden + delta_low.to(raw_hidden.dtype) + delta_high.to(raw_hidden.dtype)
            sync(device)
            representation_seconds = perf_counter() - adapter_start
            with solver.accelerator.autocast():
                raw_all = model.initial_project(state.unsqueeze(-1))
                disabled_logits = model.project_hidden(raw_all, ft.normalized).squeeze(-1)
                reference_logits = reference(state.unsqueeze(-1), graph.edge_index, ft.normalized).squeeze(-1)
            actual_logits = logits[:, :particles].float()
            adapter_delta = actual_logits - disabled_logits[:, :particles].float()
            reference_delta = actual_logits - reference_logits[:, :particles].float()
            metrics = dict(logit_delta_adapter=adapter_delta, logit_delta_reference=reference_delta,
                           probability=probabilities[:, :particles],
                           probability_delta_adapter=probabilities[:, :particles] - disabled_logits[:, :particles].float().sigmoid())
            if adapter is not None:
                metrics.update(gate_low=details["gates"][..., 0], gate_high=details["gates"][..., 1])
            masks = groups(x.float().cpu(), details["c"].cpu(), ft.degree)
            for metric, values in metrics.items():
                values = values.detach().float().cpu()
                for group, mask in masks.items():
                    sample = values[mask]
                    conditioned.append(dict(graph_id=graph_id, step=step, group=group,
                                            metric=metric, **distribution(sample)))
                    if metric.startswith("gate_"):
                        key = (step, group, metric)
                        histogram = torch.histc(sample, bins=10, min=0, max=1).long()
                        histograms[key] = histograms.get(key, torch.zeros(10, dtype=torch.long)) + histogram

            z = details["z"].float()
            error = z - details["L2"].float() - details["B1"].float() - details["B0"].float()
            raw_norm = raw_hidden.float().norm().clamp_min(1e-30)
            signals = {key: details[key] for key in ("z", "L2", "B0", "B1")}
            signals.update(raw_hidden=raw_hidden, fused_hidden=fused, logits=actual_logits,
                           disabled_logits=disabled_logits[:, :particles],
                           logit_delta_adapter=adapter_delta, logit_delta_reference=reference_delta)
            if adapter is not None:
                signals.update({key: details[key] for key in ("low_input", "high_input", "u_low", "u_high",
                                                               "delta_low", "delta_high")})
            band_row = dict(graph_id=graph_id, step=step, particles=particles,
                            reconstruction_abs=error.norm().item(),
                            reconstruction_relative=(error.norm() / z.norm().clamp_min(1e-30)).item(),
                            residual_low_relative=(delta_low.float().norm() / raw_norm).item(),
                            residual_high_relative=(delta_high.float().norm() / raw_norm).item(),
                            residual_total_relative=((delta_low.float() + delta_high.float()).norm() / raw_norm).item(),
                            alpha_low=adapter.alpha_low.item() if adapter is not None else 0,
                            alpha_high=adapter.alpha_high.item() if adapter is not None else 0)
            for name, signal in signals.items():
                band_row[name + "_norm"] = signal.float().norm().item()
                band_row[name + "_rms"] = signal.float().square().mean().sqrt().item()
                if basis is not None:
                    spectra.append(dict(graph_id=graph_id, step=step, signal=name,
                                        **spectral_statistics(signal, basis)))
            bands.append(band_row)
            sync(device)
            elapsed = perf_counter() - observation_started
            observer_seconds += elapsed
            timings.append(dict(graph_id=graph_id, step=step, diagnostic_time_s=elapsed,
                                representation_time_s=representation_seconds, decode_time_s=decode_seconds))

        selected, steps = search(solver, graph, cpu_graph, args.seed + index, observe=observe)
        sync(device)
        trajectory_seconds = perf_counter() - graph_started
        if not cpu_graph.feasible(selected) or (graph.num_nodes and not selected):
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid diagnostic independent set: {graph_id}")
        row = dict(graph_id=graph_id, base_size=selected.bit_count(), final_size=selected.bit_count(),
                   rule_size=selected.bit_count(), pave_gain=0, pave_time_s=0.0, score_time_s=0.0,
                   search_steps=steps, trajectory_with_diagnostics_s=trajectory_seconds,
                   diagnostic_observer_s=observer_seconds, selected_nodes=" ".join(map(str, nodes(selected))))
        if ranker is not None:
            score_seconds = 0.0

            def choose(local_graph, current, actions, remaining):
                nonlocal score_seconds
                start = perf_counter()
                action = ranker.choose(local_graph, current, actions, remaining)
                score_seconds += perf_counter() - start
                return action

            start = perf_counter()
            result = platform_search(cpu_graph, selected, choose=choose, horizon=1, outer_rounds=8,
                                     initial_rounds=3, candidate_cap=32, improving_cap=48, repair_rounds=4)
            if not cpu_graph.feasible(result.best):
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid PAVE diagnostic independent set: {graph_id}")
            row.update(final_size=result.best.bit_count(), rule_size=result.rule_size,
                       pave_gain=result.best.bit_count() - selected.bit_count(),
                       pave_time_s=perf_counter() - start, score_time_s=score_seconds,
                       selected_nodes=" ".join(map(str, nodes(result.best))))
        final_rows.append(row)
        if (index + 1) % 10 == 0 or index + 1 == len(dataset):
            print(f"{index + 1}/{len(dataset)} graphs: base={mean(r['base_size'] for r in final_rows):.4f}, "
                  f"final={mean(r['final_size'] for r in final_rows):.4f}", flush=True)

    for filename, rows in (("energy_conflict_curves.csv", curves), ("conditional_distributions.csv", conditioned),
                           ("bands.csv", bands), ("spectra.csv", spectra), ("eigenvalues.csv", eigen_rows),
                           ("per_graph.csv", final_rows), ("diagnostic_timings.csv", timings)):
        csv_file(args.result_dir / filename, rows)
    histogram_rows = [dict(step=step, group=group, metric=metric, counts=counts.tolist())
                      for (step, group, metric), counts in sorted(histograms.items())]
    (args.result_dir / "gate_histograms.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(
        bin_edges=[value / 10 for value in range(11)], distributions=histogram_rows), indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    write_run(args.result_dir, dict(
        version="v4_frequency", mode="diagnostic", status="completed", frequency=args.frequency,
        config=vars(args), train_seed=backbone_seed, search_seed=args.seed, split=args.split,
        samples=len(final_rows), diagnostic_particles=args.diagnostic_particles,
        spectral_graphs=len(eigen_rows), phases=PHASES,
        reference_checkpoint=str(reference_path),
        value_checkpoint=str(args.value_checkpoint) if ranker is not None else None,
        mean_size=mean(row["base_size"] for row in final_rows),
        mean_post_size=mean(row["final_size"] for row in final_rows),
        mean_pave_gain=mean(row["pave_gain"] for row in final_rows),
        maximum_reconstruction_relative=max(row["reconstruction_relative"] for row in bands),
        started_at=started_at, finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        wall_time_s=perf_counter() - started,
        curve_definition="Each particle's original best-energy state, independently decoded at observation; no added archive",
        logit_delta_adapter="Current model minus the same model with both adapter residuals disabled, at the same state",
        logit_delta_reference="Current model minus original RLNN reference checkpoint, at the same state",
        spectral_definition="L_sym Fourier energy of sqrt(max(degree,1))*signal; isolated L_sym rows are zero",
        distribution_definition="Per-graph quantiles on the first diagnostic_particles; degree terciles are graph-specific",
        timing="Diagnostic observers add computation and are excluded from official solve-time comparisons",
    ))
    return final_rows


if __name__ == "__main__":
    diagnose(build_parser().parse_args())

"""FP32 stage spectra on common teacher states and each student's own states."""
import argparse
import csv
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter

import torch

from eval_v2 import TRAIN, VALID, dataset_at
from frequency_diag_utils import (
    BAND_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE, node_groups, override_logits, spectral_basis,
    spectral_energy_many, trace_model,
)
from mis_v1 import adjacency
from mis_v4_frequency import V4FrequencyGCN, v4_topology
from models import GCN


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
MODELS = ("v4a", "v4a_message", "v4a_mlp")
PHASES = (0, 10, 25, 50, 75, 100)


class CsvOutput:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.stream = path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="")
        self.writer = None

    def write(self, row):
        if self.writer is None:
            self.writer = csv.DictWriter(self.stream, fieldnames=list(row))
            self.writer.writeheader()
        self.writer.writerow(row)

    def close(self):
        self.stream.close()


def load_model(mode, checkpoint, device):
    model = GCN(1, 128, 5, 1) if mode == "none" else V4FrequencyGCN(128, 5, mode=mode)
    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(checkpoint, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True))
    return model.float().to(device).eval().requires_grad_(False)


@torch.no_grad()
def trajectory_states(model, mode, graph, adj, topology, initial, uniforms, phases, particles):
    x = initial.clone()
    snapshots = {0: x[:, :particles].clone()} if 0 in phases else {}
    for step, noise in enumerate(uniforms, 1):
        if mode == "none":
            logits = model(x.unsqueeze(-1), graph.edge_index, topology.normalized).squeeze(-1)
        else:
            logits = model(x, graph.edge_index, adj, topology)
        x = torch.where(noise < logits.sigmoid(), 1 - x, x)
        if step in phases:
            snapshots[step] = x[:, :particles].clone()
    return snapshots


def rms(values):
    return float(values.float().square().mean().sqrt())


def correlation(first, second):
    first = first.double().flatten()
    second = second.double().flatten()
    if first.min() == first.max() or second.min() == second.max():
        return None
    first = first - first.mean()
    second = second - second.mean()
    denominator = first.norm() * second.norm()
    return float((first * second).sum() / denominator) if denominator > 1e-20 else None


@torch.no_grad()
def behavior_row(common, group, mask, details, signals, full_logits, no_high, no_adapter):
    logits = signals["logits"]
    probabilities = logits.sigmoid()
    hidden = signals["raw_hidden"][mask].float()
    low = details["delta_low"][mask].float()
    high = details["delta_high"][mask].float()
    high_change = (logits - no_high)[mask]
    normalizer = hidden.norm().clamp_min(1e-30)
    row = dict(
        **common, group=group, count=int(mask.sum()),
        selected_fraction=float(details["x"][mask].mean()),
        c_mean=float(details["c"][mask].mean()), r_mean=float(details["r"][mask].mean()),
        gate_low_mean=float(details["gates"][..., 0][mask].mean()),
        gate_high_mean=float(details["gates"][..., 1][mask].mean()),
        raw_hidden_rms=rms(hidden), delta_low_rms=rms(low), delta_high_rms=rms(high),
        residual_low_relative=float(low.norm() / normalizer),
        residual_high_relative=float(high.norm() / normalizer),
        residual_total_relative=float((low + high).norm() / normalizer),
        logit_change_from_full_rms=rms((logits - full_logits)[mask]),
        probability_change_from_full_mean_abs=float((probabilities - full_logits.sigmoid())[mask].abs().mean()),
        logit_delta_high_rms=rms(high_change),
        probability_delta_high_mean_abs=float((probabilities - no_high.sigmoid())[mask].abs().mean()),
        logit_delta_adapter_rms=rms((logits - no_adapter)[mask]),
        probability_below_001=float((probabilities[mask] < 0.01).float().mean()),
        probability_above_099=float((probabilities[mask] > 0.99).float().mean()),
        expected_flips=float(probabilities.sum(0).mean()) if group == "all" else None,
    )
    for band in ("B0", "B1"):
        for channel, label in enumerate(("x", "logc")):
            row[f"corr_{band}_{label}_high_logit_change"] = correlation(details[band][..., channel][mask], high_change)
    return row


@torch.no_grad()
def diagnose(args):
    device = torch.device(args.device)
    torch.set_num_threads(args.cpu_threads)
    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
    if not 1 <= args.particles <= 20 or any(step < 0 or step > 100 for step in args.phases):
        raise ValueError("P1 observes 1..20 particles at phases in 0..100")
    graphs = args.graphs if args.graphs is not None else (20 if args.split == "train" else 100)
    if graphs <= 0:
        raise ValueError("P1 graph count must be positive")
    data_path = args.data_path or (TRAIN if args.split == "train" else VALID)
    dataset = dataset_at(data_path, torch.float32, graphs)
    if not len(dataset):
        raise ValueError("P1 requires at least one cached graph")
    checkpoint_root = args.checkpoint_root
    teacher_path = args.teacher_checkpoint or checkpoint_root / f"outputs/v2/none_seed{args.seed}/checkpoints/best.pt"
    teacher = load_model("none", teacher_path, device)
    paths = {mode: checkpoint_root / f"outputs/v4_frequency/{mode}_seed{args.seed}/checkpoints/best.pt" for mode in args.models}
    models = {mode: load_model(mode, path, device) for mode, path in paths.items()}
    phases = sorted(set(args.phases))
    origins = ("teacher", "own") if args.trajectory == "both" else (args.trajectory,)
    graph_ids = [Path(file).stem for file in dataset.files]
    args.result_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    outputs = {name: CsvOutput(args.result_dir / f"{name}.csv") for name in
               ("stage_spectra", "stationary_removed", "gates_and_deltas", "graph_spectral_support")}
    metadata = dict(
        version="v4_frequency_followup", task="p1_spectrum", status="running", seed=args.seed,
        config=vars(args), models=args.models, graph_ids=graph_ids, split=args.split,
        role="exploratory" if args.split == "train" else "validation_recheck",
        dtype="float32", spectral_dtype="float64_cpu", state_source=args.trajectory,
        actual_K=20, actual_T=100, diagnostic_particles=args.particles, phases=phases,
        checkpoints={**paths, "teacher": teacher_path}, postprocess="none",
        variants=["full", "high_no_bias0", "high_no_bias2"],
        band_boundaries=[0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2], band_boundary_tolerance=BAND_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE,
        stationary_eigenvalue_epsilon=1e-7, centered_relative_energy_floor=1e-12,
        spectral_definition="L_sym projection of sqrt(max(degree,1))*signal; remove entire zero eigenspace",
        constant_definition="node_constant: unweighted global node mean; weighted_global_constant: degree-weighted global node mean",
        randomness="Same x0 and 100 pre-generated per-step N×20 FP32 uniforms for teacher and own trajectories; search_seed+graph_index",
        timing="Diagnostic wall time only; not solver latency", started_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    )

    def save():
        (args.result_dir / "run.json").write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    save()
    start = perf_counter()
    observations = spectral_records = 0
    try:
        for index, graph in enumerate(dataset):
            graph_id = graph_ids[index]
            basis = spectral_basis(graph.edge_index, graph.num_nodes)
            eigenvalues = basis[0]
            outputs["graph_spectral_support"].write(dict(
                graph_id=graph_id, seed=args.seed, nodes=graph.num_nodes,
                zero_modes=int((eigenvalues <= 1e-7).sum()),
                eigenvalue_min=float(eigenvalues.min()), eigenvalue_max=float(eigenvalues.max()),
                eigenvalue_mean=float(eigenvalues.mean()),
            ))
            graph = graph.to(device)
            adj = adjacency(graph)
            topology = v4_topology(graph.edge_index, adj, graph.num_nodes)
            generator = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(args.search_seed + index)
            initial = torch.randint(0, 2, (graph.num_nodes, 20), dtype=torch.float32, device=device, generator=generator)
            uniforms = torch.stack([torch.rand(initial.shape, device=device, generator=generator) for _ in range(100)])
            teacher_states = trajectory_states(teacher, "none", graph, adj, topology, initial,
                                              uniforms, phases, args.particles) if "teacher" in origins else None
            for mode, model in models.items():
                own_states = trajectory_states(model, mode, graph, adj, topology, initial,
                                                uniforms, phases, args.particles) if "own" in origins else None
                for origin in origins:
                    snapshots = teacher_states if origin == "teacher" else own_states
                    for step in phases:
                        x = snapshots[step]
                        common = dict(graph_id=graph_id, seed=args.seed, model=mode, trajectory=origin,
                                      step=step, particles=args.particles)
                        full_details, full_signals = trace_model(model, x, graph.edge_index, adj, topology)
                        no_high = override_logits(model, x, graph.edge_index, adj, topology, high_scale=0)
                        no_adapter = model(x, graph.edge_index, adj, topology, disable_adapter=True)
                        variants = {"full": (full_details, full_signals)}
                        for layer in (0, 2):
                            variants[f"high_no_bias{layer}"] = trace_model(
                                model, x, graph.edge_index, adj, topology, zero_bias={"high": (layer,)})
                        for variant, (details, signals) in variants.items():
                            selected_signals = dict(signals) if variant == "full" else {
                                name: value for name, value in signals.items()
                                if name.startswith("high_") or name in ("delta_high", "fused_hidden", "logits")}
                            selected_signals["logit_delta_high"] = signals["logits"] - no_high
                            selected_signals["logit_delta_adapter"] = signals["logits"] - no_adapter
                            selected_signals["logit_delta_from_full"] = signals["logits"] - full_signals["logits"]
                            statistics = spectral_energy_many(selected_signals, basis)
                            for signal, record in statistics.items():
                                row = dict(**common, signal=signal, variant=variant, **record)
                                outputs["stage_spectra"].write(row)
                                centered = {key: value for key, value in record.items()
                                            if key.startswith(("centered_", "stationary_", "node_constant_", "weighted_global_constant_"))
                                            or key in ("nonstationary_energy", "valid_centered", "zero_modes", "total_energy")}
                                outputs["stationary_removed"].write(dict(**common, signal=signal, variant=variant, **centered))
                                spectral_records += 1
                            groups = node_groups(x, details["c"], details["r"]) if variant == "full" else {
                                "all": torch.ones_like(x, dtype=torch.bool)}
                            for group, mask in groups.items():
                                if mask.any():
                                    row = behavior_row(dict(**common, variant=variant), group, mask, details,
                                                       signals, full_signals["logits"], no_high, no_adapter)
                                    row.update(alpha_low=float(model.adapter.alpha_low), alpha_high=float(model.adapter.alpha_high))
                                    outputs["gates_and_deltas"].write(row)
                        observations += 1
            print(f"{index + 1}/{len(dataset)} graphs; {observations} state/model observations; {perf_counter() - start:.1f}s", flush=True)
        metadata.update(status="completed", graphs=len(dataset), observations=observations, spectral_records=spectral_records)
    except Exception as error:
        metadata.update(status="failed", error=str(error))
        raise
    finally:
        for output in outputs.values():
            output.close()
        metadata.update(finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), wall_time_s=perf_counter() - start)
        save()
    return metadata


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--split", choices=("train", "validation"), default="train")
    parser.add_argument("--graphs", type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--data-path", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, choices=(0, 1, 2), default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--search-seed", type=int, default=1017)
    parser.add_argument("--models", nargs="+", choices=MODELS, default=list(MODELS))
    parser.add_argument("--trajectory", choices=("teacher", "own", "both"), default="both")
    parser.add_argument("--particles", type=int, default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--phases", nargs="+", type=int, default=list(PHASES))
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint-root", type=Path, default=ROOT)
    parser.add_argument("--teacher-checkpoint", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--device", default="cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    parser.add_argument("--cpu-threads", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--result-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    diagnose(parser.parse_args())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Measure v5 state signals, shared-noise action changes and complete MIS replay."""
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean

import torch

from diagnose_v4_branch_replay import PHASES, csv_file, replay, same_state_rows, shared_noise
from eval_v2 import ROOT, TRAIN, VALID, dataset_at, write_run
from frequency_diag_utils import spectral_basis, spectral_energy_many
from mis_v1 import adjacency
from mis_v3_search import SearchGraph, platform_search
from mis_v3_value import load_pave_v3
from mis_v4_frequency import lazy_walk
from mis_v5_frequency import V5DAFRGCN, v5_topology
from models import GCN
from problems.mis import Problem
from probe_v4_utility import rank_metrics
from probe_v4_utility_followup import label_reliability, node_masks, paired_utilities, sample_candidates


ARMS = ("baseline", "v5a_mlp", "v5a_message", "v5a")


def weights(arm, seed, initial=False):
    if arm == "baseline" or initial:
        return ROOT / f"outputs/v2/none_seed{seed}/checkpoints/best.pt"
    return ROOT / f"outputs/v5_frequency/train_{arm}_seed{seed}/checkpoints/best.pt"


def load(arm, seed, device, initial=False):
    model = GCN(1, 128, 5, 1) if arm == "baseline" else V5DAFRGCN(128, 5, mode=arm)
    missing, extra = model.load_state_dict(torch.load(weights(arm, seed, initial), weights_only=True, map_location="cpu"),
                                           strict=not initial or arm == "baseline")
    if extra or any(not key.startswith("adapter.") for key in missing):
        raise ValueError(f"Incompatible checkpoint for {arm}")
    return model.to(device).eval().requires_grad_(False)


def score(model, x, edges, adj, topo, precision):
    with torch.autocast(device_type=x.device.type, dtype=torch.float16, enabled=precision == "fp16"):
        if hasattr(model, "adapter"):
            return model(x, edges, adj, topo).float()
        return model(x.unsqueeze(-1), edges, topo.normalized).squeeze(-1).float()


@torch.no_grad()
def run(args):
    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    device = torch.device("cuda")
    dtype = torch.float16 if args.precision == "fp16" else torch.float32
    arms = ("baseline", "v5a") if args.initial else ARMS
    models = {arm: load(arm, args.seed, device, args.initial) for arm in arms}
    variants = dict(models)
    if not args.initial:
        variants["same_backbone"] = models["v5a"]
    dataset = dataset_at(TRAIN if args.split == "train" else VALID, dtype, args.samples)
    problem = Problem(1.02)
    head_path = ROOT / f"outputs/v3/stats_h1_seed{args.seed}/checkpoints/best.pt"
    ranker = None if args.initial else load_pave_v3(head_path).requires_grad_(False)
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    rows = {key: [] for key in ("reconstruction", "stage_spectra", "node_groups", "gate_summary", "replay", "replay_curves",
                               "native_repeat", "utility_ranking", "utility_reliability")}
    for index, cpu_graph in enumerate(dataset):
        gid = Path(dataset.files[index]).stem
        graph_seed = 1017 + index
        basis = spectral_basis(cpu_graph.edge_index, cpu_graph.num_nodes)
        legal = SearchGraph(cpu_graph.num_nodes, cpu_graph.edge_index, seed=graph_seed)
        graph = cpu_graph.to(device)
        adj = adjacency(graph)
        topo = v5_topology(graph.edge_index, adj, graph.num_nodes)
        initial, uniforms, terminal = shared_noise(graph.num_nodes, 20, 100, device, dtype, graph_seed)
        results = {}
        for arm, model in variants.items():
            def forward(x):
                if arm == "same_backbone":
                    with torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.float16, enabled=args.precision == "fp16"):
                        return model.backbone_logits(x, graph.edge_index, topo).float()
                return score(model, x, graph.edge_index, adj, topo, args.precision)
            result = replay(problem, adj, graph.b, initial, uniforms, forward, capture=True)
            results[arm] = result
            start = result["selected"]
            final = (platform_search(legal, start, choose=ranker.choose, horizon=1).best
                     if ranker is not None else start)
            if not legal.feasible(start) or not legal.feasible(final):
                raise ValueError(f"Infeasible replay at {gid}/{arm}")
            common = dict(graph_id=gid, seed=args.seed, arm=arm, precision=args.precision)
            counts = topo.binary @ result["best_states"].float()
            conflicts = (counts * result["best_states"].float()).sum(0) / 2
            rows["replay"].append(dict(**common, base_size=start.bit_count(), final_size=final.bit_count(),
                                       pave_gain=final.bit_count()-start.bit_count(),
                                       best_conflicts_mean=float(conflicts.mean()), feasible=1))
            rows["replay_curves"].extend(dict(**common, **row) for row in result["curves"])
            if index < args.repeat_graphs and arm in ("baseline", "v5a"):
                repeat = replay(problem, adj, graph.b, initial, uniforms, forward, capture=True)
                rows["native_repeat"].append(dict(**common, size_delta=repeat["selected"].bit_count()-start.bit_count(),
                    changed_phases=sum(not torch.equal(result["states"][t], repeat["states"][t]) for t in PHASES)))
        for step in PHASES:
            teacher_x = results["baseline"]["states"][step][:, :4]
            scores = {arm: score(model, teacher_x, graph.edge_index, adj, topo, args.precision)
                      for arm, model in models.items()}
            if not args.initial:
                with torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.float16, enabled=args.precision == "fp16"):
                    scores["same_backbone"] = models["v5a"].backbone_logits(teacher_x, graph.edge_index, topo).float()
            scores["full"] = scores.pop("v5a")
            noise = (uniforms[step] if step < 100 else terminal)[:, :4]
            counts = topo.binary @ teacher_x.float()
            release = teacher_x.float() * (topo.binary @ ((teacher_x == 0) & (counts == 1)).float())
            rows["node_groups"].extend(dict(graph_id=gid, seed=args.seed, step=step, **row)
                for row in same_state_rows(teacher_x, counts, release, scores, noise, binary=topo.binary))
            if args.utility and step in (25, 50, 100):
                state = teacher_x[:, 0].float()
                masks, _ = node_masks(state, counts[:, 0], release[:, 0])
                for sampling, count in (("uniform", 16), ("stratified", 24)):
                    candidate_seed = (graph_seed + 10000 * args.seed) * 101 + step
                    candidates = sample_candidates(masks, count, sampling, candidate_seed).to(device)
                    _, gains = paired_utilities(models["baseline"], state, candidates, graph, adj, topo.normalized,
                                                problem, 20, candidate_seed, replicates=8)
                    gains = gains.cpu()
                    info = dict(graph_id=gid, seed=args.seed, step=step, sampling=sampling, replicates=8, horizon=20)
                    rows["utility_reliability"].append(dict(**info, **label_reliability(gains)))
                    for arm, logit in scores.items():
                        metrics = rank_metrics(logit[candidates, 0].cpu(), gains.mean(0))
                        rows["utility_ranking"].append(dict(**info, arm=arm, **metrics))
            for arm in arms[1:]:
                model = models[arm]
                for source, x in (("teacher", teacher_x), ("own", results[arm]["states"][step][:, :4])):
                    corr, details = model.adapter(x, topo, return_details=True)
                    with torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.float16, enabled=args.precision == "fp16"):
                        base = model.backbone_logits(x, graph.edge_index, topo)
                        final = base + corr.to(base.dtype)
                    common = dict(graph_id=gid, seed=args.seed, step=step, arm=arm, trajectory=source)
                    signals = {key: details[key] for key in ("z", "proposal", "gated", "low", "high")}
                    signals.update(correction=corr, logits_base=base, logits_final=final,
                                   delta_probability=final.float().sigmoid()-base.float().sigmoid())
                    stats = spectral_energy_many(signals, basis)
                    rows["stage_spectra"].extend(dict(**common, signal=name, **value) for name, value in stats.items())
                    if arm == "v5a":
                        p = lazy_walk(details["gated"], topo)
                        reconstruction = (p + (details["gated"] - p) - details["gated"]).abs()
                        rows["reconstruction"].append(dict(**common, max_abs_error=float(reconstruction.max()),
                            max_relative_error=float(reconstruction.max()/details["gated"].abs().max().clamp_min(1e-12)),
                            high_stationary_fraction=stats["high"]["stationary_fraction"]))
                    for j, name in enumerate(("low", "high")):
                        gate = details["gates"][..., j].flatten()
                        rows["gate_summary"].append(dict(**common, branch=name, mean=float(gate.mean()),
                                                         p10=float(gate.quantile(.1)), p90=float(gate.quantile(.9))))
        if (index + 1) % 10 == 0 or index + 1 == len(dataset):
            print(f"{index+1}/{len(dataset)} paired graphs", flush=True)
    for key, records in rows.items():
        csv_file(args.output / f"{key}.csv", records)
    write_run(args.output, dict(status="completed", split=args.split, seed=args.seed, precision=args.precision,
        initial=args.initial, samples=len(dataset), K=20, T=100, search_seed=1017,
        graph_ids=[Path(p).stem for p in dataset.files], params={k: sum(p.numel() for p in m.parameters()) for k,m in models.items()},
        base_sizes={arm: mean(row["base_size"] for row in rows["replay"] if row["arm"] == arm) for arm in variants},
        checkpoints={arm: str(weights(arm, args.seed, args.initial)) for arm in arms},
        pave_checkpoint=str(head_path) if ranker is not None else None))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--split", choices=("train", "validation"), default="train")
    parser.add_argument("--samples", type=int, default=20)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--precision", choices=("fp32", "fp16"), default="fp32")
    parser.add_argument("--initial", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--repeat-graphs", type=int, default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--utility", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.utility and (args.precision != "fp32" or args.split != "train" or args.initial):
        parser.error("Utility diagnostics use trained policies on FP32 training graphs")
    run(args)


========================================================================
FILE: models/diagnose_v6_frequency.py

"""Measure cross-layer energy and readout contributions on validation trajectories."""

import argparse
import csv
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean

import torch

from eval_v2 import VALID, dataset_at, load_policy, policy_parser, write_run
from mis_v1 import adjacency


def dirichlet_ratio(h, adj):
    h = h.float().flatten(1)
    return float((h * (h - adj @ h)).sum() / h.square().sum().clamp_min(1e-12))


@torch.no_grad()
def diagnose(args):
    parser = policy_parser()
    mode = "none" if args.arm == "baseline" else args.arm
    options = parser.parse_args(["--result_dir", str(args.output), "--split", "validation",
        "--save_dir", str(args.checkpoint), "--frequency", mode, "--mixed_precision", "no"])
    solver = load_policy(options)
    model = solver.accelerator.unwrap_model(solver.model)
    device = solver.accelerator.device
    dataset = dataset_at(VALID, solver.dtype, args.samples)
    rows = []
    for index, graph in enumerate(dataset):
        gid = Path(dataset.files[index]).stem
        graph = graph.to(device)
        adj = adjacency(graph)
        topo = solver.policy_topology(graph, adj)
        rng = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(1017 + index)
        states = solver.sample_states(graph, adj, generator=rng, normalized=topo)
        for step, state in enumerate(states):
            if step not in (0, 10, 50, 100):
                continue
            if mode == "none":
                h = model.initial_project(state.unsqueeze(-1))
                layers = []
                for conv, linear in zip(model.convs, model.linears):
                    h = h + model.activation(conv(h, topo) + linear(h))
                    layers.append(h)
                meso = high = None
                normalized = topo
            else:
                _, layers, meso, high = model(state, graph.edge_index, adj, topo, diagnose=True)
                normalized = topo.normalized
            row = dict(graph_id=gid, step=step,
                       meso_logit_energy=float(meso.square().mean()) if meso is not None else None,
                       high_logit_energy=float(high.square().mean()) if high is not None else None)
            row.update({f"layer{i}_dirichlet_ratio": dirichlet_ratio(h, normalized)
                        for i, h in enumerate(layers, 1)})
            rows.append(row)
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    with (args.output / "per_state.csv").open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)
    summary = {key: mean(row[key] for row in rows) for key in rows[0]
               if key not in ("graph_id", "step") and rows[0][key] is not None}
    write_run(args.output, dict(status="completed", arm=args.arm, samples=len(dataset),
                               checkpoints=args.checkpoint, summary=summary))
    print(summary, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--arm", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--samples", type=int, default=20)
    diagnose(parser.parse_args())

"""Measure RLNN inference on the two published RB200-300 MIS groups."""

import csv
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from functools import partial
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter

import torch

from main import build_parser, set_seed
from solvers import RLNN


GROUP_SIZE = 500


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate(solver, result_dir, decoder):
    solver.model.eval()
    evaluate_graph = solver.evaluate_single
    if decoder == "gradient_flip":
        evaluate_graph = partial(evaluate_graph, decode=solver.problem.decode_gradient_flip)
    device = solver.accelerator.device
    groups = []
    with (result_dir / "per_graph.csv").open("w", newline="") as stream:
        writer = csv.writer(stream)
        writer.writerow(["group", "graph_id", "independent_set_size", "solve_time_s"])
        sizes = []
        seconds = []
        for index, (graph,) in enumerate(solver.test_loader):
            torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
            start = perf_counter()
            raw_size = evaluate_graph(graph)
            torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
            elapsed = perf_counter() - start
            size = -int(raw_size.item())
            sizes.append(size)
            seconds.append(elapsed)
            group = index // GROUP_SIZE + 1
            writer.writerow([group, f"idx_{index}", size, f"{elapsed:.9f}"])

            if len(sizes) % 100 == 0:
                stream.flush()
                print(f"group {group}: {len(sizes)}/{GROUP_SIZE}, "
                      f"SIZE {sum(sizes) / len(sizes):.3f}, TIME {sum(seconds):.2f}s", flush=True)
            if len(sizes) == GROUP_SIZE:
                groups.append((sum(sizes) / GROUP_SIZE, sum(seconds)))
                sizes.clear()
                seconds.clear()
    return groups


def main():
    parser = build_parser()
    parser.set_defaults(method="RLNN", problem="mis", loss="erdoes", num_t=100,
                        num_k=20, num_l=5, num_h=128, mixed_precision="fp16")
    parser.add_argument("--result_dir", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--decoder", choices=["greedy", "gradient_flip"], default="greedy")
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint_epoch", type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint_source")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.decoder == "gradient_flip" and (args.problem != "mis" or args.skip_decode):
        parser.error("gradient_flip requires MIS with decoding enabled")
    set_seed(args.seed)
    solver = RLNN(args)
    dataset = solver.test_loader.dataset
    expected = [f"idx_{index}.gpickle" for index in range(2 * GROUP_SIZE)]
    by_name = {Path(file).name: file for file in dataset.files}
    if set(by_name) != set(expected):
        parser.error("test_path must contain the author files idx_0.gpickle through idx_999.gpickle")
    dataset.files = [by_name[name] for name in expected]
    solver.prepare()
    if solver.accelerator.device.type != "cuda" or solver.accelerator.num_processes != 1:
        parser.error("this benchmark requires one CUDA process")

    result_dir = args.result_dir
    result_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    start_time = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    groups = evaluate(solver, result_dir, args.decoder)
    (group1_size, group1_time), (group2_size, group2_time) = groups
    (result_dir / "metrics").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with (result_dir / "metrics/metrics.csv").open("w", newline="") as stream:
        writer = csv.writer(stream)
        writer.writerow(["epoch", "group1/independent_set_size", "group1/total_time_s",
                         "group2/independent_set_size", "group2/total_time_s",
                         "test/independent_set_size", "test/total_time_s"])
        writer.writerow([args.checkpoint_epoch, group1_size, group1_time, group2_size, group2_time,
                         (group1_size + group2_size) / 2, (group1_time + group2_time) / 2])

    metadata = {
        "version": result_dir.parent.name,
        "run": result_dir.name,
        "task": "MIS",
        "dataset": "RLD4CO author RB200-300",
        "kind": "single_gpu",
        "mode": "eval",
        "status": "completed",
        "seed": args.seed,
        "started_at": start_time,
        "finished_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "config": {
            **vars(args),
            "result_dir": str(result_dir),
            "test_samples": 1000,
            "groups": ["idx_0–499", "idx_500–999"],
        },
        "device": {
            "name": torch.cuda.get_device_name(solver.accelerator.device),
            "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"),
            "torch": torch.__version__,
            "cuda": torch.version.cuda,
            "allocator_backend": torch.cuda.get_allocator_backend(),
            "cpu_threads": torch.get_num_threads(),
        },
        "measurement": (
            f"One graph at a time. Wall clock around sampling and {args.decoder} decoding, "
            "with CUDA synchronization on both sides. Includes the first graph; excludes "
            "data loading, host-to-device transfer and model startup. SIZE is the mean "
            "cardinality per graph. TIME is the mean of the two 500-graph solver totals."
        ),
        "reference": {
            "paper": "https://arxiv.org/pdf/2502.00277#page=7",
            "table": "Table 1, MIS RB-[200–300], RLNN (UL)",
            "gpu": "NVIDIA RTX A6000",
            "independent_set_size": 19.52,
            "total_time_minutes": 1.64,
            "data": (
                "https://huggingface.co/datasets/shengyuf/RLD4CO/tree/"
                "f273683b3fe6faa217de35ead96fbe0ee4a44a4a/MIS/RB_small_test"
            ),
        },
    }
    (result_dir / "run.json").write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


========================================================================
FILE: models/eval_v1.py

"""Score solver outputs on the same ordered RLD4CO MIS graphs."""
import csv
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean
from time import perf_counter

import torch

from problems.mis import Dataset


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
TEST = ROOT / "models/data/author_rld4co/MIS/RB_small_test"


def ordered_dataset(args, dtype):
    dataset = Dataset(args.test_path, dtype)
    files = {Path(name).stem: name for name in dataset.files}
    count = 1000 if args.test_samples < 0 else args.test_samples
    dataset.files = [files[f"idx_{i}"] for i in range(count)]
    return dataset


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate(args, solve, device, params, *, dtype=torch.float32):
    dataset = ordered_dataset(args, dtype)
    result = Path(args.result_dir)
    result.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fields = ["graph_id", "group", "independent_set_size", "solve_time_s", "conflicts",
              "extra_candidates", "archive_seconds", "archive_gain", "archive_gap", "baseline_archive_gap",
              "selected_nodes"]
    rows = []
    started = perf_counter()
    started_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    if device.type == "cuda":
        torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats(device)
    with (result / "per_graph.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=fields)
        writer.writeheader()
        for index in range(len(dataset)):
            graph = dataset[index].to(device)
            generator = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(args.seed + index)
            if device.type == "cuda":
                torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
            start = perf_counter()
            solution, details = solve(graph, generator, index)
            if device.type == "cuda":
                torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
            seconds = perf_counter() - start
            u, v = graph.edge_index
            mask = solution.bool()
            row = dict(graph_id=f"idx_{index}", group=index // 500 + 1,
                       independent_set_size=int(mask.sum()), solve_time_s=seconds,
                       conflicts=int((mask[u] & mask[v]).sum()) // 2,
                       selected_nodes=" ".join(map(str, mask.nonzero().flatten().tolist())), **details)
            writer.writerow(row)
            rows.append(row)
            if (index + 1) % 100 == 0:
                stream.flush()
                print(f"{index + 1}/{len(dataset)} graphs, mean size {mean(r['independent_set_size'] for r in rows):.3f}", flush=True)
    metadata = dict(
        version="v1", status="completed", mode="eval", run=result.name, method=args.label,
        train_seed=args.train_seed, search_seed=args.seed, samples=len(rows), config=vars(args),
        started_at=started_at, finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        wall_time_s=perf_counter() - started,
        device=torch.cuda.get_device_name(device) if device.type == "cuda" else "CPU",
        gpu=os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"), params=params,
        peak_memory_mib=torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(device) / 2**20 if device.type == "cuda" else 0,
        mean_size=mean(row["independent_set_size"] for row in rows),
        mean_solve_time_s=mean(row["solve_time_s"] for row in rows),
        feasible_rate=mean(row["conflicts"] == 0 for row in rows),
        measurement="Single graph. Synchronized wall time includes solver setup, search and decoding. Graph loading, transfer and solution verification are outside the timer.",
    )
    (result / "run.json").write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2, default=str) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({key: metadata[key] for key in ("mean_size", "mean_solve_time_s", "feasible_rate", "params", "peak_memory_mib")}), flush=True)


def add_evaluation_arguments(parser):
    parser.add_argument("--label", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--result_dir", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--train_seed", type=int, default=0)
    return parser


def main():
    from main import build_parser, set_seed
    from mis_baselines import gurobi, isco, kamis, minimum_degree
    from mis_v1 import FlipValue, search
    from problems.mis import Problem
    from solvers import RLNN, RLSA

    parser = add_evaluation_arguments(build_parser())
    parser.set_defaults(method="RLNN", test_path=str(TEST), mixed_precision="fp16",
                        num_k=20, num_t=100, num_l=5, num_h=128, num_d=5, num_workers=0)
    parser.add_argument("--archive", choices=["off", "quality", "energy"], default="off")
    parser.add_argument("--archive_probes", type=int, default=5)
    parser.add_argument("--archive_candidates", type=int, default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--value_checkpoint", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--value_energy", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--value_weight", type=float, default=0.5)
    parser.add_argument("--time_budget_s", type=float)
    parser.add_argument("--diagnostic", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--kamis", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--cpu_time_limit", type=float, default=1.0)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    set_seed(args.seed)
    params = 0
    env = None
    if args.method == "RLNN":
        solver = RLNN(args)
        solver.prepare()
        solver.model.eval()
        device, dtype = solver.accelerator.device, solver.dtype
        params = sum(p.numel() for p in solver.model.parameters())
        value = "energy" if args.value_energy else None
        if args.value_checkpoint:
            value = FlipValue().to(device).eval()
            value.load_state_dict(torch.load(args.value_checkpoint, map_location=device, weights_only=True))
            params += sum(p.numel() for p in value.parameters())

        def solve(graph, generator, index):
            return search(solver, graph, generator, archive=args.archive, probes=args.archive_probes,
                          candidates=args.archive_candidates, value=value, value_weight=args.value_weight,
                          time_budget=args.time_budget_s, diagnostic=args.diagnostic)
    elif args.method == "RLSA":
        solver = RLSA(args)
        device, dtype = solver.accelerator.device, solver.dtype

        def solve(graph, generator, index):
            return solver.evaluate_single(graph, return_solution=True, generator=generator), {}
    elif args.method == "iSCO":
        device, dtype = torch.device("cuda"), torch.float32
        problem = Problem(args.beta)

        def solve(graph, generator, index):
            return isco(problem, graph, generator, args.num_t, args.num_k, args.num_d, args.tau0), {}
    else:
        device, dtype = torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32
        if args.method == "Greedy":
            def solve(graph, generator, index):
                return minimum_degree(graph), {}
        elif args.method == "KaMIS":
            if args.kamis is None:
                parser.error("--kamis must point to redumis")

            def solve(graph, generator, index):
                return kamis(graph, args.kamis.resolve(), args.seed + index, args.cpu_time_limit), {}
        elif args.method == "Gurobi":
            import gurobipy as gp
            env = gp.Env(empty=True)
            env.setParam("OutputFlag", 0)
            env.start()

            def solve(graph, generator, index):
                return gurobi(graph, env, args.seed + index, args.cpu_time_limit), {}
        else:
            parser.error(f"unknown method {args.method}")

    try:
        evaluate(args, solve, device, params, dtype=dtype)
    finally:
        if env is not None:
            env.dispose()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Evaluate RLNN/SEGF and post-decode exchange policies on the same RB graphs."""
import csv
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
from statistics import mean
from time import perf_counter

import torch

from main import build_parser, set_seed
from mis_v1 import adjacency, best_decoded
from mis_v2_exchange import ExchangeGraph, action_values, improve, node_mask, nodes
from mis_v2_value import PAVE
from problems.mis import Dataset
from solvers import RLNN


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
VALID = ROOT / "models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_val"
TRAIN = ROOT / "models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_train"
TEST = ROOT / "models/data/author_rld4co/MIS/RB_small_test"
TEST_CACHE = ROOT / "models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_author_test"
POLICIES = ("none", "rule", "heuristic", "random", "pave", "rule23")


def policy_parser():
    parser = build_parser()
    parser.set_defaults(method="RLNN", test_path=None, mixed_precision="fp16", seed=1017,
                        num_k=20, num_t=100, num_l=5, num_h=128, num_d=5, num_workers=0)
    parser.add_argument("--split", choices=("validation", "test"), default="test")
    parser.add_argument("--result_dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--train_seed", type=int, default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--candidate_cap", type=int, default=48)
    parser.add_argument("--exchange_rounds", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--larger", action="store_true", help="try 2-to-3 when no 1-to-2 action exists")
    return parser


def dataset_at(path, dtype, count=-1, *, official=False):
    dataset = Dataset(path, dtype)
    if official:
        if dataset.tensor_cache:
            entries = json.loads((Path(path) / "tensor_manifest.json").read_text())["graphs"]
            by_id = {Path(entry["source"]).stem: str(Path(path) / entry["tensor"]) for entry in entries}
        else:
            by_id = {Path(file).stem: file for file in dataset.files}
        dataset.files = [by_id[f"idx_{index}"] for index in range(len(dataset) if count < 0 else count)]
    elif count > 0:
        dataset.files = dataset.files[:count]
    return dataset


def load_policy(args):
    if args.test_path is None:
        if args.split == "validation":
            args.test_path = str(VALID)
        else:
            args.test_path = str(TEST_CACHE if (TEST_CACHE / "tensor_manifest.json").is_file() else TEST)
    set_seed(args.seed)
    solver = RLNN(args)
    solver.prepare()
    solver.model.eval()
    return solver


def sync(device):
    if device.type == "cuda":
        torch.cuda.synchronize(device)


def search(solver, graph, cpu_graph, seed, *, deadline=None, observe=None):
    """Keep the original per-trajectory energy record and A.3 decoder."""
    device = graph.b.device
    generator = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(seed)
    adj = adjacency(graph)
    topology = solver.policy_topology(graph, adj)
    problem = solver.problem
    if getattr(solver, "cuda_graph_search", False):
        from capture_mis import captured_states
        states = captured_states(solver, graph, adj, topology, generator)
    elif getattr(solver, "v6_frequency", False):
        states = solver.sample_states(graph, adj, generator=generator, normalized=topology, with_energy=True)
    else:
        states = ((x, problem.energy_func(adj, graph.b, x)[0])
                  for x in solver.sample_states(graph, adj, generator=generator, normalized=topology))
    best_states, best_energy = next(states)
    incumbent = 0
    chunk_time = 0.0
    chunk_start = perf_counter()

    def decode():
        selected = best_decoded(problem, best_states, adj, graph.b)
        mask = node_mask(selected.nonzero().flatten().tolist())
        if not cpu_graph.feasible(mask):
            raise ValueError("A.3 returned a conflicting independent set")
        return mask

    if deadline is not None:
        first = decode()
        if perf_counter() < deadline:
            incumbent = first
    if observe is not None:
        observe(0, best_states, best_states, adj, topology)
    steps = 0
    for step in range(1, solver.num_t + 1):
        if deadline is not None and perf_counter() + chunk_time >= deadline:
            break
        state, energy = next(states)
        improves = energy < best_energy
        best_states = torch.where(improves.unsqueeze(0), state, best_states)
        best_energy = torch.where(improves, energy, best_energy)
        steps = step
        if observe is not None:
            observe(step, state, best_states, adj, topology)
        if deadline is not None and (step % 10 == 0 or step == solver.num_t):
            candidate = decode()
            now = perf_counter()
            if now >= deadline:
                break
            if candidate.bit_count() > incumbent.bit_count():
                incumbent = candidate
            chunk_time = now - chunk_start
            chunk_start = now
    return (decode() if deadline is None else incumbent), steps


def write_run(result, metadata):
    path = result / "run.json"
    tmp = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    tmp.replace(path)


def diagnose_actions(graph, selected, cap, rounds):
    row = {}
    for name, larger in (("one_to_two", False), ("fallback", True)):
        all_actions = graph.actions(selected, larger=larger)
        actions = all_actions[:cap]
        values = action_values(graph, selected, actions, cap=cap, rounds=rounds, larger=larger)
        counts = {value: values.count(value) for value in set(values)}
        ties = sum(count * (count - 1) // 2 for count in counts.values())
        row[f"{name}_actions"] = len(all_actions)
        row[f"{name}_pairs"] = len(actions) * (len(actions) - 1) // 2
        row[f"{name}_ties"] = ties
        row[f"{name}_spread"] = max(values) - min(values) if values else 0
        row[f"{name}_oracle_gain"] = max(values, default=selected.bit_count()) - selected.bit_count()
    return row


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate(args):
    solver = load_policy(args)
    device = solver.accelerator.device
    dataset = dataset_at(args.test_path, solver.dtype, args.test_samples, official=args.split == "test")
    policy_names = list(dict.fromkeys(args.post))
    if args.opportunities and "none" not in policy_names:
        raise ValueError("Opportunity diagnosis needs the original decoded solution")
    if args.time_budget_s is not None and (args.opportunities or len(policy_names) != 1):
        raise ValueError("Fixed-time runs take one post policy and no opportunity diagnosis")
    ranker = None
    if "pave" in policy_names:
        if not args.value_checkpoint:
            raise ValueError("PAVE evaluation requires --value_checkpoint")
        ranker = PAVE().eval()
        ranker.load_state_dict(torch.load(args.value_checkpoint, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True))
    model_params = sum(parameter.numel() for parameter in solver.model.parameters())
    args.result_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    started_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    started = perf_counter()
    warm = dataset[0]
    cpu_warm = ExchangeGraph(warm.num_nodes, warm.edge_index)
    search(solver, warm.to(device), cpu_warm, args.seed)
    sync(device)
    if device.type == "cuda":
        torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats(device)
    records = {name: [] for name in policy_names}
    opportunities = []
    for index, graph in enumerate(dataset):
        graph_id = f"idx_{index}" if args.split == "test" else Path(dataset.files[index]).stem
        edges = graph.edge_index
        graph = graph.to(device)
        sync(device)
        tick = perf_counter()
        deadline = tick + args.time_budget_s if args.time_budget_s is not None else None
        cutoff = deadline
        if deadline is not None and policy_names[0] != "none":
            cutoff -= args.exchange_reserve_s
        cpu_graph = ExchangeGraph(graph.num_nodes, edges)
        selected, steps = search(solver, graph, cpu_graph, args.seed + index, deadline=cutoff)
        sync(device)
        search_time = perf_counter() - tick
        for name in policy_names:
            post_start = perf_counter()
            choose = None
            if name == "pave":
                choose = ranker.choose
            elif name == "rule" or name == "rule23":
                choose = lambda graph, selected, actions: actions[0]
            elif name == "random":
                rng = random.Random(args.seed + index)
                choose = lambda graph, selected, actions: rng.choice(actions)
            final, exchanges, candidate_count = selected, 0, 0
            if name != "none":
                final, exchanges, candidate_count = improve(
                    cpu_graph, selected, cap=args.candidate_cap, rounds=args.exchange_rounds,
                    larger=name == "rule23" or (args.larger and name not in ("none", "rule")),
                    deadline=deadline if deadline is not None else float("inf"), choose=choose,
                    repeat_choice=name != "pave")
            extra_time = perf_counter() - post_start if name != "none" else 0.0
            size = final.bit_count()
            seconds = (perf_counter() - tick) if deadline is not None else search_time + extra_time
            records[name].append(dict(graph_id=graph_id, group=index // 500 + 1,
                                      independent_set_size=size, solve_time_s=seconds,
                                      conflicts=0, search_steps=steps, base_size=selected.bit_count(),
                                      exchanges=exchanges, exchange_candidates=candidate_count,
                                      exchange_time_s=extra_time, selected_nodes=" ".join(map(str, nodes(final)))))
        if args.opportunities:
            opportunities.append(dict(graph_id=graph_id, base_size=selected.bit_count(),
                                      **diagnose_actions(cpu_graph, selected, args.candidate_cap, args.exchange_rounds)))
        if (index + 1) % 25 == 0 or index + 1 == len(dataset):
            scores = ", ".join(f"{name}={mean(row['independent_set_size'] for row in rows):.3f}"
                               for name, rows in records.items())
            print(f"{index + 1}/{len(dataset)} graphs: {scores}", flush=True)
    for name, rows in records.items():
        result = args.result_dir / name
        result.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        with (result / "per_graph.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(rows)
        metadata = dict(
            version="v2", status="completed", mode="eval", run=result.parent.name + "/" + name,
            method=args.label, post=name, train_seed=args.train_seed, search_seed=args.seed,
            split=args.split, samples=len(rows), config=vars(args), started_at=started_at,
            finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), wall_time_s=perf_counter() - started,
            device=torch.cuda.get_device_name(device) if device.type == "cuda" else "CPU",
            gpu=os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"),
            params=model_params + (sum(p.numel() for p in ranker.parameters()) if name == "pave" else 0),
            peak_memory_mib=torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(device) / 2**20 if device.type == "cuda" else 0,
            mean_size=mean(row["independent_set_size"] for row in rows),
            mean_solve_time_s=mean(row["solve_time_s"] for row in rows), feasible_rate=1.0,
            group_times_s=[sum(row["solve_time_s"] for row in rows if row["group"] == group)
                           for group in sorted({row["group"] for row in rows})],
            exchange_gain=mean(row["independent_set_size"] - row["base_size"] for row in rows),
            deadline_overruns=sum(row["solve_time_s"] > args.time_budget_s for row in rows)
            if args.time_budget_s is not None else 0,
        )
        write_run(result, metadata)
    if opportunities:
        with (args.result_dir / "opportunities.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(opportunities[0]))
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(opportunities)
        summary = {"graphs": len(opportunities)}
        for name in ("one_to_two", "fallback"):
            summary[name] = dict(
                available=sum(row[f"{name}_actions"] > 0 for row in opportunities),
                informative=sum(row[f"{name}_spread"] > 0 for row in opportunities),
                mean_actions=mean(row[f"{name}_actions"] for row in opportunities),
                mean_oracle_gain=mean(row[f"{name}_oracle_gain"] for row in opportunities),
                pairs=sum(row[f"{name}_pairs"] for row in opportunities),
                ties=sum(row[f"{name}_ties"] for row in opportunities),
            )
        write_run(args.result_dir, dict(version="v2", mode="opportunities", status="completed", **summary))


def main():
    parser = policy_parser()
    parser.add_argument("--label", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--post", choices=POLICIES, nargs="+", default=["none"])
    parser.add_argument("--value_checkpoint", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--time_budget_s", type=float)
    parser.add_argument("--exchange_reserve_s", type=float, default=0.02)
    parser.add_argument("--opportunities", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    evaluate(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
