"""Finite plateau search and paired continuation values on legal MIS solutions."""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from itertools import chain, islice
from math import inf, isfinite, log1p
import random
from time import perf_counter

from mis_v2_exchange import Exchange, ExchangeGraph, node_mask, nodes


STATS_NAMES = (
    "removed_log_degree", "added_log_degree", "removed_count", "added_tightness",
    "removed_log_r1", "removed_log_r2", "added_log_r1", "added_log_r2",
    "log_release_count", "log_release_compatible_pairs", "log_covered",
    "log_shared_coverage", "added_log_outside_degree", "removed_log_outside_degree",
    "log_pairs_before", "log_pairs_after", "new_zero_tight", "lost_zero_tight",
    "new_one_tight", "lost_one_tight", "new_two_tight", "lost_two_tight",
    "selected_fraction", "remaining_fraction",
)
STATS_DIM = len(STATS_NAMES)


def reverse(action):
    return action.added, action.removed


@dataclass
class CandidatePool:
    actions: list
    total_count: int
    completed: bool = True

    @property
    def exact(self):
        return self.completed


@dataclass
class RepairResult:
    work: int
    exchanges: int = 0
    capped: bool = False
    exhausted: bool = False
    deadline_hit: bool = False
    candidate_counts: list = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass
class RolloutResult:
    work: int
    best: int
    gain: int
    neutral_actions: tuple = ()
    attempted_actions: tuple = ()
    exchanges: int = 0
    segments: int = 0
    returned_to_start: bool = False
    ended_below_start: bool = False
    rolled_back: bool = False
    deadline_hit: bool = False
    capped: bool = False


@dataclass
class SearchResult:
    work: int
    best: int
    history: tuple
    base_size: int
    rule_size: int
    exchanges: int = 0
    neutral_decisions: int = 0
    outer_steps: int = 0
    deadline_hit: bool = False
    trace: list = field(default_factory=list)


class SearchGraph(ExchangeGraph):
    """Bitset topology with one fixed node priority for all candidate branches."""

    def __init__(self, num_nodes, edge_index, seed=0):
        super().__init__(num_nodes, edge_index)
        self.num_nodes = num_nodes
        self.edge_index = edge_index
        self.seed = seed
        priority = list(range(num_nodes))
        random.Random(seed).shuffle(priority)
        self.priority = [0] * num_nodes
        for rank, node in enumerate(priority):
            self.priority[node] = rank

    def compatible_pairs(self, mask):
        count = 0
        while mask:
            bit = mask & -mask
            mask ^= bit
            count += (mask & ~self.neighbors[bit.bit_length() - 1]).bit_count()
        return count

    def state_structure(self, selected):
        tightness = [(adj & selected).bit_count() for adj in self.neighbors]
        masks = [0, 0, 0]
        for node in nodes(self.all_nodes ^ selected):
            count = tightness[node]
            if count < 3:
                masks[count] |= 1 << node
        r1 = [(adj & masks[1]).bit_count() for adj in self.neighbors]
        r2 = [(adj & masks[2]).bit_count() for adj in self.neighbors]
        pairs = [self.compatible_pairs(self.neighbors[i] & masks[1])
                 if selected & (1 << i) else 0 for i in range(self.num_nodes)]
        return tightness, masks, r1, r2, pairs

    def node_features(self, selected):
        tightness, _, r1, r2, pairs = self.state_structure(selected)
        return [[float(bool(selected & (1 << i))), min(tightness[i], 3) / 3,
                 self.log_degree[i], float(not selected & (1 << i) and tightness[i] == 1),
                 float(not selected & (1 << i) and tightness[i] == 2),
                 log1p(r1[i]), log1p(r2[i]), log1p(pairs[i])]
                for i in range(self.num_nodes)]

    def affected_nodes(self, action):
        affected = 0
        for node in action.removed + action.added:
            affected |= self.neighbors[node]
        return list(nodes(affected))

    def priority_key(self, action):
        return tuple(self.priority[i] for i in action.added + action.removed)

    def heuristic_key(self, selected, action):
        return (*self.heuristic(selected, action), self.priority_key(action))

    def apply_move(self, selected, action):
        candidate = (selected & ~node_mask(action.removed)) | node_mask(action.added)
        if not self.feasible(candidate):
            raise ValueError("Move must preserve independence")
        return candidate

    def stats_features(self, selected, actions, remaining=1.0):
        tight, masks, r1, r2, pairs = self.state_structure(selected)
        outside = self.all_nodes ^ selected
        levels = [0] * (3 + max((len(action.removed) for action in actions), default=0))
        for node, count in enumerate(tight):
            if count < len(levels):
                levels[count] |= 1 << node
        log_pairs_before = log1p(sum(pairs))
        selected_fraction = selected.bit_count() / self.num_nodes
        rows = []
        for action in actions:
            successor = self.apply_move(selected, action)
            removed = node_mask(action.removed)
            removed_neighbors = 0
            after_levels = levels
            for node in action.removed:
                adjacent = self.neighbors[node]
                removed_neighbors |= adjacent
                after_levels = [(same & ~adjacent) | (higher & adjacent)
                                for same, higher in zip(after_levels, after_levels[1:])]
            after_levels = after_levels[:3]
            added_neighbors = 0
            for node in action.added:
                adjacent = self.neighbors[node]
                added_neighbors |= adjacent
                zero, one, two = after_levels
                after_levels = [zero & ~adjacent,
                                (one & ~adjacent) | (zero & adjacent),
                                (two & ~adjacent) | (one & adjacent)]
            after_masks = [mask & ~successor for mask in after_levels]
            after_pairs = sum(self.compatible_pairs(self.neighbors[node] & after_masks[1])
                              for node in nodes(successor))
            released = removed_neighbors & outside
            for node in nodes(selected & ~removed):
                released &= ~self.neighbors[node]
            removed_cover = removed_neighbors & outside
            added_cover = added_neighbors & outside & ~node_mask(action.added)
            row = [sum(self.log_degree[i] for i in action.removed),
                   sum(self.log_degree[i] for i in action.added), len(action.removed),
                   sum(tight[i] for i in action.added),
                   sum(log1p(r1[i]) for i in action.removed),
                   sum(log1p(r2[i]) for i in action.removed),
                   sum(log1p(r1[i]) for i in action.added),
                   sum(log1p(r2[i]) for i in action.added),
                   log1p(released.bit_count()), log1p(self.compatible_pairs(released)),
                   log1p(added_cover.bit_count()), log1p((removed_cover & added_cover).bit_count()),
                   sum(log1p((self.neighbors[i] & outside).bit_count()) for i in action.added),
                   sum(log1p((self.neighbors[i] & outside).bit_count()) for i in action.removed),
                   log_pairs_before, log1p(after_pairs)]
            for before, after in zip(masks, after_masks):
                row.extend(((after & ~before).bit_count(), (before & ~after).bit_count()))
            row.extend((selected_fraction, float(remaining)))
            rows.append(row)
        return rows


def candidate_actions(graph, selected, *, cap=32, anchored=False, tabu=(), deadline=inf):
    """Root history contains executed moves; only their exact reverse is excluded."""
    forbidden = {reverse(action) for action in tabu}
    outside = graph.all_nodes ^ selected
    blockers = [(node, graph.neighbors[node] & selected) for node in nodes(outside)]
    actions = []
    complete = True
    for node, blocked in blockers:
        if perf_counter() >= deadline:
            complete = False
            break
        count = blocked.bit_count()
        if count != 1 and not (anchored and count == 2):
            continue
        removed = tuple(nodes(blocked))
        if (removed, (node,)) in forbidden:
            continue
        released = sum(bool(mask and not mask & ~blocked) for _, mask in blockers)
        actions.append(Exchange(removed, (node,), released))
    total = len(actions)
    if cap is not None and total > cap:
        ordered = sorted(actions, key=lambda action: graph.heuristic_key(selected, action))
        first = (cap + 1) // 2
        actions = ordered[:first] + sorted(ordered[first:], key=graph.priority_key)[:cap - first]
    return CandidatePool(actions, total, complete)


def improving_actions(graph, selected, *, cap=48, union=False, anchor=None, deadline=inf):
    def allowed(size):
        for action in graph._exchanges(selected, size, deadline):
            if anchor is None or anchor not in action.removed:
                yield action

    if union:
        return list(islice(chain(allowed(1), allowed(2)), cap))
    actions = list(islice(allowed(1), cap))
    return actions if actions else list(islice(allowed(2), cap))


def choose_action(graph, selected, actions, rule="coverage", remaining=1.0):
    if rule in ("coverage", "heuristic"):
        return min(actions, key=lambda action: graph.heuristic_key(selected, action))
    if rule == "degree":
        return min(actions, key=lambda action: (sum(graph.log_degree[i] for i in action.added),
                   -sum(graph.log_degree[i] for i in action.removed), graph.priority_key(action)))
    if rule == "random":
        return min(actions, key=graph.priority_key)
    if rule in ("rule", "canonical"):
        return actions[0]
    raise ValueError(f"Unknown selection rule: {rule}")


def repair(graph, selected, *, rounds=4, cap=48, anchor=None, deadline=inf, extend_first=True):
    result = RepairResult(selected)
    if perf_counter() >= deadline:
        result.deadline_hit = True
        return result
    if extend_first:
        candidate = graph.extend(selected)
        if perf_counter() >= deadline:
            result.deadline_hit = True
            return result
        result.work = candidate
    for _ in range(rounds):
        actions = improving_actions(graph, result.work, cap=cap, anchor=anchor, deadline=deadline)
        result.candidate_counts.append(len(actions))
        if perf_counter() >= deadline:
            result.deadline_hit = True
            return result
        if not actions:
            result.exhausted = True
            return result
        candidate = graph.apply(result.work, actions[0])
        if perf_counter() >= deadline:
            result.deadline_hit = True
            return result
        result.work = candidate
        result.exchanges += 1
    result.capped = True
    return result


def rollout(graph, selected, action, *, horizon=2, repair_rounds=4,
            improving_cap=48, candidate_cap=32, deadline=inf):
    """The same finite macro is used for labels and deployment; history is local."""
    if horizon not in (1, 2):
        raise ValueError("horizon must be 1 or 2")
    result = RolloutResult(selected, selected, 0)
    attempted = []
    if perf_counter() >= deadline:
        result.deadline_hit = True
        return result
    work = graph.apply_move(selected, action)
    if perf_counter() >= deadline:
        result.deadline_hit = True
        return result
    attempted.append(action)
    anchor = action.added[0] if len(action.removed) == 2 else None
    for stage in range(horizon):
        if stage:
            strict = improving_actions(graph, work, cap=1, deadline=deadline)
            if perf_counter() >= deadline:
                result.deadline_hit = True
                break
            if not strict:
                pool = candidate_actions(graph, work, cap=candidate_cap, tabu=(action,), deadline=deadline)
                if not pool.completed or perf_counter() >= deadline:
                    result.deadline_hit = True
                    break
                if not pool.actions:
                    break
                second = choose_action(graph, work, pool.actions)
                candidate = graph.apply_move(work, second)
                if perf_counter() >= deadline:
                    result.deadline_hit = True
                    break
                work = candidate
                attempted.append(second)
        segment = repair(graph, work, rounds=repair_rounds, cap=improving_cap,
                         anchor=anchor if stage == 0 else None, deadline=deadline)
        work = segment.work
        result.segments += 1
        result.exchanges += segment.exchanges
        result.capped |= segment.capped
        if work.bit_count() > result.best.bit_count():
            result.best = work
        if segment.deadline_hit:
            result.deadline_hit = True
            break
    result.ended_below_start = work.bit_count() < selected.bit_count()
    result.rolled_back = work.bit_count() < result.best.bit_count()
    result.work = result.best if result.rolled_back else work
    result.returned_to_start = result.work == selected
    result.attempted_actions = tuple(attempted)
    result.neutral_actions = () if result.rolled_back else tuple(attempted)
    result.gain = result.best.bit_count() - selected.bit_count()
    return result


def action_values(graph, selected, actions, *, return_rollouts=False, **kwargs):
    results = [rollout(graph, selected, action, **kwargs) for action in actions]
    values = [result.gain for result in results]
    return (values, results) if return_rollouts else values


def platform_search(graph, selected, *, choose="coverage", outer_rounds=8, initial_rounds=3,
                    horizon=2, candidate_cap=32, improving_cap=48, repair_rounds=4,
                    anchored=False, history=(), deadline=inf, on_state=None):
    """Initial v2 rule23, then at most outer_rounds rule or neutral macro rounds.

    A scorer has signature choose(graph, selected, actions, remaining_fraction).
    on_state(graph, selected, pool, history, outer_index, remaining_fraction)
    observes decision states before selection without changing search state.
    """
    limited = isfinite(deadline)
    work_deadline = deadline - 0.002 if limited else deadline
    initial_start = perf_counter() if limited else 0.0
    initial = repair(graph, selected, rounds=initial_rounds, cap=improving_cap,
                     deadline=work_deadline, extend_first=False) if initial_rounds else RepairResult(selected)
    initial_seconds = perf_counter() - initial_start if limited else 0.0
    round_seconds, score_units = [], []
    macro_seconds = [max(0.002, initial_seconds * horizon)]
    result = SearchResult(initial.work, initial.work, tuple(history)[-2:], selected.bit_count(),
                          initial.work.bit_count(), exchanges=initial.exchanges,
                          deadline_hit=initial.deadline_hit)
    for step in range(outer_rounds):
        if result.deadline_hit or perf_counter() >= work_deadline:
            result.deadline_hit = True
            break
        round_start = perf_counter() if limited else 0.0
        strict = improving_actions(graph, result.work, cap=1, deadline=work_deadline)
        if perf_counter() >= work_deadline:
            result.deadline_hit = True
            break
        before = result.work
        remaining = (outer_rounds - step) / outer_rounds
        if strict:
            segment = repair(graph, before, rounds=repair_rounds, cap=improving_cap, deadline=work_deadline)
            result.work = segment.work
            result.exchanges += segment.exchanges
            result.deadline_hit = segment.deadline_hit
            row = dict(kind="repair", exchanges=segment.exchanges, capped=segment.capped)
        else:
            if limited:
                predicted_round = 1.25 * max(round_seconds[-2:]) if round_seconds else 0.003
                if perf_counter() + predicted_round >= work_deadline:
                    result.deadline_hit = True
                    break
            pool = candidate_actions(graph, before, cap=candidate_cap, anchored=anchored,
                                     tabu=result.history, deadline=work_deadline)
            if not pool.completed or perf_counter() >= work_deadline:
                result.deadline_hit = True
                break
            if on_state is not None:
                on_state(graph, before, pool, result.history, step, remaining)
            if not pool.actions:
                break
            if limited:
                count = len(pool.actions)
                if callable(choose) and count > 1:
                    unit = max(score_units[-2:]) if score_units else 0.0006 * graph.num_nodes / 250
                    predicted_score = unit * count
                else:
                    predicted_score = 0.0005 if callable(choose) else 0.0001
                predicted_macro = max(macro_seconds[-2:])
                if perf_counter() + 1.25 * (predicted_score + predicted_macro) >= work_deadline:
                    result.deadline_hit = True
                    break
                score_start = perf_counter()
            action = (choose(graph, before, pool.actions, remaining) if callable(choose)
                      else choose_action(graph, before, pool.actions, choose))
            if limited:
                actual_score = perf_counter() - score_start
                if callable(choose) and count > 1:
                    score_units.append(actual_score / count)
                if perf_counter() + 1.25 * predicted_macro >= work_deadline:
                    result.deadline_hit = True
                    break
                macro_start = perf_counter()
            macro = rollout(graph, before, action, horizon=horizon, repair_rounds=repair_rounds,
                            improving_cap=improving_cap, candidate_cap=candidate_cap, deadline=work_deadline)
            result.work = macro.work
            result.history = (result.history + macro.neutral_actions)[-2:]
            result.exchanges += macro.exchanges
            result.neutral_decisions += len(macro.attempted_actions)
            result.deadline_hit = macro.deadline_hit
            row = dict(kind="neutral", candidate_count=len(pool.actions), total_count=pool.total_count,
                       exchanges=macro.exchanges, neutral_steps=len(macro.attempted_actions),
                       returned_to_start=macro.returned_to_start, rolled_back=macro.rolled_back,
                       ended_below_start=macro.ended_below_start, gain=macro.gain, capped=macro.capped)
            if limited:
                actual_macro = perf_counter() - macro_start
                actual_round = perf_counter() - round_start
                macro_seconds.append(actual_macro)
                round_seconds.append(actual_round)
                row.update(round_time_s=actual_round, score_time_s=actual_score,
                           predicted_score_time_s=predicted_score, rollout_time_s=actual_macro)
            if macro.best.bit_count() > result.best.bit_count():
                result.best = macro.best
        if result.work.bit_count() > result.best.bit_count():
            result.best = result.work
        result.outer_steps += 1
        row.update(outer=step, before_size=before.bit_count(), after_size=result.work.bit_count())
        result.trace.append(row)
    return result

FILE: models/mis_v3_value.py

"""Statewise action scoring for legal MIS plateau search."""
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from torch import nn


STATS_DIM = 24
MODES = ("stats", "message", "frequency")


def build_state(graph, selected, actions, remaining=1.0, *, include_nodes=False):
    """Encode one candidate pool without executing its continuation."""
    state = {
        "stats": torch.as_tensor(graph.stats_features(selected, actions, remaining=remaining),
                                 dtype=torch.float32).reshape(-1, STATS_DIM),
    }
    if include_nodes:
        state.update(
            node_features=torch.as_tensor(graph.node_features(selected), dtype=torch.float32),
            edge_index=torch.as_tensor(graph.edge_index, dtype=torch.long),
            removed=[torch.tensor(action.removed, dtype=torch.long) for action in actions],
            added=[torch.tensor(action.added, dtype=torch.long) for action in actions],
            affected=[torch.tensor(graph.affected_nodes(action), dtype=torch.long) for action in actions],
        )
    return state


def move_state(state, device, mode="stats"):
    """Move the tensors used by this scorer; retain state metadata."""
    result = dict(state)
    result["stats"] = torch.as_tensor(state["stats"], dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    for name in ("values", "_pairs"):
        if name in state:
            result[name] = torch.as_tensor(state[name], device=device)
    if mode != "stats":
        result["node_features"] = torch.as_tensor(state["node_features"], dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
        result["edge_index"] = torch.as_tensor(state["edge_index"], dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        for name in ("removed", "added", "affected"):
            result[name] = {key: value.to(device) for key, value in pack_groups(state[name]).items()}
    return result


def pack_groups(groups):
    """Pack candidate node sets into one index array and its pooling assignments."""
    if isinstance(groups, dict):
        return groups
    indices = torch.cat(groups) if groups else torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.long)
    lengths = torch.tensor([len(nodes) for nodes in groups], dtype=torch.long, device=indices.device)
    owners = torch.repeat_interleave(torch.arange(len(groups), device=indices.device), lengths,
                                    output_size=len(indices))
    return dict(indices=indices, owners=owners, lengths=lengths)


def collate_states(states, mode="stats"):
    """Join independent states with block-diagonal edges and candidate-local pools."""
    sizes = [len(state["stats"]) for state in states]
    batch = dict(stats=torch.cat([state["stats"] for state in states]), candidate_sizes=sizes)
    if mode == "stats" or not sum(sizes):
        return batch
    features, edges = [], []
    pools = {name: {key: [] for key in ("indices", "owners", "lengths")}
             for name in ("removed", "added", "affected")}
    node_offset = candidate_offset = 0
    for state, size in zip(states, sizes):
        if not size:
            continue
        node_features = torch.as_tensor(state["node_features"], dtype=torch.float32)
        features.append(node_features)
        edges.append(torch.as_tensor(state["edge_index"], dtype=torch.long) + node_offset)
        for name in pools:
            packed = pack_groups(state[name])
            pools[name]["indices"].append(packed["indices"] + node_offset)
            pools[name]["owners"].append(packed["owners"] + candidate_offset)
            pools[name]["lengths"].append(packed["lengths"])
        node_offset += len(node_features)
        candidate_offset += size
    batch.update(node_features=torch.cat(features), edge_index=torch.cat(edges, dim=1))
    batch.update({name: {key: torch.cat(values) for key, values in packed.items()}
                  for name, packed in pools.items()})
    return batch


def neighbor_mean(features, edge_index):
    row, col = edge_index
    total = features.new_zeros(features.shape)
    total.index_add_(0, row, features[col])
    degree = torch.bincount(row, minlength=len(features)).to(features.dtype).unsqueeze(1)
    return torch.where(degree > 0, total / degree.clamp_min(1), features)


def pool_nodes(features, groups, *, maximum=False):
    """Pool variable-size node sets; empty affected regions have zero encoding."""
    groups = pack_groups(groups)
    lengths, owners, indices = groups["lengths"], groups["owners"], groups["indices"]
    result = features.new_zeros((len(lengths), features.shape[1]))
    if not len(indices):
        return result
    if maximum:
        result.scatter_reduce_(0, owners.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, features.shape[1]),
                               features[indices], reduce="amax", include_self=False)
    else:
        result.index_add_(0, owners, features[indices])
        result = result / lengths.clamp_min(1).unsqueeze(1)
    return result


def node_branch():
    return nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(8, 32), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(32, 32), nn.SiLU())


class PAVEV3(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, mode="stats", stats_dim=STATS_DIM):
        super().__init__()
        if mode not in MODES:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown PAVE v3 mode: {mode}")
        self.mode = mode
        self.stats_dim = stats_dim
        if mode == "stats":
            self.scorer = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(stats_dim, 64), nn.SiLU(),
                                        nn.Linear(64, 32), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(32, 1))
        else:
            self.first = node_branch()
            self.second = node_branch()
            self.scorer = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(4 * 64 + stats_dim, 64), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(64, 1))

    def forward(self, state):
        device = next(self.parameters()).device
        stats = torch.as_tensor(state["stats"], dtype=torch.float32, device=device).reshape(-1, self.stats_dim)
        if len(stats) == 0:
            return stats.new_empty(0)
        if self.mode == "stats":
            return self.scorer(stats).squeeze(-1)
        state = move_state(state, device, self.mode)
        features = state["node_features"]
        neighbors = neighbor_mean(features, state["edge_index"])
        if self.mode == "frequency":
            first = (features + neighbors) * 0.5
            second = features - first
        else:
            first, second = features, neighbors
        nodes = torch.cat((self.first(first), self.second(second)), dim=-1)
        action = torch.cat((pool_nodes(nodes, state["removed"]),
                            pool_nodes(nodes, state["added"]),
                            pool_nodes(nodes, state["affected"]),
                            pool_nodes(nodes, state["affected"], maximum=True), stats), dim=-1)
        return self.scorer(action).squeeze(-1)

    @torch.no_grad()
    def choose(self, graph, selected, actions, remaining=1.0):
        if len(actions) == 1:
            return actions[0]
        if not actions:
            return None
        state = build_state(graph, selected, actions, remaining, include_nodes=self.mode != "stats")
        return actions[int(self(state).argmax())]


def load_pave_v3(path, device="cpu"):
    checkpoint = torch.load(Path(path), map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    model = PAVEV3(checkpoint["mode"], checkpoint.get("stats_dim", STATS_DIM))
    model.load_state_dict(checkpoint["model_state"])
    model.strongest_rule = checkpoint["strongest_rule"]
    return model.to(device).eval()

FILE: models/mis_v4_frequency.py

"""Lazy random-walk state filters with residual adapters for MIS flip logits."""
from typing import NamedTuple

import torch
from torch import nn

from models import GCN, edge2adj


V4_MODES = (
    "v4a_mlp", "v4a_message", "v4a", "v4a_fixed", "v4a_low", "v4a_high",
    "v4a_near", "v4a_norelease", "v4a_noenergy", "v4a_complementary",
)


class V4Topology(NamedTuple):
    normalized: torch.Tensor
    binary: torch.Tensor
    degree: torch.Tensor
    log_degree: torch.Tensor


def v4_topology(edge_index, adj, nodes):
    """Cache static topology, using unit edges instead of the energy's half weights."""
    binary = torch.sparse_csr_tensor(
        adj.crow_indices(), adj.col_indices(),
        torch.ones(adj.values().shape, device=adj.device, dtype=torch.float32),
        size=adj.shape, device=adj.device,
    )
    degree = binary.crow_indices().diff().float().view(-1, 1)
    return V4Topology(edge2adj(edge_index, nodes), binary, degree, degree.log1p())


def neighbor_sum(signals, topology):
    return (topology.binary @ signals.flatten(1)).reshape_as(signals)


def lazy_walk(signals, topology):
    """Apply P = (I + D^-1 A)/2, with the identity on isolated vertices."""
    with torch.autocast(device_type=signals.device.type, enabled=False):
        signals = signals.float()
        degree = topology.degree.reshape((-1,) + (1,) * (signals.ndim - 1))
        average = neighbor_sum(signals, topology) / degree.clamp_min(1)
        return 0.5 * (signals + torch.where(degree > 0, average, signals))


def state_bands(x, topology, beta=1.02):
    """Compute current-state statistics and the exact L2 + B1 + B0 decomposition."""
    with torch.autocast(device_type=x.device.type, enabled=False):
        x = x.float()
        c = neighbor_sum(x, topology)
        release = ((x == 0) & (c == 1)).float()
        r = x * neighbor_sum(release, topology)
        z = torch.stack((x, c.log1p()), -1)
        pz = lazy_walk(z, topology)
        ppz = lazy_walk(pz, topology)
        return {
            "x": x, "c": c, "r": r, "release": release,
            "z": z, "pz": pz, "ppz": ppz, "L2": ppz,
            "B0": z - pz, "B1": pz - ppz,
            "delta_energy": (1 - 2 * x) * (beta * c - 1),
        }


def encoder(channels, hidden):
    return nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(channels, 16), nn.SiLU(),
                         nn.Linear(16, hidden), nn.LayerNorm(hidden))


class V4FrequencyAdapter(nn.Module):
    """Two equal-width branches with independent state-conditioned sigmoid gates.

    Every arm has the same parameters. The MLP arm uses raw local statistics;
    the message arm uses (P²Z, [Z, PZ]), retaining exactly the frequency arm's
    information. All main arms share eta = mean(abs([B0, B1])) and clipped
    energy changes in [-1, 1] in their six gate inputs.
    """

    def __init__(self, hidden, beta=1.02, mode="v4a"):
        super().__init__()
        if mode not in V4_MODES:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown v4 frequency mode: {mode}")
        self.beta = beta
        self.mode = mode
        self.low = encoder(2, hidden)
        self.high = encoder(4, hidden)
        self.gates = nn.Linear(6, 2)
        self.alpha_low = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(0.01))
        self.alpha_high = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(0.01))
        self.gate_override = None
        self.low_override = None
        self.high_override = None

    def inspect(self, x, adj, topology):
        """Return current filters, gates, encoded branches and injected residuals.

        ``gate_override=0.5`` fixes both gates. Setting ``low_override`` or
        ``high_override`` to False disables that branch during inference.
        ``adj`` is the energy adjacency; all filter reductions use the cached
        binary adjacency in ``topology``.
        """
        details = state_bands(x, topology, self.beta)
        z, pz, ppz = details["z"], details["pz"], details["ppz"]
        b0, b1 = details["B0"], details["B1"]
        high_input = torch.cat((b0, b1), -1)
        low_input = ppz
        eta_input = high_input
        if self.mode == "v4a_mlp":
            low_input = z
            high_input = torch.cat((
                z, topology.log_degree.expand_as(x).unsqueeze(-1),
                details["r"].log1p().unsqueeze(-1),
            ), -1)
        elif self.mode == "v4a_message":
            high_input = torch.cat((z, pz), -1)
        elif self.mode == "v4a_near":
            high_input = torch.cat((b0, torch.zeros_like(b1)), -1)
            eta_input = high_input

        release_input = details["r"].log1p()
        energy_input = details["delta_energy"].clamp(-1, 1)
        if self.mode == "v4a_norelease":
            release_input = torch.zeros_like(release_input)
        if self.mode == "v4a_noenergy":
            energy_input = torch.zeros_like(energy_input)
        eta = eta_input.abs().mean(-1)
        gate_input = torch.stack((
            details["x"], topology.log_degree.expand_as(x),
            details["c"].log1p(), release_input, energy_input, eta,
        ), -1)
        gate_logits = self.gates(gate_input)
        gates = gate_logits.sigmoid()
        if self.mode == "v4a_complementary":
            g_low = (gate_logits[..., 0] - gate_logits[..., 1]).sigmoid()
            gates = torch.stack((g_low, 1 - g_low), -1)
        if self.mode == "v4a_fixed" or self.gate_override is not None:
            value = 0.5 if self.gate_override is None else self.gate_override
            gates = torch.full_like(gates, value)

        u_low, u_high = self.low(low_input), self.high(high_input)
        delta_low = self.alpha_low * gates[..., :1] * u_low
        delta_high = self.alpha_high * gates[..., 1:] * u_high
        low_enabled = self.mode not in ("v4a_high", "v4a_near")
        high_enabled = self.mode != "v4a_low"
        if self.low_override is not None:
            low_enabled = self.low_override
        if self.high_override is not None:
            high_enabled = self.high_override
        if not low_enabled:
            delta_low = torch.zeros_like(delta_low)
        if not high_enabled:
            delta_high = torch.zeros_like(delta_high)
        details.update(
            low_input=low_input, high_input=high_input, eta=eta,
            gate_input=gate_input, gates=gates, u_low=u_low, u_high=u_high,
            delta_low=delta_low, delta_high=delta_high,
        )
        return details

    def forward(self, x, adj, topology):
        details = self.inspect(x, adj, topology)
        return details["delta_low"], details["delta_high"]


class V4FrequencyGCN(GCN):
    def __init__(self, hidden, layers, beta=1.02, mode="v4a"):
        super().__init__(1, hidden, layers, 1)
        self.adapter = V4FrequencyAdapter(hidden, beta, mode)

    def forward(self, x, edge_index, adj, topology=None, *, disable_adapter=False):
        if topology is None:
            topology = v4_topology(edge_index, adj, x.size(0))
        hidden = self.initial_project(x.unsqueeze(-1))
        if not disable_adapter:
            low, high = self.adapter(x, adj, topology)
            hidden = hidden + low.to(hidden.dtype) + high.to(hidden.dtype)
        return self.project_hidden(hidden, topology.normalized).squeeze(-1)

FILE: models/mis_v5_frequency.py

"""DAFR-Lite: post-encoding graph bands for scalar MIS flip corrections."""
import torch
from torch import nn

from models import GCN
from mis_v4_frequency import lazy_walk, v4_topology as v5_topology


V5_MODES = ("v5a", "v5a_mlp", "v5a_message", "v5a_low", "v5a_high", "v5a_fixed",
            "v5a_noenergy", "v5a_conflict", "v5a_mlp_conflict", "v5a_message_conflict")


def local_energy(x, counts, beta):
    return (1 - 2 * x) * (beta * counts - 1)


class V5DAFR(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, mode="v5a", width=12, beta=1.02):
        super().__init__()
        self.mode = mode
        self.beta = beta
        self.signal = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(5, width), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(width, 2), nn.Tanh())
        self.gate = nn.Linear(5, 2)
        self.theta_low = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(()))
        self.theta_high = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(()))

    def features(self, x, counts, topology):
        degree = topology.degree.expand_as(x)
        delta_e = local_energy(x, counts, self.beta)
        occupancy = counts / degree.clamp_min(1)
        if self.mode.endswith("_conflict"):
            occupancy = ((x == 1) & (counts > 0)).float()
        energy = (delta_e / 5).tanh() if self.mode != "v5a_noenergy" else torch.zeros_like(x)
        return torch.stack((x, counts.log1p(), topology.log_degree.expand_as(x), occupancy, energy), -1)

    def encode(self, z):
        proposal = self.signal(z)
        gates = self.gate(z).sigmoid() if self.mode != "v5a_fixed" else torch.full_like(proposal, 0.5)
        return proposal, gates, proposal * gates

    def bands(self, gated, topology):
        if self.mode.startswith("v5a_mlp"):
            return gated[..., 0], gated[..., 1]
        propagated = lazy_walk(gated, topology)
        low = propagated[..., 0]
        high = (0.5 * (gated[..., 1] + propagated[..., 1]) if self.mode.startswith("v5a_message")
                else gated[..., 1] - propagated[..., 1])
        if self.mode == "v5a_low":
            high = torch.zeros_like(high)
        if self.mode == "v5a_high":
            low = torch.zeros_like(low)
        return low, high

    def forward(self, x, topology, return_details=False):
        with torch.autocast(device_type=x.device.type, enabled=False):
            x = x.float()
            counts = topology.binary @ x
            z = self.features(x, counts, topology)
            proposal, gates, gated = self.encode(z)
            low, high = self.bands(gated, topology)
            a_low = 0.25 * self.theta_low.tanh()
            a_high = 0.25 * self.theta_high.tanh()
            correction = a_low * low + a_high * high
        if return_details:
            return correction, dict(z=z, counts=counts, proposal=proposal, gates=gates, gated=gated,
                                    low=low, high=high, a_low=a_low, a_high=a_high)
        return correction


class V5DAFRGCN(GCN):
    def __init__(self, hidden, layers, beta=1.02, mode="v5a"):
        super().__init__(1, hidden, layers, 1)
        self.adapter = V5DAFR(mode=mode, beta=beta)

    def backbone_logits(self, x, edge_index, topology):
        return super().forward(x.unsqueeze(-1), edge_index, topology.normalized).squeeze(-1)

    def forward(self, x, edge_index, energy_adj, topology=None):
        if topology is None:
            topology = v5_topology(edge_index, energy_adj, x.size(0))
        base = self.backbone_logits(x, edge_index, topology)
        return base + self.adapter(x, topology).to(base.dtype)

"""SC-RLNN with gated backbone bands and a cross-layer readout."""

from typing import NamedTuple

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F

from models import edge2adj


V6_MODES = ("v6_full", "v6_noscatter", "v6_lowonly", "v6_highonly", "v6_nogate", "v6_noanti")


class V6Topology(NamedTuple):
    normalized: torch.Tensor
    inverse_degree: torch.Tensor
    log_degree: torch.Tensor
    degree_asymmetry: torch.Tensor
    polarization_edges: torch.Tensor
    polarization_weight: torch.Tensor


def physics_state(x, product, inverse_degree, log_degree, asymmetry, beta, use_asymmetry):
    counts = 2 * product.to(x.dtype)
    occupancy = counts * inverse_degree.to(x.dtype)
    delta = (1 - 2 * x) * (beta * counts - 1)
    asymmetry = asymmetry.to(x.dtype).expand_as(x) if use_asymmetry else torch.zeros_like(x)
    return torch.stack((x, occupancy, (0.25 * delta).tanh(),
                        log_degree.to(x.dtype).expand_as(x), asymmetry), dim=-1), counts


def mix_bands(h, local, neighbor, gate, alpha_low, alpha_high, scale, bias, mode):
    if mode == "v6_lowonly":
        mixed = (local + neighbor) * (0.5 + 0.5 * alpha_low.tanh()).to(h.dtype)
    elif mode == "v6_highonly":
        high = (0.5 + 0.5 * alpha_high.tanh()).to(h.dtype) * gate
        mixed = (local - neighbor) * high
    else:
        low = (0.5 + 0.5 * alpha_low.tanh()).to(h.dtype)
        high = (0.5 + 0.5 * alpha_high.tanh()).to(h.dtype) * gate
        mixed = local * (low + high) + neighbor * (low - high)
    return torch.addcmul(h, scale.to(h.dtype), F.silu(mixed + bias.to(h.dtype)))


@torch.no_grad()
def v6_topology(edge_index, energy_adj, num_nodes):
    degree = energy_adj.crow_indices().diff().float()
    inverse_degree = degree.clamp_min(1).reciprocal()
    log_degree = degree.log1p()
    log_degree = log_degree / log_degree.max().clamp_min(1)
    # MIS energy adjacency stores half the undirected adjacency weight.
    neighbor_log = 2 * (energy_adj @ log_degree.to(energy_adj.dtype)[:, None]).flatten()
    src, dst = edge_index
    edges = edge_index[:, src < dst]
    weight = (inverse_degree[edges[0]] * inverse_degree[edges[1]]).sqrt()
    return V6Topology(edge2adj(edge_index, num_nodes), inverse_degree[:, None],
                      log_degree[:, None], (log_degree - inverse_degree * neighbor_log)[:, None],
                      edges, weight[:, None])


class SpectralDecoupledConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden, mode):
        super().__init__()
        self.mode = mode
        self.neighbor = nn.Linear(hidden, hidden, bias=False)
        self.local = nn.Linear(hidden, hidden, bias=False)
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(hidden))
        self.alpha_low = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(hidden), requires_grad=mode != "v6_highonly")
        self.alpha_high = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(hidden), requires_grad=mode != "v6_lowonly")
        self.res_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(hidden))
        self.mix = mix_bands

    def reset_parameters(self):
        self.neighbor.reset_parameters()
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.local.weight, gain=0.5)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.bias)
        # Different nonzero gains give the neighbor projection a gradient at initialization.
        nn.init.constant_(self.alpha_low, 0.10)
        nn.init.constant_(self.alpha_high, -0.10)
        nn.init.constant_(self.res_scale, 0.2)

    def forward(self, h, adj, gate):
        support = self.neighbor(h)
        neighbor = torch.spmm(adj, support.flatten(1)).reshape_as(h).to(h.dtype)
        local = self.local(h)
        return self.mix(h, local, neighbor, gate, self.alpha_low, self.alpha_high,
                        self.res_scale, self.bias, self.mode)


class V6SCGCN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden, layers, beta, mode):
        super().__init__()
        if layers < 3:
            raise ValueError("v6 requires at least three layers for distinct readout depths")
        self.mode, self.beta = mode, beta
        self.mid = layers // 2
        self.physics = physics_state
        self.input_proj = nn.Linear(5, hidden)
        self.conflict_gate = None if mode in ("v6_nogate", "v6_lowonly") else nn.Linear(5, 1)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(SpectralDecoupledConv(hidden, mode) for _ in range(layers))
        self.head_low = nn.Linear(hidden, 1, bias=False)
        self.head_phys = nn.Linear(5, 1)
        self.gamma_phys = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(0.1))
        if mode != "v6_noscatter":
            self.head_meso = nn.Linear(hidden, 1, bias=False)
            self.head_high = nn.Linear(hidden, 1, bias=False)
            self.gamma_meso = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(0.2))
            self.gamma_high = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(0.2))

    def compile_pointwise(self):
        self.physics = torch.compile(physics_state, dynamic=True)
        mix = torch.compile(mix_bands, dynamic=True)
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv.mix = mix

    def reset_parameters(self):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.input_proj.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.input_proj.bias)
        if self.conflict_gate is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(self.conflict_gate.weight)
            nn.init.zeros_(self.conflict_gate.bias)
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv.reset_parameters()
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.head_low.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.head_phys.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.head_phys.bias)
        nn.init.constant_(self.gamma_phys, 0.1)
        if self.mode != "v6_noscatter":
            nn.init.orthogonal_(self.head_meso.weight, gain=0.2)
            nn.init.orthogonal_(self.head_high.weight, gain=0.2)
            nn.init.constant_(self.gamma_meso, 0.2)
            nn.init.constant_(self.gamma_high, 0.2)

    def forward(self, x, edge_index, energy_adj, topology=None, *,
                adjacency_product=None, regularize=False, diagnose=False):
        shape = x.shape
        x = x.reshape(x.shape[0], -1)
        if topology is None:
            topology = v6_topology(edge_index, energy_adj, x.size(0))
        if adjacency_product is None:
            adjacency_product = energy_adj @ x
        state, counts = self.physics(x, adjacency_product, topology.inverse_degree, topology.log_degree,
                                     topology.degree_asymmetry, self.beta, self.mode != "v6_noanti")
        gate = 1.0 if self.conflict_gate is None else 0.5 + self.conflict_gate(state).sigmoid()
        h = F.silu(self.input_proj(state))
        trace = []
        for layer, conv in enumerate(self.convs, 1):
            h = conv(h, topology.normalized, gate)
            if layer == 1:
                first = h
            if layer == self.mid:
                mid = h
            if diagnose:
                trace.append(h)
        logits = self.head_low(h).squeeze(-1)
        logits = logits + self.gamma_phys.to(logits.dtype) * self.head_phys(state).squeeze(-1)
        high = meso_logit = high_logit = None
        if self.mode != "v6_noscatter":
            high = first - mid
            meso_logit = self.gamma_meso.to(logits.dtype) * self.head_meso(mid - h).squeeze(-1)
            high_logit = self.gamma_high.to(logits.dtype) * self.head_high(high).squeeze(-1)
            logits = logits + meso_logit + high_logit
        logits = logits.reshape(shape)
        if diagnose:
            return logits, trace, meso_logit, high_logit
        if regularize:
            orthogonality = (F.cosine_similarity(h.float(), high.float(), dim=-1).square()
                             if high is not None else None)
            return logits, counts, orthogonality
        return logits


def polarization_bonus(x, prob, counts, topology, num_graphs):
    src, dst = topology.polarization_edges
    selected = (1 - prob) * x + prob * (1 - x)
    plateau = (counts[src] <= 1) & (counts[dst] <= 1)
    difference = (selected[src] - selected[dst]).square()
    return (difference * plateau * topology.polarization_weight).sum(dim=0).mean() / num_graphs

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import Parameter
from torch_scatter import scatter_add
from torch_geometric.utils import add_remaining_self_loops
import math


class MLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, hidden_channels, num_layers, out_channels, dropout=0.5):
        super(MLP, self).__init__()   
        self.initial_project = nn.Linear(in_channels, hidden_channels)
        self.linear = nn.ModuleList()
        for i in range(num_layers):
            self.linear.append(nn.Linear(hidden_channels, hidden_channels))
        self.final_project = nn.Linear(hidden_channels, out_channels)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        
    def reset_parameters(self):
        for linear in self.linear:
            linear.reset_parameters()
        
        self.initial_project.reset_parameters()
        self.final_project.reset_parameters()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.initial_project(x)
        
        for linear in self.linear:
            x_ = self.activation(linear(x))
            x = x_ + x

        return self.final_project(x)
            

def edge2adj(edge_index, num_nodes):
    """Convert edge index to adjacency matrix"""
    tmp, _ = add_remaining_self_loops(edge_index, num_nodes=num_nodes)
    edge_weight = torch.ones(tmp.size(1), dtype=None,
                                     device=edge_index.device)

    row, col = tmp[0], tmp[1]
    deg = scatter_add(edge_weight, row, dim=0, dim_size=num_nodes)
    deg_inv_sqrt = deg.pow_(-0.5)
    deg_inv_sqrt.masked_fill_(deg_inv_sqrt == float('inf'), 0)
    edge_weight = deg_inv_sqrt[row] * edge_weight * deg_inv_sqrt[col]
    return torch.sparse_coo_tensor(tmp, edge_weight, torch.Size((num_nodes, num_nodes))).to_sparse_csr()

class GCNConv(nn.Module):
    """
    Simple GCN layer, similar to https://arxiv.org/abs/1609.02907
    """

    def __init__(self, in_features, out_features, bias=True):
        super(GCNConv, self).__init__()
        self.in_features = in_features
        self.out_features = out_features
        self.weight = Parameter(torch.FloatTensor(in_features, out_features))
        if bias:
            self.bias = Parameter(torch.FloatTensor(out_features))
        else:
            self.register_parameter('bias', None)
        self.reset_parameters()

    def reset_parameters(self):
        stdv = 1. / math.sqrt(self.weight.size(1))
        self.weight.data.uniform_(-stdv, stdv)
        if self.bias is not None:
            self.bias.data.uniform_(-stdv, stdv)

    def forward(self, x, adj):
        support = torch.matmul(x, self.weight)
        support = support.flatten(1)
        output = torch.spmm(adj, support)
        output = output.reshape(x.shape)
        if self.bias is not None:
            return output + self.bias
        else:
            return output

    def __repr__(self):
        return self.__class__.__name__ + ' (' \
               + str(self.in_features) + ' -> ' \
               + str(self.out_features) + ')'


class GCN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, hidden_channels, num_layers, out_channels, dropout=0.5):
        super(GCN, self).__init__()   
        self.initial_project = nn.Linear(in_channels, hidden_channels)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList()  
        self.linears = nn.ModuleList()
        
        for i in range(num_layers):
            conv = GCNConv(hidden_channels, hidden_channels)
            self.convs.append(conv)
            self.linears.append(nn.Linear(hidden_channels, hidden_channels))       
        
        self.final_project = nn.Linear(hidden_channels, out_channels)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        
    def reset_parameters(self):
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv.reset_parameters()
        for linear in self.linears:
            linear.reset_parameters()
        
        self.initial_project.reset_parameters()
        self.final_project.reset_parameters()
            
    def forward(self, x, edge_index, adj=None):
        if adj is None:
            adj = edge2adj(edge_index, x.shape[0])
        return self.project_hidden(self.initial_project(x), adj)

    def project_hidden(self, x, adj):
        for conv, linear in zip(self.convs,self.linears):
            nei = conv(x, adj)
            x_ = linear(x)
            x = self.activation(nei + x_) + x
        
        x = self.final_project(x)
        
        return x

"""Validation-only paired flip interventions under a frozen RLNN continuation."""
import argparse
import csv
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean
from time import perf_counter

import torch

from eval_v2 import VALID, dataset_at
from mis_v1 import adjacency
from mis_v4_frequency import V4FrequencyGCN, V4_MODES, v4_topology
from models import GCN, edge2adj
from problems.mis import Problem


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def checkpoint_file(path):
    path = Path(path)
    return path / "best.pt" if path.is_dir() else path


def load_model(mode, path, device):
    model = GCN(1, 128, 5, 1) if mode == "none" else V4FrequencyGCN(128, 5, mode=mode)
    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(checkpoint_file(path), map_location="cpu", weights_only=True))
    return model.to(device).eval().requires_grad_(False)


def logits(model, mode, x, graph, adj, topology, normalized):
    if mode == "none":
        return model(x.unsqueeze(-1), graph.edge_index, normalized).squeeze(-1)
    return model(x, graph.edge_index, adj, topology)


@torch.no_grad()
def paired_utilities(teacher, state, candidates, graph, adj, normalized, problem,
                     horizon, seed, replicates=2):
    """Share continuation noise across all interventions within each replicate."""
    choices = candidates.numel() + 1
    x = state[:, None, None].expand(-1, replicates, choices).clone()
    candidate_columns = torch.arange(1, choices, device=state.device)
    for replicate in range(replicates):
        x[candidates, replicate, candidate_columns] = 1 - x[candidates, replicate, candidate_columns]
    x = x.flatten(1)
    best = x.clone()
    best_energy, _ = problem.energy_func(adj, graph.b, x)
    generators = [torch.Generator(device=state.device).manual_seed(seed + replicate)
                  for replicate in range(replicates)]
    for _ in range(horizon):
        probability = teacher(x.unsqueeze(-1), graph.edge_index, normalized).squeeze(-1).sigmoid()
        shared_noise = torch.stack([
            torch.rand(state.shape[0], generator=generator, device=state.device)
            for generator in generators
        ], dim=1)
        noise = shared_noise.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, choices).flatten(1)
        x = torch.where(noise < probability, 1 - x, x)
        energy, _ = problem.energy_func(adj, graph.b, x)
        improves = energy < best_energy
        best = torch.where(improves.unsqueeze(0), x, best)
        best_energy = torch.minimum(best_energy, energy)
    solutions = problem.decode_gradient_flip(best, adj, graph.b, return_solutions=True)
    if ((adj @ solutions) * solutions).any():
        raise ValueError("A.3 produced a conflicting independent set")
    sizes = solutions.sum(0).reshape(replicates, choices)
    gains = sizes[:, 1:] - sizes[:, :1]
    return sizes, gains


def rank_metrics(scores, utilities):
    pairs = torch.triu_indices(utilities.numel(), utilities.numel(), offset=1)
    differences = utilities[pairs[0]] - utilities[pairs[1]]
    non_ties = differences != 0
    score_differences = scores[pairs[0]] - scores[pairs[1]]
    products = score_differences[non_ties] * differences[non_ties]
    correct = (products > 0).float() + 0.5 * (products == 0).float()
    chosen = int(scores.argmax())
    return dict(
        pairs=pairs.shape[1], non_tied_pairs=int(non_ties.sum()),
        correct_pair_credit=float(correct.sum()),
        pair_accuracy=float(correct.mean()) if correct.numel() else None,
        score_tied_pairs=int((score_differences[non_ties] == 0).sum()),
        chosen_index=chosen, top1_gain=float(utilities[chosen]),
        uniform_gain=float(utilities.mean()), oracle_flip_gain=float(utilities.max()),
        top1_regret=float(utilities.max() - utilities[chosen]),
    )


def write_csv(path, rows):
    if not rows:
        return
    with path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)


@torch.no_grad()
def probe(args):
    if args.graphs <= 0 or args.nodes < 2:
        raise ValueError("The probe requires positive graph count and at least two sampled nodes")
    device = torch.device(args.device)
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
    models = {"baseline": ("none", load_model("none", args.teacher_checkpoint, device))}
    paths = {"baseline": str(checkpoint_file(args.teacher_checkpoint))}
    for name, mode, path in args.model:
        if name in models or mode not in ("none",) + V4_MODES:
            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate name or unsupported mode: {name}, {mode}")
        models[name] = mode, load_model(mode, path, device)
        paths[name] = str(checkpoint_file(path))
    teacher = models["baseline"][1]
    problem = Problem(1.02)
    dataset = dataset_at(args.validation_path, torch.float32, args.graphs)
    if not len(dataset):
        raise ValueError("The validation dataset is empty")
    args.result_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    metadata = dict(
        version="v4_frequency", mode="utility_probe", status="running", split="validation",
        seed=args.seed, config=vars(args), checkpoints=paths,
        started_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        protocol="Current single-trajectory states; paired node flips with common continuation noise; per-column energy archive and A.3",
        continuation_policy="frozen baseline", continuation_steps=args.horizon, replicates=2,
        times=[25, 50, 100], precision="float32", model_selection="diagnostic only",
    )

    def save():
        (args.result_dir / "run.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(metadata, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    save()
    started = perf_counter()
    action_rows, state_rows, ranking_rows = [], [], []
    try:
        for index, graph in enumerate(dataset):
            graph_id = Path(dataset.files[index]).stem
            graph = graph.to(device)
            adj = adjacency(graph)
            normalized = edge2adj(graph.edge_index, graph.num_nodes)
            topology = v4_topology(graph.edge_index, adj, graph.num_nodes)
            trajectory_rng = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(args.seed + index)
            x = torch.randint(0, 2, (graph.num_nodes, 1), device=device,
                              generator=trajectory_rng).float()
            for step in range(1, 101):
                probability = teacher(x.unsqueeze(-1), graph.edge_index, normalized).squeeze(-1).sigmoid()
                noise = torch.rand(x.shape, device=device, generator=trajectory_rng)
                x = torch.where(noise < probability, 1 - x, x)
                if step not in (25, 50, 100):
                    continue
                state_id = f"{graph_id}:t{step}"
                node_seed = args.seed + 10000 * (index + 1) + step
                candidate_rng = torch.Generator().manual_seed(node_seed)
                candidates = torch.randperm(graph.num_nodes, generator=candidate_rng)[:args.nodes].to(device)
                sizes, gains = paired_utilities(
                    teacher, x[:, 0], candidates, graph, adj, normalized, problem,
                    args.horizon, seed=node_seed + 1000000,
                )
                sizes, gains = sizes.cpu(), gains.cpu()
                utilities = gains.mean(0)
                scores = {name: logits(model, mode, x, graph, adj, topology, normalized)[candidates, 0].cpu()
                          for name, (mode, model) in models.items()}
                common = dict(graph_id=graph_id, graph_index=index, state_id=state_id, step=step)
                neutral_metrics = rank_metrics(scores["baseline"], utilities)
                state_rows.append(dict(
                    **common, nodes=graph.num_nodes, candidates=len(candidates),
                    pairs=neutral_metrics["pairs"], non_tied_pairs=neutral_metrics["non_tied_pairs"],
                    informative=int(neutral_metrics["non_tied_pairs"] > 0),
                    nonzero_gain_candidates=int((utilities != 0).sum()),
                    positive_gain_candidates=int((utilities > 0).sum()),
                    mean_gain=float(utilities.mean()), oracle_flip_gain=float(utilities.max()),
                    noflip_size_r0=float(sizes[0, 0]), noflip_size_r1=float(sizes[1, 0]),
                    replicate_sign_agreement=float((gains[0].sign() == gains[1].sign()).float().mean()),
                ))
                for column, node in enumerate(candidates.tolist()):
                    row = dict(
                        **common, node=node, selected=int(x[node, 0]),
                        flip_size_r0=float(sizes[0, column + 1]), flip_size_r1=float(sizes[1, column + 1]),
                        noflip_size_r0=float(sizes[0, 0]), noflip_size_r1=float(sizes[1, 0]),
                        gain_r0=float(gains[0, column]), gain_r1=float(gains[1, column]),
                        mean_gain=float(utilities[column]),
                    )
                    row.update({f"logit_{name}": float(values[column]) for name, values in scores.items()})
                    action_rows.append(row)
                for name, values in scores.items():
                    metrics = rank_metrics(values, utilities)
                    metrics["chosen_node"] = int(candidates[metrics.pop("chosen_index")])
                    ranking_rows.append(dict(**common, model=name, **metrics))
            print(f"{index + 1}/{len(dataset)} validation graphs; {len(state_rows)} states", flush=True)
        write_csv(args.result_dir / "actions.csv", action_rows)
        write_csv(args.result_dir / "states.csv", state_rows)
        write_csv(args.result_dir / "ranking.csv", ranking_rows)
        summaries = {}
        for name in models:
            rows = [row for row in ranking_rows if row["model"] == name]
            informative = [row for row in rows if row["non_tied_pairs"]]
            non_tied = sum(row["non_tied_pairs"] for row in rows)
            summaries[name] = dict(
                states=len(rows), informative_states=len(informative),
                state_mean_pair_accuracy=mean(row["pair_accuracy"] for row in informative) if informative else None,
                pooled_pair_accuracy=sum(row["correct_pair_credit"] for row in rows) / non_tied if non_tied else None,
                mean_top1_gain=mean(row["top1_gain"] for row in rows),
                mean_uniform_gain=mean(row["uniform_gain"] for row in rows),
                mean_oracle_flip_gain=mean(row["oracle_flip_gain"] for row in rows),
                mean_top1_regret=mean(row["top1_regret"] for row in rows),
            )
        total_pairs = sum(row["pairs"] for row in state_rows)
        metadata.update(
            status="completed", graphs=len(dataset), states=len(state_rows), actions=len(action_rows),
            informative_states=sum(row["informative"] for row in state_rows),
            informative_state_fraction=mean(row["informative"] for row in state_rows),
            informative_graphs=len({row["graph_id"] for row in state_rows if row["informative"]}),
            total_pairs=total_pairs, non_tied_pairs=sum(row["non_tied_pairs"] for row in state_rows),
            non_tied_pair_fraction=sum(row["non_tied_pairs"] for row in state_rows) / total_pairs if total_pairs else None,
            model_metrics=summaries,
        )
    except Exception as error:
        metadata.update(status="failed", error=str(error))
        raise
    finally:
        metadata.update(finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), wall_time_s=perf_counter() - started)
        save()
    return metadata


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--teacher-checkpoint", type=Path,
                        default=ROOT / "outputs/v2/none_seed0/checkpoints/best.pt")
    parser.add_argument("--model", nargs=3, action="append", default=[], metavar=("NAME", "MODE", "CHECKPOINT"))
    parser.add_argument("--validation-path", type=Path, default=VALID)
    parser.add_argument("--result-dir", type=Path, default=ROOT / "outputs/v4_frequency/utility_seed0")
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--graphs", type=int, default=20)
    parser.add_argument("--nodes", type=int, default=16)
    parser.add_argument("--horizon", type=int, choices=(10, 20), default=20)
    parser.add_argument("--device", default="cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    probe(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
