"""Save the initial statistics scorers for the fixed-work learning control."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import torch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'models'))
from mis_v3_value import PAVEV3, STATS_DIM


def main():
    for seed in (0, 1, 2):
        torch.manual_seed(seed)
        model = PAVEV3('stats')
        result = ROOT / 'outputs' / 'v3' / f'stats_untrained_h1_seed{seed}'
        checkpoints = result / 'checkpoints'
        checkpoints.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        torch.save(dict(mode='stats', stats_dim=STATS_DIM, model_state=model.state_dict(),
                        seed=seed, epoch=0, strongest_rule='degree'), checkpoints / 'best.pt')
        metadata = dict(version='v3', mode='untrained_control', status='completed',
                        run=result.name, model='stats', train_seed=seed, epoch=0,
                        strongest_rule='degree', params=sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()),
                        finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
        (result / 'run.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
        print(f'{result.name}: {metadata["params"]} parameters, epoch 0', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()


========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v3/validate_heads.py
========================================================================
"""Compare frozen-start platform quality before admitting graph encoders."""
import argparse
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor
import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pickle
from statistics import mean
import sys
from time import perf_counter

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'models'))
import torch
from mis_v3_search import SearchGraph, platform_search
from mis_v3_value import load_pave_v3


def worker(payload):
    record, output, backbone = pickle.loads(payload)
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    graph = SearchGraph(record['num_nodes'], record['edge_index'], record['search_seed'])
    rows = []
    choices = [('none', 2, None), ('rule23', 2, None)]
    choices += [(rule, horizon, None) for horizon in (1,2) for rule in ('random','degree','coverage')]
    for horizon in (1,2):
        checkpoint = output/f'stats_h{horizon}_seed{record["backbone_seed"]}/checkpoints/best.pt'
        if checkpoint.is_file():
            choices.append(('stats', horizon, load_pave_v3(checkpoint)))
    for mode in ('message','frequency','stats_adapted'):
        checkpoint = output/f'{mode}_h1_seed{record["backbone_seed"]}/checkpoints/best.pt'
        if checkpoint.is_file() and (checkpoint.parent.parent/'run.json').is_file():
            choices.append((mode, 1, load_pave_v3(checkpoint)))
    for policy, horizon, model in choices:
        tick = perf_counter()
        selected = record['selected']
        result = None if policy=='none' else platform_search(graph, selected,
                    choose=model.choose if model else policy, horizon=horizon,
                    outer_rounds=0 if policy=='rule23' else 8)
        final = result.best if result else selected
        if not graph.feasible(final):
            raise ValueError('Invalid cached-validation result')
        rows.append(dict(graph_id=record['graph_id'], backbone=backbone,
            backbone_seed=record['backbone_seed'], policy=policy, horizon=horizon,
            base_size=selected.bit_count(), rule_size=result.rule_size if result else selected.bit_count(),
            final_size=final.bit_count(), post_time_s=perf_counter()-tick,
            neutral_decisions=result.neutral_decisions if result else 0))
    return rows


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,default=Path('outputs/v3'))
    parser.add_argument('--workers',type=int,default=24)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    records=[]
    for backbone in ('original','tuned'):
        for seed in range(3):
            name=f'starts_validation_seed{seed}_stream0' if backbone=='original' else f'starts_tuned_seed{seed}'
            records += [pickle.dumps((r,args.output,backbone),protocol=5)
                        for r in torch.load(args.output/name/'starts.pt',weights_only=False)]
    tick=perf_counter()
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=args.workers) as pool:
        rows=[row for group in pool.map(worker,records) for row in group]
    result=args.output/'validation_platform'
    result.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with (result/'per_graph.csv').open('w',encoding='utf-8',newline='') as handle:
        writer=csv.DictWriter(handle,fieldnames=list(rows[0])); writer.writeheader(); writer.writerows(rows)
    summary={}
    for backbone in ('original','tuned'):
        variants=sorted({(r['policy'],r['horizon']) for r in rows if r['backbone']==backbone})
        summary[backbone]={}
        for policy,horizon in variants:
            group=[r for r in rows if r['backbone']==backbone and r['policy']==policy and r['horizon']==horizon]
            summary[backbone][f'{policy}_h{horizon}']=dict(mean_size=mean(r['final_size'] for r in group),
                by_seed={str(seed):mean(r['final_size'] for r in group if r['backbone_seed']==seed) for seed in range(3)})
    backbone=max(summary,key=lambda b:max(v['mean_size'] for k,v in summary[b].items() if k.startswith(('random','degree','coverage'))))
    rules={key:value for key,value in summary[backbone].items() if key.startswith(('random','degree','coverage'))}
    strongest=max(rules,key=lambda key:rules[key]['mean_size'])
    stats={key:value for key,value in summary[backbone].items() if key in ('stats_h1','stats_h2')}
    selected_stats=max(stats,key=lambda key:stats[key]['mean_size']) if stats else None
    delta=stats[selected_stats]['mean_size']-rules[strongest]['mean_size'] if selected_stats else None
    choice=dict(backbone=backbone,strongest_rule=strongest,stats=selected_stats,
                delta_vs_strongest_rule=delta,train_encoders=delta is not None and delta>0)
    learned={key:value for key,value in summary[backbone].items()
             if key.startswith(('stats','message','frequency'))}
    choice['best_learned']=max(learned,key=lambda key:learned[key]['mean_size']) if learned else None
    if 'message_h1' in learned and 'frequency_h1' in learned:
        differences=[learned['frequency_h1']['by_seed'][str(seed)]-learned['message_h1']['by_seed'][str(seed)]
                     for seed in range(3)]
        choice['frequency_minus_message_by_seed']=differences
        choice['train_exchange_band']=all(delta>0 for delta in differences)
    metadata=dict(version='v3',status='completed',mode='validation_platform',split='validation',
                  samples=600,wall_time_s=perf_counter()-tick,summaries=summary,choice=choice,
                  timing='Parallel cached-start quality selection; post timing is diagnostic only')
    (result/'run.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    (args.output/'model_decision.json').write_text(json.dumps(choice,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps(metadata,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':
    main()


========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v4_frequency/check_adapter.py
========================================================================
"""Check v4 filter semantics, backbone compatibility and independent graph batching."""
import argparse
import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import torch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "models"))
from models import GCN
from mis_v4_frequency import V4FrequencyGCN, V4_MODES, lazy_walk, state_bands, v4_topology


def graph(nodes, pairs, device):
    edges = torch.tensor(pairs + [(j, i) for i, j in pairs],
                         dtype=torch.long, device=device).t().contiguous()
    adj = torch.sparse_coo_tensor(edges, torch.full((edges.shape[1],), 0.5, device=device),
                                  (nodes, nodes)).to_sparse_csr()
    return edges, adj, v4_topology(edges, adj, nodes)


def close(actual, expected, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5):
    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, atol=atol, rtol=rtol)


def run(device):
    torch.manual_seed(17)
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    nodes = 7
    pairs = [(0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 4)]
    edges, adj, topology = graph(nodes, pairs, device)
    x = torch.tensor([[1, 0, 1], [0, 1, 1], [0, 0, 0], [1, 0, 0],
                      [0, 1, 0], [1, 0, 1], [0, 1, 1]], device=device).float()
    a = topology.binary.to_dense()
    d = a.sum(1, keepdim=True)
    transition = a / d.clamp_min(1)
    transition[d.squeeze(1) == 0] = torch.eye(nodes, device=device)[d.squeeze(1) == 0]
    p = 0.5 * (torch.eye(nodes, device=device) + transition)
    details = state_bands(x, topology)
    dense_z = torch.stack((x, (a @ x).log1p()), -1)
    dense_pz = (p @ dense_z.flatten(1)).reshape_as(dense_z)
    dense_ppz = (p @ dense_pz.flatten(1)).reshape_as(dense_z)
    close(details["c"], 2 * (adj @ x), atol=0, rtol=0)
    close(details["r"], x * (a @ ((x == 0) & ((a @ x) == 1)).float()), atol=0, rtol=0)
    close(details["z"], dense_z)
    close(details["pz"], dense_pz)
    close(details["ppz"], dense_ppz)
    close(details["L2"] + details["B0"] + details["B1"], details["z"])
    for key in ("B0", "B1"):
        close(details[key][5:], torch.zeros_like(details[key][5:]), atol=0, rtol=0)
    constant = torch.tensor([2.0, -3.0], device=device).expand(nodes, 3, 2)
    close(lazy_walk(constant, topology), constant, atol=0, rtol=0)
    close(lazy_walk(lazy_walk(constant, topology), topology), constant, atol=0, rtol=0)
    all_selected = state_bands(torch.ones_like(x), topology)
    assert all_selected["B0"][..., 1].abs().max() > 0
    assert not torch.equal(state_bands(1 - x, topology)["c"], details["c"])

    base = GCN(1, 128, 5, 1).to(device).eval()
    model = V4FrequencyGCN(128, 5).to(device).eval()
    missing, extra = model.load_state_dict(base.state_dict(), strict=False)
    assert missing and all(key.startswith("adapter.") for key in missing) and not extra
    with torch.no_grad():
        expected = base(x.unsqueeze(-1), edges, topology.normalized).squeeze(-1)
        close(model(x, edges, adj, topology, disable_adapter=True), expected, atol=0, rtol=0)
        alpha = (model.adapter.alpha_low.item(), model.adapter.alpha_high.item())
        assert all(abs(value - 0.01) < 1e-8 for value in alpha)
        model.adapter.alpha_low.zero_()
        model.adapter.alpha_high.zero_()
        close(model(x, edges, adj, topology), expected, atol=0, rtol=0)
        model.adapter.alpha_low.fill_(alpha[0])
        model.adapter.alpha_high.fill_(alpha[1])

    counts = {}
    for mode in V4_MODES:
        arm = V4FrequencyGCN(128, 5, mode=mode).to(device)
        counts[mode] = sum(parameter.numel() for parameter in arm.parameters())
        assert torch.isfinite(arm(x, edges, adj, topology)).all()
    assert set(counts.values()) == {170513}
    assert sum(parameter.numel() for parameter in model.adapter.parameters()) == 5008
    message = V4FrequencyGCN(128, 5, mode="v4a_message").to(device)
    info = message.adapter.inspect(x, adj, topology)
    raw_z, raw_pz = info["high_input"].chunk(2, -1)
    close(raw_z - raw_pz, details["B0"])
    close(raw_pz - info["low_input"], details["B1"])
    model.adapter.gate_override = 0.5
    model.adapter.low_override = False
    info = model.adapter.inspect(x, adj, topology)
    close(info["gates"], torch.full_like(info["gates"], 0.5), atol=0, rtol=0)
    close(info["delta_low"], torch.zeros_like(info["delta_low"]), atol=0, rtol=0)
    model.adapter.gate_override = model.adapter.low_override = None

    order = torch.tensor([4, 6, 1, 0, 5, 2, 3], device=device)
    inverse = torch.argsort(order)
    permuted_edges = inverse[edges]
    permuted_adj = torch.sparse_coo_tensor(
        permuted_edges, torch.full((edges.shape[1],), 0.5, device=device), adj.shape,
    ).to_sparse_csr()
    permuted_topology = v4_topology(permuted_edges, permuted_adj, nodes)
    output = model(x, edges, adj, topology)
    close(model(x[order], permuted_edges, permuted_adj, permuted_topology), output[order], atol=1e-5)
    particle_order = torch.tensor([2, 0, 1], device=device)
    close(model(x[:, particle_order], edges, adj, topology), output[:, particle_order], atol=1e-5)
    for particles in (1, 20, 64, 1000):
        repeated = x[:, :1].expand(-1, particles).contiguous()
        scored = model(repeated, edges, adj, topology)
        assert scored.shape == (nodes, particles)
        close(scored, output[:, :1].expand_as(scored), atol=1e-5)

    other_edges, other_adj, other_topology = graph(4, [(0, 1), (1, 2)], device)
    other_x = 1 - x[:4]
    batched_edges = torch.cat((edges, other_edges + nodes), 1)
    batched_adj = torch.sparse_coo_tensor(
        batched_edges, torch.full((batched_edges.shape[1],), 0.5, device=device), (11, 11),
    ).to_sparse_csr()
    batched_topology = v4_topology(batched_edges, batched_adj, 11)
    batched_model, separate_model = copy.deepcopy(model), copy.deepcopy(model)
    batched = batched_model(torch.cat((x, other_x)), batched_edges, batched_adj, batched_topology)
    separate = torch.cat((separate_model(x, edges, adj, topology),
                          separate_model(other_x, other_edges, other_adj, other_topology)))
    close(batched, separate, atol=1e-5)
    batched.square().mean().backward()
    separate.square().mean().backward()
    gradient_error = 0.0
    for (name, parameter), (_, reference) in zip(batched_model.named_parameters(), separate_model.named_parameters()):
        close(parameter.grad, reference.grad, atol=1e-5)
        gradient_error = max(gradient_error, (parameter.grad - reference.grad).abs().max().item())
        if name.startswith("adapter."):
            assert torch.isfinite(parameter.grad).all() and parameter.grad.abs().sum() > 0, name

    if device.type == "cuda":
        with torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.float16), torch.no_grad():
            info = model.adapter.inspect(x.half(), adj.half(), topology)
            assert info["z"].dtype == torch.float32
            assert info["c"].dtype == torch.float32
            assert torch.isfinite(model(x.half(), edges, adj.half(), topology)).all()
            no_adapter = model(x.half(), edges, adj.half(), topology, disable_adapter=True)
            original = base(x.half().unsqueeze(-1), edges, topology.normalized).squeeze(-1)
            close(no_adapter, original, atol=0, rtol=0)
    return {"status": "passed", "device": str(device), "params": counts,
            "adapter_params": 5008, "batch_gradient_max_abs_difference": gradient_error}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--device", default="cpu")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = json.dumps(run(torch.device(args.device)), indent=2)
    if args.output:
        args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.output.write_text(result + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(result)


========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v4_frequency/check_native_repeat.py
========================================================================
"""Measure native forward and shared-random replay variation on real validation graphs."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "models"))
import torch
from diagnose_v4_branch_replay import load_group, replay, shared_noise
from eval_v2 import dataset_at, sync
from mis_v1 import adjacency
from profile_v4_frequency import build_parser

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--precision", choices=("fp32", "fp16"), default="fp16")
parser.add_argument("--repeats", type=int, default=3)
parser.add_argument("--replay-graphs", type=int, default=3)
parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
cli = parser.parse_args()
records = []
def emit(record):
    records.append(record)
    print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
args = build_parser().parse_args([
    "--seed", "0", "--split", "validation", "--graph-count", str(max(1, cli.replay_graphs)),
    "--precision", cli.precision, "--models", "baseline", "f4",
    "--result-dir", "outputs/v4_frequency/followup/p0_checks/native_repeat_probe",
])
torch.set_num_threads(1)
torch.manual_seed(17)
solvers, _ = load_group(args, args.models)
first = solvers["baseline"]
device = first.accelerator.device
dataset = dataset_at(args.test_path, first.dtype, args.graphs)


@torch.no_grad()
def run():
    for index, item in enumerate(dataset):
        graph = item.to(device)
        adj = adjacency(graph)
        topologies = {name: solver.policy_topology(graph, adj) for name, solver in solvers.items()}
        initial, uniforms, _ = shared_noise(graph.num_nodes, 20, 100, device, first.dtype, 1017 + index)
        if index == 0:
            state = initial.clone()
            for step in range(50):
                p = first.flip_logits(state, graph, adj, topologies["baseline"]).sigmoid()
                state = torch.where(uniforms[step] < p, 1 - state, state)
            for name, solver in solvers.items():
                values = []
                for repeat in range(cli.repeats):
                    value = solver.flip_logits(state, graph, adj, topologies[name]).detach().clone()
                    sync(device)
                    values.append(value)
                pairs = []
                for repeat in range(1, cli.repeats):
                    difference = (values[repeat] - values[0]).abs()
                    p0, p1 = values[0].sigmoid(), values[repeat].sigmoid()
                    pairs.append(dict(repeat=repeat, changed_logits=int((difference > 0).sum()),
                                      total_logits=difference.numel(), maximum_logit_difference=float(difference.max()),
                                      maximum_probability_difference=float((p1 - p0).abs().max()),
                                      sampled_flip_disagreements=int(((uniforms[50] < p0) != (uniforms[50] < p1)).sum())))
                emit(dict(kind="native_same_state", precision=cli.precision, model=name,
                          graph_id=Path(dataset.files[index]).stem, phase=50, comparisons=pairs))
        if not cli.replay_graphs:
            continue
        for name, solver in solvers.items():
            results = []
            for repeat in range(cli.repeats):
                result = replay(solver.problem, adj, graph.b, initial, uniforms,
                                lambda x: solver.flip_logits(x, graph, adj, topologies[name]),
                                phases=range(101), capture=True)
                sync(device)
                results.append(result)
            pairs = []
            for repeat in range(1, cli.repeats):
                changed = {step: int((results[0]["states"][step] != results[repeat]["states"][step]).sum())
                           for step in range(101)}
                pairs.append(dict(repeat=repeat, first_changed_step=next((step for step, count in changed.items() if count), None),
                                  changed_steps=sum(count > 0 for count in changed.values()),
                                  changed_state_entries=sum(changed.values()), final_state_changed=changed[100],
                                  selected_nodes_changed=results[0]["selected"] != results[repeat]["selected"]))
            emit(dict(kind="native_replay", precision=cli.precision, model=name,
                      graph_id=Path(dataset.files[index]).stem,
                      sizes=[result["selected"].bit_count() for result in results], comparisons=pairs))


run()

if cli.output:
    cli.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cli.output.write_text(json.dumps(dict(precision=cli.precision, repeats=cli.repeats, records=records), indent=2)+"\n", encoding="utf-8")

FILE: train_scripts/v4_frequency/check_replay_profile.py
========================================================================
"""Check shared-random replay and profiler decomposition on a small MIS graph."""
import argparse
from contextlib import nullcontext
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from types import SimpleNamespace

import torch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "models"))
from diagnose_v4_branch_replay import policy_logits, replay, same_state_rows, shared_noise
from eval_v2 import search
from frequency_diag_utils import override_logits
from mis_v3_search import SearchGraph
from mis_v4_frequency import V4FrequencyGCN, state_bands, v4_topology
from problems.mis import Problem
from profile_v4_frequency import branch_inputs, gate_fusion, state_statistics
from solvers import RLNN


@torch.no_grad()
def check(device, precision):
    dtype = torch.float16 if precision == "fp16" else torch.float32
    pairs = [(0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 4)]
    edges = torch.tensor(pairs + [(j, i) for i, j in pairs], device=device).T.contiguous()
    adjacency = torch.sparse_coo_tensor(edges, torch.full((edges.shape[1],), .5, device=device, dtype=dtype),
                                        (7, 7)).to_sparse_csr()
    graph = SimpleNamespace(num_nodes=7, edge_index=edges, edge_weight=adjacency.values(),
                            b=-torch.ones(7, 1, device=device, dtype=dtype))
    topology = v4_topology(edges, adjacency, 7)
    model = V4FrequencyGCN(16, 2, mode="v4a").to(device).eval().requires_grad_(False)
    context = lambda: torch.autocast(device_type=device.type, dtype=torch.float16) if precision == "fp16" else nullcontext()
    accelerator = SimpleNamespace(device=device, autocast=context, unwrap_model=lambda module: module)
    solver = SimpleNamespace(model=model, problem=Problem(1.02), dtype=dtype, num_k=20, num_t=100,
                              accelerator=accelerator, policy_topology=lambda *_: topology)

    def logits(state, *_):
        with context():
            return model(state, edges, adjacency, topology).float()

    solver.flip_logits = logits
    solver.sample_states = lambda *args, **kwargs: RLNN.sample_states(solver, *args, **kwargs)
    initial, uniforms, probe = shared_noise(7, 20, 100, device, dtype, 1017)
    generator = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(1017)
    torch.testing.assert_close(initial, torch.randint(0, 2, (7, 20), device=device, dtype=dtype, generator=generator), atol=0, rtol=0)
    for uniform in uniforms:
        torch.testing.assert_close(uniform, torch.rand((7, 20), device=device, dtype=dtype, generator=generator), atol=0, rtol=0)
    torch.testing.assert_close(probe, torch.rand((7, 20), device=device, dtype=dtype, generator=generator), atol=0, rtol=0)
    result = replay(solver.problem, adjacency, graph.b, initial, uniforms, logits, phases=range(101), capture=True)
    repeated = replay(solver.problem, adjacency, graph.b, initial, uniforms, logits, phases=range(101), capture=True)
    generator = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(1017)
    stream = solver.sample_states(graph, adjacency, generator=generator, normalized=topology)
    for step, state in enumerate(stream):
        torch.testing.assert_close(result["states"][step], state, atol=0, rtol=0)
        torch.testing.assert_close(repeated["states"][step], state, atol=0, rtol=0)
    cpu_graph = SearchGraph(7, edges.cpu(), seed=1017)
    selected, steps = search(solver, graph, cpu_graph, 1017)
    assert steps == 100 and selected == result["selected"] == repeated["selected"]
    assert cpu_graph.feasible(selected) and selected
    tolerance = 1e-5 if precision == "fp32" else 2e-3
    before = {name: value.clone() for name, value in model.state_dict().items()}
    full = policy_logits(solver, graph, adjacency, topology, initial)
    with context():
        no_adapter = model(initial, edges, adjacency, topology, disable_adapter=True).float()
    intervention = policy_logits(solver, graph, adjacency, topology, initial, dict(low_scale=0., high_scale=0.))
    torch.testing.assert_close(intervention, no_adapter, atol=tolerance, rtol=tolerance)
    policy_logits(solver, graph, adjacency, topology, initial, dict(zero_bias={"high": (0,)}, activation={"high": "identity"}))
    torch.testing.assert_close(full, policy_logits(solver, graph, adjacency, topology, initial), atol=0, rtol=0)
    for name, value in model.state_dict().items():
        torch.testing.assert_close(value, before[name], atol=0, rtol=0)

    details = state_bands(initial, topology)
    stats = state_statistics(initial, topology)
    for name in stats:
        torch.testing.assert_close(stats[name], details[name], atol=0, rtol=0)
    for mode in ("v4a", "v4a_mlp", "v4a_message"):
        candidate = V4FrequencyGCN(16, 2, mode=mode).to(device).eval()
        with context():
            native = candidate.adapter.inspect(initial, adjacency, topology)
            low_input, high_input, gate_input = branch_inputs(candidate.adapter, details, topology)
            for actual, expected in ((low_input, native["low_input"]), (high_input, native["high_input"]), (gate_input, native["gate_input"])):
                torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, atol=0, rtol=0)
            raw = candidate.initial_project(initial.unsqueeze(-1))
            fused = gate_fusion(candidate.adapter, raw, candidate.adapter.low(low_input), candidate.adapter.high(high_input), gate_input)
            decomposed = candidate.project_hidden(fused, topology.normalized).squeeze(-1)
            native_logits = candidate(initial, edges, adjacency, topology)
        torch.testing.assert_close(decomposed, native_logits, atol=tolerance, rtol=tolerance)
    rows = same_state_rows(initial, details["c"], details["r"], {"full": full, "no_adapter": intervention}, uniforms[0], binary=topology.binary)
    reference_rows = [row for row in rows if row["variant"] == "full" and row["category"] == "all"]
    assert len(reference_rows) == 20
    assert all(row["top5_jaccard"] == 1 and row["sampled_action_disagreement"] == 0 for row in reference_rows)
    q = initial.float() + (1 - 2 * initial.float()) * full.float().sigmoid()
    exact_expected = (q * (1.02 * (topology.binary @ q) / 2 - 1)).sum(0)
    current = (initial.float() * (1.02 * details["c"] / 2 - 1)).sum(0)
    torch.testing.assert_close(torch.tensor([row["expected_joint_delta_energy"] for row in reference_rows], device=device),
                               exact_expected - current, atol=1e-4, rtol=1e-5)
    return dict(precision=precision, size=selected.bit_count(), steps=steps, shared_stream=True,
                matches_original_search=True, interventions_nonmutating=True, component_decomposition=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--device", choices=("cpu", "cuda"), default="cpu")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    torch.manual_seed(17)
    device = torch.device(args.device)
    result = dict(device=args.device, checks=[check(device, precision) for precision in
                                             (("fp32", "fp16") if args.device == "cuda" else ("fp32",))])
    if args.output:
        args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(result))

FILE: train_scripts/v4_frequency/check_spectrum.py

"""Check spectral centering and non-mutating v4 stage/intervention diagnostics."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "models"))
from frequency_diag_utils import (
    BANDS, intervention_details, override_logits, remove_stationary, spectral_basis,
    spectral_energy_extended, spectral_energy_many, trace_model, trace_sequential,
)


def close(actual, expected, atol=1e-10, rtol=1e-9):
    torch.testing.assert_close(torch.as_tensor(actual, dtype=torch.float64),
                               torch.as_tensor(expected, dtype=torch.float64), atol=atol, rtol=rtol)


def edges_from(pairs):
    return torch.tensor(pairs + [(j, i) for i, j in pairs], dtype=torch.long).t().contiguous()


def spectral_checks():
    edges = edges_from([(0, 1), (1, 2), (0, 2), (3, 4), (4, 5)])
    basis = spectral_basis(edges, 7)
    assert int((basis[0] <= 1e-7).sum()) == 3
    signal = torch.randn(7, 4, 3, dtype=torch.float64)
    stats = spectral_energy_extended(signal, basis)
    close(sum(stats[f"raw_{name}_energy"] for _, _, name in BANDS), stats["total_energy"])
    close(sum(stats[f"raw_{name}_fraction"] for _, _, name in BANDS), 1.0)
    close(sum(stats[f"centered_{name}_fraction"] for _, _, name in BANDS), 1.0)
    close(stats["stationary_energy"] + stats["nonstationary_energy"], stats["total_energy"])
    centered = remove_stationary(signal, basis)
    centered_stats = spectral_energy_extended(centered, basis)
    close(centered_stats["total_energy"], stats["nonstationary_energy"])
    assert centered_stats["stationary_fraction"] < 1e-20
    for _, _, name in BANDS:
        close(centered_stats[f"raw_{name}_fraction"], stats[f"centered_{name}_fraction"])

    component_constants = torch.tensor([1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3], dtype=torch.float64)[:, None, None].expand(-1, 4, 3)
    const = spectral_energy_extended(component_constants, basis)
    close(const["stationary_fraction"], 1.0)
    assert const["weighted_global_constant_fraction"] < 1
    assert not const["valid_centered"] and const["centered_higher_fraction"] is None
    global_constant = spectral_energy_extended(torch.ones_like(component_constants), basis)
    close(global_constant["node_constant_fraction"], 1.0)
    close(global_constant["weighted_global_constant_fraction"], 1.0)
    assert not global_constant["valid_centered"]
    zero = spectral_energy_extended(torch.zeros_like(signal), basis)
    assert not zero["valid_total"] and not zero["valid_centered"]
    assert zero["raw_low_fraction"] is None

    permutation = torch.tensor([5, 0, 6, 3, 2, 1, 4])
    permuted = spectral_basis(torch.argsort(permutation)[edges], 7)
    permuted_stats = spectral_energy_extended(signal[permutation], permuted)
    for key in stats:
        if isinstance(stats[key], float) and stats[key] is not None:
            close(stats[key], permuted_stats[key])
    first = spectral_energy_extended(signal[:3], spectral_basis(edges_from([(0, 1), (1, 2), (0, 2)]), 3))
    second = spectral_energy_extended(signal[3:], spectral_basis(edges_from([(0, 1), (1, 2)]), 4))
    for key in ["total_energy", "stationary_energy", "nonstationary_energy"] + [f"raw_{name}_energy" for _, _, name in BANDS]:
        close(stats[key], first[key] + second[key])
    packed = spectral_energy_many({"a": signal, "b": signal * 2}, basis)
    close(packed["a"]["total_energy"], stats["total_energy"])
    close(packed["b"]["total_energy"], 4 * stats["total_energy"])

    block = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(4, 16), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(16, 128), nn.LayerNorm(128))
    inputs = torch.randn(7, 4, 4)
    parameters = {name: value.clone() for name, value in block.state_dict().items()}
    stages = trace_sequential(block, inputs)
    close(stages["stage3_LayerNorm"], block(inputs), atol=0, rtol=0)
    no_bias = trace_sequential(block, inputs, zero_bias=(0,))
    close(no_bias["stage0_Linear"], F.linear(inputs, block[0].weight, None), atol=0, rtol=0)
    identity = trace_sequential(block, inputs, activation="identity", skip_norm=True)
    close(identity["stage1_SiLU"], identity["stage0_Linear"], atol=0, rtol=0)
    close(identity["stage3_LayerNorm"], identity["stage2_Linear"], atol=0, rtol=0)
    assert all(torch.equal(value, block.state_dict()[name]) for name, value in parameters.items())
    return {"spectral_parseval": "passed", "entire_zero_space": "passed",
            "constant_and_empty_energy": "passed", "node_permutation": "passed",
            "block_diagonal_energy": "passed", "stage_trace_and_no_mutation": "passed"}


def model_checks(device):
    from mis_v4_frequency import V4FrequencyGCN, v4_topology
    edges = edges_from([(0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 4)]).to(device)
    adj = torch.sparse_coo_tensor(edges, torch.full((edges.shape[1],), 0.5, device=device), (7, 7)).to_sparse_csr()
    topology = v4_topology(edges, adj, 7)
    x = torch.randint(0, 2, (7, 4), device=device).float()
    checks = {}
    for mode in ("v4a", "v4a_message", "v4a_mlp"):
        model = V4FrequencyGCN(128, 5, mode=mode).to(device).eval()
        before = {name: value.clone() for name, value in model.state_dict().items()}
        expected = model(x, edges, adj, topology)
        details, stages = trace_model(model, x, edges, adj, topology)
        close(stages["logits"], expected, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)
        close(override_logits(model, x, edges, adj, topology), expected, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)
        for branch in ("low", "high"):
            close(stages[f"{branch}_stage3_LayerNorm"], details[f"u_{branch}"], atol=0, rtol=0)
        close(override_logits(model, x, edges, adj, topology, low_scale=0, high_scale=0),
              model(x, edges, adj, topology, disable_adapter=True), atol=0, rtol=0)
        for spec in ({"zero_bias": {"high": (0,)}}, {"zero_bias": {"high": (2,)}},
                     {"activation": {"high": "identity"}}, {"skip_norm": ("high",)}, {"gate": 0.5}):
            intervention_details(model.adapter, x, adj, topology, **spec)
            values = override_logits(model, x, edges, adj, topology, **spec)
            assert torch.isfinite(values).all()
        singles = torch.cat([model(x[:, i:i + 1], edges, adj, topology) for i in range(x.shape[1])], dim=1)
        close(singles, expected, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
        assert before.keys() == model.state_dict().keys()
        assert all(torch.equal(value, model.state_dict()[name]) for name, value in before.items())
        close(model(x, edges, adj, topology), expected, atol=0, rtol=0)
        checks[mode] = "trace/logits/particles/interventions/state_dict passed"
    return checks


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--device", default="cpu")
    parser.add_argument("--spectral-only", action="store_true", help="Run pure-torch checks without the original GCN dependencies")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    torch.manual_seed(2026)
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    with torch.no_grad():
        result = {"status": "passed", "spectral": spectral_checks(), "device": args.device}
        if not args.spectral_only:
            result["models"] = model_checks(torch.device(args.device))
    rendered = json.dumps(result, indent=2)
    if args.output:
        args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.output.write_text(rendered + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(rendered)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Check shared rollout labels, chunking, candidate strata and P3 output prefixes."""
import argparse
import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
from types import SimpleNamespace

import torch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "models"))
from models import GCN
from mis_v4_frequency import V4FrequencyGCN, state_bands, v4_topology
from problems.mis import Problem
from probe_v4_utility import paired_utilities as original_paired_utilities
from probe_v4_utility_followup import (
    LABEL_MODES, build_parser, continuation_noise, graph_average, label_reliability,
    node_masks, paired_utilities, prefix_counts, probe, sample_candidates,
)


def run(device):
    torch.manual_seed(17)
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    pairs = [(0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2), (3, 4)]
    edges = torch.tensor(pairs + [(b, a) for a, b in pairs], device=device).T.contiguous()
    adj = torch.sparse_coo_tensor(edges, torch.full((edges.shape[1],), .5, device=device), (7, 7)).to_sparse_csr()
    topology = v4_topology(edges, adj, 7)
    graph = SimpleNamespace(num_nodes=7, edge_index=edges, b=-torch.ones(7, 1, device=device))
    state = torch.tensor([1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0], device=device).float()
    candidates = torch.tensor([0, 2, 4, 6], device=device)
    teacher = GCN(1, 128, 5, 1).to(device).eval().requires_grad_(False)
    problem = Problem(1.02)
    args = (teacher, state, candidates, graph, adj, topology.normalized, problem, 10, 12345)
    expected, expected_gains = original_paired_utilities(*args, replicates=2)
    for chunk in (1, 7, 256):
        sizes, gains = paired_utilities(*args, replicates=2, chunk_size=chunk)
        torch.testing.assert_close(sizes, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
        torch.testing.assert_close(gains, expected_gains, rtol=0, atol=0)
    full_sizes, full_gains = paired_utilities(*args, replicates=16, chunk_size=7)
    for repeats in prefix_counts(16):
        sizes, gains = paired_utilities(*args, replicates=repeats, chunk_size=7)
        torch.testing.assert_close(sizes, full_sizes[:repeats], rtol=0, atol=0)
        torch.testing.assert_close(gains, full_gains[:repeats], rtol=0, atol=0)
    torch.testing.assert_close(continuation_noise(7, 10, 2, 12345, device),
                               continuation_noise(7, 10, 16, 12345, device)[:2], rtol=0, atol=0)
    permutation = torch.tensor([2, 0, 3, 1], device=device)
    permuted, _ = paired_utilities(teacher, state, candidates[permutation], graph, adj,
        topology.normalized, problem, 10, 12345, replicates=16, chunk_size=7)
    torch.testing.assert_close(permuted[:, 0], full_sizes[:, 0], rtol=0, atol=0)
    torch.testing.assert_close(permuted[:, 1:], full_sizes[:, 1:][:, permutation], rtol=0, atol=0)

    details = state_bands(state[:, None], topology)
    masks, threshold = node_masks(state, details["c"][:, 0], details["r"][:, 0])
    assert torch.stack([masks[key] for key in list(masks)[:5]]).sum(0).eq(1).all()
    assert all(masks[key].any() for key in list(masks)[:5])
    assert threshold == 1 and masks["release_high"].nonzero().flatten().tolist() == [3]
    for sampling in ("uniform", "stratified"):
        selected = sample_candidates(masks, 6, sampling, 112)
        assert len(selected) == 6 and len(selected.unique()) == 6
        assert torch.equal(selected, selected.sort().values)
        assert torch.equal(selected, sample_candidates(masks, 6, sampling, 112))
        assert sample_candidates(masks, 24, sampling, 112).tolist() == list(range(7))
    baseline_energy, _ = problem.energy_func(adj, graph.b, state[:, None])
    for node in range(7):
        changed = state.clone()
        changed[node] = 1 - changed[node]
        energy, _ = problem.energy_func(adj, graph.b, changed[:, None])
        torch.testing.assert_close(energy - baseline_energy, details["delta_energy"][node], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6)
    stable = label_reliability(torch.tensor([[1., 0., -1.]]).repeat(8, 1))
    assert stable["half_pair_direction_agreement"] == 1 and stable["half_joint_non_tied_pairs"] == 3
    assert stable["mean_gain_sem"] == 0 and stable["half_top1_same"] == 1
    tied = label_reliability(torch.zeros(8, 4))
    assert tied["informative"] == 0 and tied["half_spearman"] is None
    assert graph_average([dict(graph_id="a", v=0.), dict(graph_id="a", v=1.), dict(graph_id="b", v=1.)], "v") == .75

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="rlnn_p3_") as directory:
        temporary = Path(directory)
        data = temporary / "data"
        data.mkdir()
        torch.save(dict(edge_index=edges.cpu(), num_nodes=7), data / "toy.pt")
        (data / "tensor_manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(graphs=[dict(tensor="toy.pt", source="toy.gpickle")])))
        cli = ["--device", str(device), "--graphs", "1", "--nodes", "7", "--replicates", "8",
               "--phases", "0", "--horizon", "10", "--sampling", "stratified", "--chunk-size", "7",
               "--data-path", str(data), "--result-dir", str(temporary / "result")]
        for name, mode in LABEL_MODES.items():
            model = GCN(1, 128, 5, 1) if mode == "none" else V4FrequencyGCN(128, 5, mode=mode)
            path = temporary / f"{name}.pt"
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), path)
            cli.extend(["--model", name, mode, str(path)])
        metadata = probe(build_parser().parse_args(cli))
        assert metadata["status"] == "completed" and metadata["states"] == 1
        assert metadata["replicate_prefixes"] == [2, 4, 8]
        assert metadata["actions"] == 7 and metadata["action_replicates"] == 56
        result = temporary / "result"
        repeat_rows = list(csv.DictReader((result / "action_replicate.csv").open()))
        aggregate_rows = list(csv.DictReader((result / "action_aggregate.csv").open()))
        for row in aggregate_rows:
            samples = torch.tensor([float(x["gain"]) for x in repeat_rows
                                    if x["node"] == row["node"] and int(x["replicate"]) < int(row["R"])])
            assert float(row["gain_mean"]) == float(samples.mean())
            assert float(row["gain_std"]) == float(samples.std(unbiased=True))
            assert abs(float(row["gain_sem"]) - float(samples.std(unbiased=True)) / len(samples)**.5) < 1e-12
        ranked = list(csv.DictReader((result / "ranking.csv").open()))
        assert {row["model"] for row in ranked} == set(LABEL_MODES) | {
            "F4_no_low", "F4_no_high", "Energy", "Random", "DegreeLow", "SelectedNeighbors", "Release"}
    return dict(status="passed", device=str(device), checks=[
        "R2 original paired-label semantics", "chunk sizes 1/7/256", "R2/4/8/16 shared prefixes",
        "candidate permutation", "unique stratified sampling", "exact single-flip energy",
        "split-half reliability", "graph-weighted summaries", "CLI CSV prefixes and repeat moments",
    ])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--device", default="cpu")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = run(torch.device(args.device))
    if args.output:
        args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))

"""Apply the v4 validation gate before expanding the training budget."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = ROOT / 'outputs/v4_frequency'


def main():
    values = {}
    for path in OUT.glob('*/*/run.json'):
        if path.parent.parent.name.startswith('smoke'):
            continue
        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        if data.get('mode') != 'eval' or data.get('status') != 'completed' or data.get('split') != 'validation':
            continue
        if any(data.get('interventions', {}).values()):
            continue
        config = data['config']
        key = (config['mixed_precision'], data['protocol'], data['post'], data['method'], data['train_seed'], data.get('extended_search', False))
        values[key] = data['mean_size']
    result = dict(stage='A1', status='pending', primary='FP32 fixed-work without PAVE',
                  efficiency='FP16 0.5-second budget with frozen PAVE', comparisons=[])
    tests = [('no', 'fixed_work', 'none', control, False) for control in ('v4a_mlp', 'v4a_message')]
    tests += [('fp16', 'fixed_time', 'pave', control, False) for control in ('baseline', 'v4a_mlp', 'v4a_message')]
    tests += [('fp16', 'fixed_time', 'pave', 'baseline', True)]
    missing = []
    for precision, protocol, post, control, extended in tests:
        keys = [(precision, protocol, post, label, seed, is_extended)
                for label, is_extended in (('v4a', False), (control, extended)) for seed in range(3)]
        missing.extend(key for key in keys if key not in values)
        if any(key not in values for key in keys):
            continue
        deltas = [round(values[precision, protocol, post, 'v4a', seed, False] - values[precision, protocol, post, control, seed, extended], 8) for seed in range(3)]
        positive = sum(delta > 0 for delta in deltas)
        passed = mean(deltas) > 0 and (positive >= 2 if protocol == 'fixed_work' else True)
        result['comparisons'].append(dict(precision=precision, protocol=protocol, post=post,
                                          control=control, control_extended_search=extended, deltas=deltas, mean_delta=mean(deltas),
                                          positive_seeds=positive, passed=passed))
    if missing:
        result['missing'] = sorted(set(missing))
    else:
        passed = all(item['passed'] for item in result['comparisons'])
        result.update(status='passed' if passed else 'stop_current_adapter',
                      next_stage='A2_50_epochs' if passed else 'retain_v3_pave',
                      pave_change=False)
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (OUT / 'decision.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

FILE: train_scripts/v4_frequency/followup/manifest.py

"""Record fixed diagnostic inputs and check that inference preserves checkpoints."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import torch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "models"))
from probe_v4_utility import load_model
from mis_v3_value import load_pave_v3


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--source-sha", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--verify", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    out = ROOT / "outputs/v4_frequency/followup"
    path = out / "manifest.json"
    if args.verify:
        manifest = json.loads(path.read_text())
        for item in manifest["checkpoints"]:
            assert digest(ROOT / item["path"]) == item["sha256"], item["path"]
        report = {"status": "passed", "checkpoint_count": len(manifest["checkpoints"]),
                  "checked_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
        (out / "p0_checks/checkpoints_unchanged.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
        print(report)
        return
    rows = []
    for seed in range(3):
        for name, mode, relative in (
            ("B", "none", f"outputs/v2/none_seed{seed}/checkpoints/best.pt"),
            ("BFT", "none", f"outputs/v4_frequency/none_seed{seed}/checkpoints/best.pt"),
            ("MLP", "v4a_mlp", f"outputs/v4_frequency/v4a_mlp_seed{seed}/checkpoints/best.pt"),
            ("MSG", "v4a_message", f"outputs/v4_frequency/v4a_message_seed{seed}/checkpoints/best.pt"),
            ("F4", "v4a", f"outputs/v4_frequency/v4a_seed{seed}/checkpoints/best.pt"),
            ("PAVE", "stats", f"outputs/v3/stats_h1_seed{seed}/checkpoints/best.pt"),
        ):
            checkpoint = ROOT / relative
            if name == "PAVE":
                model = load_pave_v3(checkpoint, "cpu")
            else:
                model = load_model(mode, checkpoint, torch.device("cpu"))
            model.eval().requires_grad_(False)
            assert not model.training and not any(p.requires_grad for p in model.parameters())
            rows.append(dict(model=name, seed=seed, mode=mode, path=relative,
                             sha256=digest(checkpoint), bytes=checkpoint.stat().st_size,
                             params=sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()), keys=list(model.state_dict())))
    datasets = {}
    for split, directory, count in (("train", "RB_small_train", 20), ("validation", "RB_small_val", 100)):
        relative = f"models/data/MIS_tensors/{directory}"
        entries = json.loads((ROOT / relative / "tensor_manifest.json").read_text())["graphs"][:count]
        for item in entries:
            assert (ROOT / relative / item["tensor"]).is_file(), item
        datasets[split] = dict(path=relative, graphs=entries,
                               purpose="mechanism development" if split == "train" else "reused validation confirmation")
    record = dict(created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), source_sha=args.source_sha,
                  checkpoints=rows, datasets=datasets,
                  resources=json.loads((out / "p0_checks/resources.json").read_text()),
                  torch=torch.__version__, cuda=torch.version.cuda,
                  fixed=dict(beta=1.02, K=20, T=100, d=5, layers=5, hidden=128,
                             search_seed=1017, precision_spectrum="fp32", precision_deploy="fp16",
                             time_budget_s=0.5, pave_reserve_s=0.05),
                  selection=dict(p1_train=20, p1_validation=100, p2_validation=100,
                                 p3_reliability_train=10, p3_node_groups_train=20,
                                 p3_validation="conditional on a useful sampling definition",
                                 official_test_used=False))
    path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print(f"Recorded {len(rows)} frozen checkpoints and {sum(len(d['graphs']) for d in datasets.values())} graph IDs")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v4_frequency/followup/README.md

# v4 频率机制诊断

使用已训练权重分析频率编码、分支行为、动作收益和计算成本。PAVE-Stats H1、MIS能量、原训练损失和A.3解码保持原协议。

- 方案：`docs/temporary/RLNN_v4_Frequency_Mechanism_Diagnostic_Implementation_Plan.md`
- 输出：`outputs/v4_frequency/followup/`
- 训练图前20张用于机制探索，验证图100张用于复核；图顺序取已有tensor manifest，不重新生成图。
- P1使用FP32，K20/T100完整轨迹，观察前4粒子，分别记录冻结教师轨迹和模型自身轨迹。
- P2分别运行FP32/FP16；每图共享`x0`与逐步`U`，保留原按粒子最低能量档案。分支干预仍执行全部编码，运行时间不用于结构剪枝的速度结论。
- P3先用训练10图检查R2/4/8/16稳定性，再比较20图Uniform16与Stratified24；所有评分方法使用同一冻结教师的成对收益标签。只有发现值得复核的抽样定义才扩到验证100图。
- P4在独占GPU上交错测量方法，20图、30次预热、5次重复。端到端计时与组件同步微基准分开。

统计先在图内聚合，再计算每个训练种子的图均值；三种子标准差使用样本标准差。配对bootstrap以图ID为重采样单位，并保留该图所有训练种子。验证图已用于权重选择，诊断区间不代表独立测试结论。

环境与冻结输入记录：

```bash
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
export PYTHON=/home/hzeng/envs/rlnn/bin/python
$PYTHON train_scripts/v4_frequency/followup/manifest.py --source-sha "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
# 全部诊断结束后确认所有检查点保持原值
$PYTHON train_scripts/v4_frequency/followup/manifest.py --verify
```

正式1000图测试集不参与本轮诊断。后续是否短训由P1–P4形成的任务收益证据决定。

运行入口依次为 `smoke.sh`、`explore.sh`、`spectrum_confirm.sh`、`utility_controls.sh`、`branch_confirm.sh` 和 `profile.sh`。P2与P1可并行。P4在GPU 0的FP32回放结束后启动。结果用 `python tools/summarize_frequency_followup.py --plots` 聚合，用 `tools/update_frequency_followup_workbook.mjs` 更新追诊页。

完整逐层频谱、逐状态回放、逐动作重复收益保存在服务器的 `outputs/v4_frequency/followup/`。Git保留运行清单、图级求解结果、汇总表和图。

run() {

  return "$code"

  pids=()
  for source in teacher own; do
    if [[ "$source" == teacher ]]; then gpu=0; else gpu=1; fi
    for model in v4a v4a_message v4a_mlp; do
      name="val_${model}_${source}_seed$seed"
      run "$name" "$gpu" models/diagnose_v4_spectrum.py --seed "$seed" --split validation --graphs 100 --models "$model" --trajectory "$source" --result-dir "$OUT/p1_spectrum/$name" &
      pids+=("$!")
    done
  done
  code=0
  for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do wait "$pid" || code=1; done
  if [[ "$code" != 0 ]]; then exit "$code"; fi
done
date -Is > "$OUT/queue/spectrum_confirm.done.txt"

logged() {
  local name="$1" rc=0
  shift
  "$@" > "$OUT/queue/$name.log" 2>&1 || rc=$?
  printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$OUT/queue/$name.exit_code.txt"
  return "$rc"
}

index=0

  done

pids=()
for seed in 0 1 2; do

      --model tuned none "$OUT/none_seed${seed}/checkpoints/best.pt" &
  pids+=("$!")
done
for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do wait "$pid" || failed=1; done

interventions() {
  local gpu="$1" index=0 name seed intervention

    for seed in 0 1 2; do

          logged "$name" bash train_scripts/v4_frequency/eval.sh v4a "--disable-$intervention"
      fi

    done
  done

========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v4_frequency/README.md
========================================================================
# v4 频域状态适配器

当前实验只改变 RLNN 搜索状态编码。PAVE 使用 `outputs/v3/stats_h1_seed{0,1,2}/checkpoints/best.pt`，24 维统计、H1、32 个中性候选、48 个严格改善候选、三轮初始规则交换、四轮修复与八轮平台搜索均沿用 v3。

## 模型与对照

动态信号为 `Z=[x,log1p(c)]`，`c=Ax`；图算子为二值无向图上的 `P=(I+D^-1 A)/2`。孤立节点的 P 为恒等。静态拓扑在一次求解中复用，状态描述每步重算。频带为 `L2=P²Z`、`B0=Z-PZ`、`B1=PZ-P²Z`，满足重构 `Z=L2+B0+B1`。

| arm | 两路输入 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `none` | 原 RLNN | 同预算继续微调 |
| `v4a_mlp` | Z；x、logc、logdegree、logr | 状态统计与容量对照 |
| `v4a_message` | P²Z；Z、PZ | 同信息、同参数普通消息对照 |
| `v4a` | L2；B0、B1 | 双尺度频域候选 |
| `v4a_fixed` | 同 v4a，门控固定 0.5 | 门控消融 |

三种适配器使用相同的 2→16→128 与 4→16→128 分支、LayerNorm、六维门控输入与独立 sigmoid，两项可学习残差系数初值 0.01。共同门控含状态、度数、选中邻居数、释放数、裁剪能量差、尺度差强度。MLP 是容量对照；其门控仍能访问共同图统计。Message 输入保留 Z、PZ、P²Z，和频域三项线性等价。

## A1 训练协议

从同种子 v2 `none` 的已微调 RLNN 权重启动。种子为 0、1、2；每组 3 epoch、1000 张训练图、100 张验证图、每批 8 图 × 64 状态、6000 次优化更新、FP32、原 erdoes 主目标、Adam。适配器第 1 epoch 冻结骨干、学习率 1e-4，第 2–3 epoch 解冻并使用 2e-5；`none` 对照第一轮训练整个骨干，其他学习率和更新预算一致。

短期筛选使用冻结的同种子起始 RLNN 生成训练状态。教师每图 20 条轨迹、50 步，三组适配器共享图顺序和采样随机流。模型初始化完成后，将训练随机流重设为 `20261+seed`，消除各结构初始化所消耗随机数的差异。教师不参与梯度；学生仍学习原独立 Bernoulli 的一步期望能量和距离正则。训练状态只来自训练集。`STATE_SOURCE=on_policy` 提供原策略生成状态的训练入口，不能与共享教师状态结果混算。

每轮按验证随机流 1017+图序号、K=20/T=100 和 A.3 选择最优权重。正式筛选再次用同一批验证图记录 FP32 与 FP16 结果，以及加冻结 PAVE 前后的 Size；限时结果统一 FP16。所有权重与数据保存在服务器。

## 阶段决策

先运行 4 arm × 3 seed。主筛选口径为 FP32、固定搜索量、不加 PAVE：F4 相对 Message 和 MLP 都需要平均验证 Size 为正，且各至少两个种子严格改善。效率口径为 FP16、0.5 秒、冻结 PAVE：F4 的平均 Size 需超过固定旧骨干、Message 和 MLP。如果质量优势被额外时间抵消，就停止当前结构。`decide.py` 记录各项逐种子差值与阶段决策。未通过筛选时仍记录低/高/门控置零的机制诊断，但不利用测试集挑选结构。

通过后，F4 与相应 MLP/Message 对照统一进行 50 epoch 三种子训练，再展开 low/high、固定门控、释放统计和能量先验消融。动态任务图 v4-B 仅在静态版本显示独立价值后推进。每个阶段均保留不加 PAVE 与加同一个冻结 PAVE 的两张结果表。

## 执行

```bash
export PYTHON=/home/hzeng/envs/rlnn/bin/python
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 "$PYTHON" train_scripts/v4_frequency/check_adapter.py
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 SEED=0 bash train_scripts/v4_frequency/train.sh v4a
```

`RUN_NAME`、`EPOCHS`、`SEED`、`CHECKPOINT`、`BATCH_SIZE`、`GRAPH_BATCH_SIZE` 可指定实验；改变 batch 后必须在全部主对照统一使用，并报告实际更新数。默认保留 64×8，优先用独立训练进程填充两张 GPU。正式计时阶段每张卡只允许一个评测进程，计时包含构图、滤波、GCN、采样、A.3 与 PAVE。

训练输出为 `outputs/v4_frequency/<arm>_seed<seed>/run.json`、`training.csv` 和服务器上的 `checkpoints/`。逐图评测及诊断也写入 `outputs/v4_frequency/`。汇总使用三个种子均值的样本标准差，逐图配对保留图 ID 与种子，不把同一张图的三次采样当作三张独立图。

`screen.sh` 在两卡各启动六个独立训练；`validate.sh 0/1` 等待训练结束后，各自串行执行固定量和限时验证。强规则基线使用 20 ms 后处理预留，PAVE 使用既定 50 ms。`mechanism.sh` 等两卡计时任务均结束后运行三种子各 20 图频谱/门控诊断、真实翻转收益探针，再用独占卡完成 low/high/gate 的推理干预。分支干预复用已训练权重，不等同于从头训练的结构消融。

`strong_pave.sh` 在干预评测结束后，补充三种子原骨干＋冻结 PAVE 的持续搜索预算对照。仅放开骨干的步数上限，仍在0.5秒总预算内为同一个PAVE保留50 ms，其余PAVE配置保持一致。

## 本轮结果

12组训练、102份方法评测、12组频域诊断和3组收益探针已完成。F4在FP32固定量下为19.53000，普通消息为19.54667；0.5秒下F4＋PAVE为19.48000，原骨干持续搜索＋PAVE为19.65000。当前适配器未通过A1，保留v3 PAVE主线。完整均值、标准差、逐图差值和机制解释见[结果分析](../../docs/temporary/RLNN_v4_Frequency_Results_Analysis.md)。

复算顺序为 `python tools/summarize_v4_mechanism.py`、`python train_scripts/v4_frequency/decide.py`、`python tools/analyze_v4_frequency.py`；工作簿使用提供 `@oai/artifact-tool` 的Node运行时执行 `tools/update_v4_workbook.mjs`。

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
mkdir -p "$OUT/queue"
arms=(none v4a_mlp v4a_message v4a)
pids=()
index=0
for arm in "${arms[@]}"; do
  for seed in 0 1 2; do
    gpu=$((index % 2))
    slot=$((index / 2))
    cpu_first=$((gpu * 24 + slot * 4))
    cpu_last=$((cpu_first + 3))
    run="${arm}_seed${seed}"
    (
      rc=0
      CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$gpu" SEED="$seed" taskset -c "$cpu_first-$cpu_last" \
        bash "$ROOT/train_scripts/v4_frequency/train.sh" "$arm" > "$OUT/queue/$run.log" 2>&1 || rc=$?
      printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$OUT/queue/$run.exit_code.txt"
      exit "$rc"
    ) &
    pids+=("$!")
    printf '%s GPU%s pid=%s\n' "$run" "$gpu" "$!" >> "$OUT/queue/screen.pids.txt"
    index=$((index + 1))
  done
done
failed=0
for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do wait "$pid" || failed=1; done
date -Is > "$OUT/queue/screen.finished.txt"
exit "$failed"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
export PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=backend:cudaMallocAsync
arm="${1:?pass none, v4a_mlp, v4a_message, or v4a}"
shift
seed="${SEED:-0}"
schedule=()
if [[ "$arm" != none ]]; then schedule+=(--freeze_backbone_epochs 1); fi
exec "$PYTHON" -u "$ROOT/models/train_v4_frequency.py" \
  --result_dir "$OUT/${RUN_NAME:-${arm}_seed${seed}}" \
  --frequency "$arm" --seed "$seed" --epochs "${EPOCHS:-3}" \
  --warm_start "${CHECKPOINT:-$(base_checkpoint "$seed")}/best.pt" \
  --state_source "${STATE_SOURCE:-teacher}" --finetune_lr 0.00002 "${schedule[@]}" \
  --graph_batch_size "${GRAPH_BATCH_SIZE:-8}" --batch_size "${BATCH_SIZE:-64}" \
  --lr 0.0001 --validation_seed 1017 --method RLNN --loss erdoes --problem mis \
  --train_path "$DATA/MIS_tensors/RB_small_train" --train_samples 1000 \
  --valid_path "$DATA/MIS_tensors/RB_small_val" --valid_samples 100 \
  --test_path "$DATA/MIS_tensors/RB_small_author_test" --num_workers 2 \
  --num_k 20 --num_t 100 --num_tp 50 --num_d 5 --num_l 5 --num_h 128 \
  --mixed_precision no --beta 1.02 --lambd 0.5 "$@"

========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v5_frequency/check_adapter.py

"""Check scalar filters, backbone compatibility, graph batching and AMP."""
import argparse
import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import torch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "models"))
from models import GCN
from mis_v4_frequency import lazy_walk
from mis_v5_frequency import V5DAFRGCN, V5_MODES, local_energy, v5_topology


def graph(nodes, pairs, device):
    edges = torch.tensor(pairs + [(j, i) for i, j in pairs], device=device, dtype=torch.long).reshape(-1, 2).T.contiguous()
    adj = torch.sparse_coo_tensor(edges, torch.full((edges.shape[1],), .5, device=device), (nodes, nodes)).to_sparse_csr()
    return edges, adj, v5_topology(edges, adj, nodes)


def run(device):
    torch.manual_seed(17)
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    close = torch.testing.assert_close
    pairs = [(0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2), (3, 4)]
    edges, adj, topo = graph(7, pairs, device)
    x = torch.randint(2, (7, 3), device=device).float()
    dense = topo.binary.to_dense()
    close(topo.binary @ x, 2 * (adj @ x), atol=0, rtol=0)
    delta = local_energy(x, dense @ x, 1.02)

    def energy(state):
        return (state * (1.02 * (dense @ state) / 2 - 1)).sum(0)

    for i in range(7):
        y = x.clone()
        y[i] = 1 - y[i]
        close(energy(y) - energy(x), delta[i])
    u = torch.randn(7, 3, 2, device=device)
    low = lazy_walk(u, topo)
    high = u - low
    close(low + high, u)
    close(high[5:], torch.zeros_like(high[5:]), atol=0, rtol=0)
    for component in (slice(0, 3), slice(3, 5)):
        close((topo.degree[component, :, None] * high[component]).sum(0),
              torch.zeros_like(high[0]), atol=2e-6, rtol=0)
    constant = torch.full_like(u, 3)
    close(lazy_walk(constant, topo), constant, atol=0, rtol=0)
    close(lazy_walk(u, graph(7, [], device)[2]), u, atol=0, rtol=0)
    base = GCN(1, 128, 5, 1).to(device)
    model = V5DAFRGCN(128, 5).to(device)
    missing, extra = model.load_state_dict(base.state_dict(), strict=False)
    assert set(missing) == {"adapter." + name for name in model.adapter.state_dict()} and not extra
    reference = base(x.unsqueeze(-1), edges, topo.normalized).squeeze(-1)
    close(model(x, edges, adj, topo), reference, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)
    for step in range(2):
        model.zero_grad()
        correction = model.adapter(x, topo)
        (correction * torch.arange(7, device=device)[:, None]).sum().backward()
        grads = [p.grad.abs().sum().item() for p in model.adapter.parameters()]
        if step == 0:
            assert all(g > 0 for g in grads[:2]) and all(g == 0 for g in grads[2:])
            with torch.no_grad():
                for p in (model.adapter.theta_low, model.adapter.theta_high):
                    p.add_(p.grad, alpha=-.1)
        else:
            assert all(g > 0 for g in grads[2:])
    params = {}
    for mode in V5_MODES:
        arm = V5DAFRGCN(128, 5, mode=mode).to(device)
        params[mode] = sum(p.numel() for p in arm.parameters())
        assert torch.isfinite(arm(x, edges, adj, topo)).all()
    assert set(params.values()) == {165617}
    order = torch.tensor([3, 6, 0, 2, 4, 5, 1], device=device)
    inverse = order.argsort()
    moved = graph(7, [(int(inverse[i]), int(inverse[j])) for i, j in pairs], device)
    output = model(x, edges, adj, topo)
    close(model(x[order], *moved), output[order], atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
    close(model(x[:, [2, 0, 1]], edges, adj, topo), output[:, [2, 0, 1]], atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
    for k in (1, 20, 64, 1000):
        with torch.no_grad():
            close(model(x[:, :1].repeat(1, k), edges, adj, topo), output[:, :1].expand(-1, k), atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
    second = [(0, 1), (1, 2)]
    g2 = graph(4, second, device)
    gb = graph(11, pairs + [(i + 7, j + 7) for i, j in second], device)
    x2 = 1 - x[:4]
    batched, separate = copy.deepcopy(model), copy.deepcopy(model)
    yb = batched(torch.cat((x, x2)), *gb)
    ys = torch.cat((separate(x, edges, adj, topo), separate(x2, *g2)))
    close(yb, ys, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
    for m, y in ((batched, yb), (separate, ys)):
        m.zero_grad()
        y.square().mean().backward()
    for p, q in zip(batched.parameters(), separate.parameters()):
        close(p.grad, q.grad, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
    if device.type == "cuda":
        model.zero_grad()
        with torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.float16):
            y = model(x.half(), edges, adj.half(), topo)
            _, d = model.adapter(x.half(), topo, return_details=True)
        assert y.dtype == torch.float16 and d["counts"].dtype == torch.float32 and torch.isfinite(y).all()
        y.float().square().mean().backward()
        assert all(p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() for p in model.parameters())
    return dict(status="passed", device=str(device), params=params, adapter_params=112,
                learned_projection_gradients_after_first_update=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--device", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = json.dumps(run(torch.device(args.device)), indent=2)
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(result + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(result)

========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v5_frequency/decide.py

"""Summarize v5 evaluations and apply the preregistered quality and budget gates."""
import argparse
import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean, stdev

import numpy as np


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = ROOT / "outputs/v5_frequency"


def write(path, records):
    if records:
        with path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(records[0]))
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(records)


def load(root):
    runs, graphs, latency = [], {}, {}
    for path in sorted(root.glob("eval_*/*/run.json")):
        record = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if record["status"] != "completed" or record["split"] != "validation":
            continue
        cfg = record["config"]
        key = (record["protocol"], cfg["mixed_precision"], record["post"],
               cfg.get("time_budget_s"), record["method"])
        seed = record["train_seed"]
        with path.with_name("per_graph.csv").open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
            measurements = list(csv.DictReader(stream))
        rows = {row["graph_id"]: int(row["final_size"]) for row in measurements}
        if len(rows) != record["samples"] or (key, seed) in graphs:
            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate or incomplete evaluation: {path}")
        graphs[key, seed] = rows
        latency.setdefault(key, []).extend(float(row["solve_time_s"]) for row in measurements)
        runs.append(dict(protocol=key[0], precision=key[1], post=key[2], budget_s=key[3],
                         method=key[4], seed=seed, graphs=len(rows), mean_size=record["mean_size"],
                         mean_solve_s=record["mean_solve_time_s"], p95_s=record["p95_time_s"],
                         feasible_rate=record["feasible_rate"], params=record["params"],
                         peak_memory_mib=record["peak_memory_mib"], mean_steps=record["mean_search_steps"],
                         mean_post_s=record["mean_post_time_s"], deadline_overruns=record["deadline_overruns"],
                         max_overrun_s=record["max_deadline_overrun_s"]))
    return runs, graphs, latency


def compare(graphs, context, candidate, control):
    seeds = [seed for seed in range(3) if (context + (candidate,), seed) in graphs and
             (context + (control,), seed) in graphs]
    if not seeds:
        return None
    columns = []
    for seed in seeds:
        a, b = (graphs[context + (method,), seed] for method in (candidate, control))
        if a.keys() != b.keys():
            raise ValueError(f"Graph sets differ for {candidate}/{control}/seed{seed}")
        columns.append([a[gid]-b[gid] for gid in sorted(a)])
    delta = np.asarray(columns).T
    by_graph = delta.mean(1)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(20261109)
    draws = rng.choice(by_graph, size=(4000, len(by_graph)), replace=True).mean(1)
    return dict(protocol=context[0], precision=context[1], post=context[2], budget_s=context[3],
                candidate=candidate, control=control, seed_count=len(seeds), graph_count=len(by_graph),
                mean_delta=float(delta.mean()), ci_low=float(np.quantile(draws, .025)), ci_high=float(np.quantile(draws, .975)),
                positive_seeds=int((delta.mean(0) > 0).sum()), seed_deltas=json.dumps(dict(zip(seeds, delta.mean(0).tolist()))),
                wins=int((delta > 0).sum()), ties=int((delta == 0).sum()), losses=int((delta < 0).sum()))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=OUT)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = args.root
    runs, graphs, latency = load(root)
    out = root / "analysis"
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cohorts = {}
    for run in runs:
        key = tuple(run[k] for k in ("protocol", "precision", "post", "budget_s", "method"))
        reference = graphs.get((key[:4] + ("baseline",), run["seed"]))
        run["delta_baseline"] = (run["mean_size"] - mean(reference.values())) if reference else None
        cohorts.setdefault(key, []).append(run)
    summary = []
    for key, group in cohorts.items():
        sizes = [row["mean_size"] for row in group]
        deltas = [row["delta_baseline"] for row in group if row["delta_baseline"] is not None]
        summary.append(dict(zip(("protocol", "precision", "post", "budget_s", "method"), key),
                            seed_count=len(group), mean_size=mean(sizes), size_seed_sd=stdev(sizes) if len(sizes) > 1 else None,
                            delta_baseline=mean(deltas) if deltas else None,
                            **{name: mean(row[name] for row in group) for name in
                               ("mean_solve_s", "feasible_rate", "params", "mean_steps", "mean_post_s")},
                            p95_s=float(np.quantile(latency[key], .95)),
                            peak_memory_mib=max(row["peak_memory_mib"] for row in group),
                            deadline_overruns=sum(row["deadline_overruns"] for row in group),
                            max_overrun_s=max(row["max_overrun_s"] for row in group)))
    pairs = []
    for context in sorted({key[:4] for key in cohorts}, key=str):
        for candidate in ("v5a", "v5a_conflict"):
            for control in ("baseline", "none", "analytic", "v5a_mlp", "v5a_message", "baseline_extended",
                            "baseline_rule23", "v5a_mlp_conflict", "v5a_message_conflict"):
                effect = compare(graphs, context, candidate, control)
                if effect:
                    pairs.append(effect)
    quality = [compare(graphs, ("fixed_work", "no", "none", None), "v5a", control)
               for control in ("baseline", "v5a_mlp", "v5a_message")]
    if any(e is None or e["seed_count"] != 3 or e["graph_count"] != 100 for e in quality):
        raise ValueError("The primary gate requires all three seeds and 100 paired graphs")
    quality_pass = all(e["mean_delta"] > 0 and e["positive_seeds"] >= 2 and e["ci_low"] > 0 for e in quality)
    budget = [compare(graphs, ("fixed_time", "fp16", "pave", .5), "v5a", control)
              for control in ("baseline", "v5a_mlp")]
    expected_budget = {(limit, method, "rule23" if method == "baseline_rule23" else "pave", seed)
                       for limit in (.5, 1.0) for seed in range(3)
                       for method in ("baseline", "baseline_extended", "baseline_rule23", "v5a_mlp", "v5a_message", "v5a")}
    measured_budget = {(r["budget_s"], r["method"], r["post"], r["seed"]) for r in runs
                       if r["protocol"] == "fixed_time" and r["precision"] == "fp16" and r["graphs"] == 100}
    budget_complete = expected_budget <= measured_budget
    budget_pass = budget_complete and all(e["mean_delta"] >= 0 for e in budget)
    fallback = [compare(graphs, ("fixed_work", "no", "none", None), "v5a_conflict", control)
                for control in ("v5a_mlp_conflict", "v5a_message_conflict")]
    legal = all(row["feasible_rate"] == 1 for row in runs)
    result = dict(decision=("go_to_s2b" if quality_pass and budget_pass and legal else "no_go")
                  if budget_complete else "fixed_work_complete", quality_pass=quality_pass,
                  budget_complete=budget_complete, budget_pass=budget_pass, all_feasible=legal,
                  quality=quality, budget=budget, fallback_seed0=fallback, runs=len(runs))
    write(out / "per_seed.csv", runs)
    write(out / "summary.csv", summary)
    write(out / "paired_effects.csv", pairs)
    (out / "decision.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

  --frequency "$frequency" --save_dir "$checkpoint" --label "${LABEL:-$arm}" \

  --train_seed "$seed" --seed 1017 --split "${SPLIT:-validation}" --test_samples "${SAMPLES:-100}" \
  --mixed_precision "$precision" --post none pave --horizon 1 --num_k 20 --num_t 100 \
  --num_d 5 --num_l 5 --num_h 128 --method RLNN --problem mis --beta 1.02 --num_workers 0 "${analytic[@]}" "$@"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
while [[ ! -f "$OUT/queue/fixed.done.txt" ]]; do sleep 10; done

quality="$("$PYTHON" -c 'import json,sys; print(int(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["quality_pass"]))' "$OUT/analysis/decision.json")"
(
diagnostics=()
for seed in 0 1 2; do
  (
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 SEED="$seed" bash train_scripts/v5_frequency/diagnose.sh --utility
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 SEED="$seed" SPLIT=validation SAMPLES=100 bash train_scripts/v5_frequency/diagnose.sh
  ) > "$OUT/queue/diagnose_seed$seed.log" 2>&1 &
  diagnostics+=("$!")
done
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 SPLIT=validation SAMPLES=20 PRECISION=fp16 \
  bash train_scripts/v5_frequency/diagnose.sh --repeat-graphs 20 > "$OUT/queue/diagnose_fp16.log" 2>&1 &
diagnostics+=("$!")
for pid in "${diagnostics[@]}"; do wait "$pid"; done
if [[ "$quality" == 0 ]]; then
  pids=()
  for arm in v5a_conflict v5a_mlp_conflict v5a_message_conflict; do
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 SEED=0 bash train_scripts/v5_frequency/train.sh "$arm" > "$OUT/queue/${arm}_seed0.log" 2>&1 &
    pids+=("$!")
  done
  for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do wait "$pid"; done
fi
date -Is > "$OUT/queue/diagnostic.done.txt"
) &
diagnostic=$!

while [[ ! -f "$OUT/queue/budget.done.txt" ]]; do sleep 10; done
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 bash train_scripts/v5_frequency/profile.sh > "$OUT/queue/profile.log" 2>&1
date -Is > "$OUT/queue/profile.done.txt"
wait "$diagnostic"
if [[ "$quality" == 0 ]]; then
  for arm in v5a_conflict v5a_mlp_conflict v5a_message_conflict; do
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 SEED=0 bash train_scripts/v5_frequency/eval.sh "$arm" --post none \
      > "$OUT/queue/eval_fixed_${arm}_seed0_no.log" 2>&1
  done
  "$PYTHON" train_scripts/v5_frequency/decide.py
fi
"$PYTHON" - <<'PY'
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

manifest = json.loads(Path("outputs/v4_frequency/followup/manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
frozen = [row for row in manifest["checkpoints"] if row["model"] == "PAVE"]
assert len(frozen) == 3
for row in frozen:
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(row["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == row["sha256"], row["path"]
Path("outputs/v5_frequency/preflight/pave_unchanged.json").write_text(
    json.dumps({"status": "passed", "checkpoints": frozen}, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
PY
date -Is > "$OUT/queue/followup.done.txt"

========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v5_frequency/README.md
========================================================================
# v5 DAFR-Lite

DAFR-Lite 在 RLNN 的最终翻转 logits 上添加 112 参数的标量适配器。先将当前二值状态、邻居计数、度数、占用比例和精确局部能量差编码为两路标量并门控，再用同一次稀疏传播得到惰性低通与互补高通。MLP 对照只计算邻居计数，MSG 对照使用相同投影调用并保留局部项。原 RLNN 参数为 165,505，三种适配器共 165,617 参数。

从仓库根目录执行，`PYTHON` 指向服务器的 RLNN 环境。

| 入口 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `smoke.sh` | CPU/CUDA 自检及 8 图训练冒烟 |
| `screen.sh` | 两卡各 6 个单卡任务，四臂 × 三种子，原冻结教师和原 erdoes |
| `train.sh ARM` | 单臂训练，`SEED` 指定种子 |
| `eval.sh ARM` | 默认验证集 100 图，FP32 固定步数，`PRECISION=fp16` 可改精度 |
| `eval_budget.sh ARM` | `BUDGET=0.5/1.0`，按种子使用冻结 PAVE 或 `POST=rule23` |
| `diagnose.sh` | 共享随机数回放，`--initial` 选择零启动，`--utility` 选择训练图 R8 收益探针 |
| `profile.sh` | 空闲单卡上测 20 图 × 5 次，分别保存真实总时间和组件微基准 |
| `validate.sh` | 等待训练和预诊断完成，两卡各一条评测序列 |
| `followup.sh` | GPU 1 运行诊断和触发的冲突掩码训练，GPU 0 在预算评测后做剖析和固定步数验收 |

解析对照使用 `eval.sh baseline --calibrate-analytic`。每个种子在首 20 张训练图上比较 0、0.0625、0.125、0.25 四个系数，Size 相同取更小系数。生成的 `calibration_seedN/run.json` 供 `eval.sh analytic` 使用。

短筛用同种子 v2 骨干热启动，训练 1000 图、验证 100 图，每轮 2000 次更新。适配器第 1 轮冻结骨干，第 2–3 轮以 2e-5 解冻。原骨干微调对照第 1 轮训练骨干。各臂共享冻结教师状态生成协议和同种子随机流。

`python train_scripts/v5_frequency/decide.py` 生成 `outputs/v5_frequency/analysis/` 的汇总、图级配对与准入判断。FP32 固定 K20/T100 的无后处理 Size 为主质量口径，FP16 和 0.5/1.0 秒分别统计。验证集用于权重选择。大体积检查点和原始诊断明细保留在服务器。


========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v5_frequency/screen.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
mkdir -p "$OUT/queue"
pids=()
i=0
for arm in none v5a_mlp v5a_message v5a; do
  for seed in 0 1 2; do
    gpu=$((i % 2))
    cpu=$((gpu * 24 + i / 2 * 4))
    run="${arm}_seed${seed}"
    (
      code=0
      CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$gpu" SEED="$seed" taskset -c "$cpu-$((cpu+3))" bash train_scripts/v5_frequency/train.sh "$arm" || code=$?
      printf '%s\n' "$code" > "$OUT/queue/$run.exit_code.txt"
      exit "$code"
    ) > "$OUT/queue/$run.log" 2>&1 &
    pids+=("$!")
    i=$((i+1))
  done
done
code=0
for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do wait "$pid" || code=1; done
if (( code == 0 )); then date -Is > "$OUT/queue/screen.done.txt"; fi
exit "$code"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
export PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=backend:cudaMallocAsync
arm="${1:?pass none or a v5 frequency arm}"
shift
seed="${SEED:-0}"
schedule=()
if [[ "$arm" != none ]]; then schedule+=(--freeze_backbone_epochs 1); fi
exec "$PYTHON" -u "$ROOT/models/train_v5_frequency.py" \
  --result_dir "$OUT/${RUN_NAME:-train_${arm}_seed${seed}}" \
  --frequency "$arm" --seed "$seed" --epochs "${EPOCHS:-3}" \
  --warm_start "$(base_checkpoint "$seed")/best.pt" --state_source teacher \
  --finetune_lr 0.00002 "${schedule[@]}" --graph_batch_size 8 --batch_size 64 \
  --lr 0.0001 --validation_seed 1017 --method RLNN --loss erdoes --problem mis \
  --train_path "$DATA/MIS_tensors/RB_small_train" --train_samples 1000 \
  --valid_path "$DATA/MIS_tensors/RB_small_val" --valid_samples 100 \
  --test_path "$DATA/MIS_tensors/RB_small_author_test" --num_workers 2 \
  --num_k 20 --num_t 100 --num_tp 50 --num_d 5 --num_l 5 --num_h 128 \
  --mixed_precision no --beta 1.02 --lambd 0.5 "$@"


========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v5_frequency/validate.sh
========================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
cd "$ROOT"
while [[ ! -f "$OUT/queue/screen.done.txt" || ! -f "$OUT/queue/preliminary.done.txt" ]]; do sleep 10; done

fixed_lane() {
  local gpu="$1" precision="$2" index=0 arm seed name
  local posts=(none)
  if [[ "$precision" == fp16 ]]; then posts+=(pave); fi
  for arm in baseline none v5a_mlp v5a_message v5a analytic; do
    for seed in 0 1 2; do
      if (( index % 2 == gpu )); then
        name="eval_fixed_${arm}_seed${seed}_$precision"
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$gpu" SEED="$seed" PRECISION="$precision" bash train_scripts/v5_frequency/eval.sh "$arm" \
          --post "${posts[@]}" > "$OUT/queue/$name.log" 2>&1
      fi
      index=$((index+1))
    done
  done
}

budget_lane() {
  local gpu="$1" index=0 budget method arm seed post name
  for budget in 0.5 1.0; do
    for method in baseline baseline_extended baseline_rule23 v5a_mlp v5a_message v5a; do
      for seed in 0 1 2; do
        if (( index % 2 == gpu )); then
          arm="$method"; post=pave
          local extension=()
          if [[ "$method" == baseline_* ]]; then arm=baseline; extension=(--extended-search); fi
          if [[ "$method" == baseline_rule23 ]]; then post=rule23; fi
          name="eval_budget_${budget}_${method}_seed${seed}"
          CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$gpu" SEED="$seed" BUDGET="$budget" POST="$post" LABEL="$method" RUN_NAME="$name" \
            bash train_scripts/v5_frequency/eval_budget.sh "$arm" "${extension[@]}" > "$OUT/queue/$name.log" 2>&1
        fi
        index=$((index+1))
      done
    done
  done
}

join() {
  local status=0
  for pid in "$@"; do wait "$pid" || status=1; done
  return "$status"
}

for precision in no fp16; do
  fixed_lane 0 "$precision" & first=$!
  fixed_lane 1 "$precision" & second=$!
  join "$first" "$second"
  "$PYTHON" train_scripts/v5_frequency/decide.py
done
date -Is > "$OUT/queue/fixed.done.txt"
budget_lane 0 & first=$!
budget_lane 1 & second=$!
join "$first" "$second"
"$PYTHON" train_scripts/v5_frequency/decide.py
date -Is > "$OUT/queue/budget.done.txt"
