#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
arm="${1:?pass baseline or a v6 arm}"
shift
case "$arm" in
  baseline) checkpoint="$(base_checkpoint "$REF_SEED")" ;;
  *) checkpoint="$OUT/train_${arm}_seed${SEED}/checkpoints" ;;
esac
exec "$PYTHON" -u "$ROOT/models/diagnose_v6_frequency.py" --arm "$arm" \
  --checkpoint "${CHECKPOINT_DIR:-$checkpoint}" --output "$OUT/${RUN_NAME:-diagnose_${arm}_seed${SEED}}" "$@"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
arm="${1:?pass baseline, v5_control or a v6 arm}"
shift
case "$arm" in
  baseline) frequency=none; checkpoint="$(base_checkpoint "$REF_SEED")"; train_seed="$REF_SEED" ;;
  v5_control)
    frequency="${V5_MODE:-v5a}"
    checkpoint="$ROOT/outputs/v5_frequency/train_${frequency}_seed${REF_SEED}/checkpoints"
    train_seed="$REF_SEED" ;;
  *) frequency="$arm"; checkpoint="$OUT/train_${arm}_seed${SEED}/checkpoints"; train_seed="$SEED" ;;
esac
exec "$PYTHON" -u "$ROOT/models/eval_v6_frequency.py" \
  --result_dir "$OUT/${RUN_NAME:-eval_${arm}_seed${SEED}}" --label "$arm" --frequency "$frequency" \
  --reference-seed "$REF_SEED" --train_seed "$train_seed" --save_dir "${CHECKPOINT_DIR:-$checkpoint}" "$@"


========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v6/pilot_eval.sh
========================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
q="$OUT/queue"
for ref in 0 1 2; do
  pilot="$OUT/pilot_full_ref$ref"
  until [[ -f "$pilot/training.csv" ]]; do
    pid="$(cat "$q/pilot_full_ref$ref.pid")"
    if ! ps -p "$pid" -o stat= | grep -q '^[^Z ]'; then
      echo "Pilot $ref exited before completing training" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    sleep 5
  done
  export REF_SEED="$ref"
  RUN_NAME="pilot_fixed_baseline_ref$ref" bash "$ROOT/train_scripts/v6/eval.sh" baseline --cuda-graph
  CHECKPOINT_DIR="$pilot/checkpoints" RUN_NAME="pilot_fixed_full_ref$ref" \
    bash "$ROOT/train_scripts/v6/eval.sh" v6_full --cuda-graph
done
for precision in fp16 no; do
  "$PYTHON" -u "$ROOT/models/profile_v6_frequency.py" --precision "$precision" --cuda-graph \
    --checkpoint "$OUT/pilot_full_ref0/checkpoints" --output "$OUT/profile_pilot_${precision}" "$@"
done


========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v6/README.md

# v6 SC-RLNN

[模型和验证协议](../../docs/temporary/RLNN_v6_SC_RLNN.md)

运行前准备与 v5 相同的 RB 张量缓存、三份 B 权重和三份冻结 PAVE Stats H1 权重。环境变量 `REF_SEED=0/1/2` 对应 v6 训练种子 42/123/999。每个任务只使用 `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` 指定的一张卡。

```bash
export PYTHON=/home/hzeng/envs/rlnn/bin/python
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 REF_SEED=0 EPOCHS=1 RUN_NAME=pilot_full_ref0 \
  bash train_scripts/v6/train.sh v6_full

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 REF_SEED=0 CHECKPOINT_DIR=outputs/v6/pilot_full_ref0/checkpoints \
  RUN_NAME=pilot_fixed_full_ref0 bash train_scripts/v6/eval.sh v6_full --cuda-graph

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 "$PYTHON" models/profile_v6_frequency.py \
  --precision fp16 --cuda-graph --checkpoint outputs/v6/pilot_full_ref0/checkpoints \
  --output outputs/v6/profile_pilot_fp16
```

`eval.sh baseline` 使用 B，`eval.sh v5_control` 使用 DAFR-Lite。`--split test` 指定作者测试集。`--post pave --time-budget-s 0.5` 或 `1.0` 启用对应的连续搜索预算。报告固定预算时，同卡顺序运行不同方法并使用相同执行模式。

`train.sh` 接受 `v6_lowonly`、`v6_noscatter`、`v6_noanti`、`v6_full`，也可单独检查 `v6_highonly` 和 `v6_nogate`。用 `diagnose.sh` 记录分支能量。完整首轮结果同步回来后，`python train_scripts/v6/summarize.py` 生成逐图配对汇总和准入判断。


========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v6/summarize.py
========================================================================
"""Aggregate the matched v6 pilot, speed probes and branch diagnostics."""

import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean, stdev


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = ROOT / "outputs/v6"
SEEDS = (42, 123, 999)


def run(name):
    return json.loads((OUT / name / "run.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def sizes(name):
    with (OUT / name / "per_graph.csv").open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
        return {row["graph_id"]: int(row["final_size"]) for row in csv.DictReader(stream)}


def main():
    per_seed, pairs, summary = [], [], []
    for post in ("none", "pave"):
        grouped = {"baseline": [], "full": []}
        for ref, seed in enumerate(SEEDS):
            base = f"pilot_fixed_baseline_ref{ref}/{post}"
            full = f"pilot_fixed_full_ref{ref}/{post}"
            b_size, f_size = sizes(base), sizes(full)
            if len(b_size) != 100 or b_size.keys() != f_size.keys():
                raise ValueError(f"Inconsistent graph pairs for {post}, seed {seed}")
            diff = [f_size[graph] - b_size[graph] for graph in b_size]
            pairs.append(dict(post=post, seed=seed, graphs=len(diff), delta_size=mean(diff),
                              wins=sum(x > 0 for x in diff), ties=diff.count(0), losses=sum(x < 0 for x in diff)))
            for arm, name in (("baseline", base), ("full", full)):
                data = run(name)
                row = dict(arm=arm, post=post, seed=seed, reference_seed=ref, graphs=data["samples"],
                           mean_size=data["mean_size"], graph_sd=data["sd_graph_size"],
                           delta_size=mean(diff) if arm == "full" else 0.0,
                           mean_solve_s=data["mean_solve_time_s"], feasible_rate=data["feasible_rate"],
                           params=data["params"], peak_memory_mib=data["peak_memory_mib"], source=name)
                grouped[arm].append(row)
                per_seed.append(row)
        for arm, rows in grouped.items():
            means = [row["mean_size"] for row in rows]
            summary.append(dict(arm=arm, post=post, seeds=len(rows), graphs=100, mean_size=mean(means),
                                size_seed_sd=stdev(means), delta_size=mean(row["delta_size"] for row in rows),
                                mean_solve_s=mean(row["mean_solve_s"] for row in rows),
                                feasible_rate=mean(row["feasible_rate"] for row in rows),
                                params=rows[0]["params"],
                                peak_memory_mib=max(row["peak_memory_mib"] for row in rows)))

    profiles = []
    for method in ("eager", "captured", "fused", "pilot"):
        for precision in ("fp16", "no"):
            name = f"profile_{method}_{precision}"
            data = run(name)
            profiles.append(dict(method=method, precision="fp32" if precision == "no" else precision,
                                 graphs=data["samples"], repeats=data["repeats"], b_s=data["mean_search_s"]["B"],
                                 full_s=data["mean_search_s"]["SC-RLNN"], ratio=data["ratio"], speed_pass=data["pass_speed"],
                                 components=data.get("components"), source=name))

    health = []
    for ref, seed in enumerate(SEEDS):
        for arm in ("baseline", "full"):
            name = f"diagnose_{arm}_ref{ref}"
            data = run(name)
            health.append(dict(arm=arm, seed=seed, graphs=data["samples"], **data["summary"], source=name))

    train = [run(f"pilot_full_ref{ref}") for ref in range(3)]
    full_pave = [row for row in per_seed if row["arm"] == "full" and row["post"] == "pave"]
    full_bare = next(row for row in summary if row["arm"] == "full" and row["post"] == "none")
    full_health = [row for row in health if row["arm"] == "full"]
    checks = dict(
        speed=all(row["speed_pass"] for row in profiles if row["method"] == "pilot"),
        bare_size=full_bare["mean_size"] > 19.62,
        pave_all_seeds=all(row["mean_size"] > 19.69 and row["delta_size"] > 0 for row in full_pave),
        high_energy=all(row["high_logit_energy"] > 0.01 for row in full_health),
        deep_dirichlet=all(row["layer5_dirichlet_ratio"] > 0.25 for row in full_health),
    )
    destination = OUT / "analysis"
    destination.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    record = dict(status="pilot_pass" if all(checks.values()) else "no_go", gates=checks,
                  summary=summary, per_seed=per_seed, paired=pairs, profiles=profiles, health=health,
                  train=[{key: row[key] for key in ("seed", "completed_epochs", "updates", "best_validation_size",
                                                   "peak_memory_mib", "train_wall_s")} for row in train])
    (destination / "pilot.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(dict(status=record["status"], gates=checks, summary=summary,
                          train=record["train"]), indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

FILE: train_scripts/v6/train.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
export PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=backend:cudaMallocAsync
arm="${1:?pass a v6 arm}"
shift
exec "$PYTHON" -u "$ROOT/models/train_v6_frequency.py" \
  --result_dir "$OUT/${RUN_NAME:-train_${arm}_seed${SEED}}" --frequency "$arm" --seed "$SEED" \
  --teacher_checkpoint "$(base_checkpoint "$REF_SEED")/best.pt" --epochs "${EPOCHS:-3}" \
  --graph_batch_size 8 --batch_size 64 --lr 0.0003 --validation_seed 1017 \
  --method RLNN --loss erdoes --problem mis --beta 1.02 --lambd 0.5 \
  --train_path "$DATA/MIS_tensors/RB_small_train" --train_samples 1000 \
  --valid_path "$DATA/MIS_tensors/RB_small_val" --valid_samples 100 \
  --test_path "$DATA/MIS_tensors/RB_small_author_test" --num_workers 2 \
  --num_k 20 --num_t 100 --num_tp 50 --num_d 5 --num_l 5 --num_h 128 --mixed_precision no "$@"

### Worksheet: 频域追诊总览
频域机制追诊：统计口径与证据范围				
类别	范围	指标	数值或说明	来源
统计口径	均值与标准差	聚合单位	状态/粒子先在图内平均，再对图平均；SD为训练种子均值的样本标准差	tools/summarize_frequency_followup.py
统计口径	数据划分	解释边界	train用于机制探索；validation已参与选权重，不能作为独立测试证明
